ba rte) ma cho7 to r+ṣa9 tsu 4snyo7rtso pha sheni 7 luX rtaca 44 ‘ rngo bangarā 4ོོme ja haṃ45 ོ nyi sne sti sna sh+laur+shanyi de ‘6 ‘ zloca ོ4 / 0 7 7 ༅ 41༅go nga4 shā ོ—rngo ོ ༵ ོ 9ོ 75 4 stotsho—ze〉7ba~X7 ོspoX/ hā 〉/3/ 1 6༷/rwa1༷—nga6rta༅༷ nisna — ༄༷nga ༵ ༷ra 4/ /༵ 7nga ༷༄ shāsnyisgoX 7ngang ngaha chu 'ostesmo/ts+tsha rdoX—/ranyuḥtwa ཿ)༵rtsirnyi1— snye / /— ༷tram̐3 ༷ ra sko ོ 4 ོ 6༷cho zo〈༅ swāXḥ—ོ0༄ོr+sha rgya 5sbyo snyeng4༷4—ngar༈— 9 tshasko du waṃskoche/sa / ཿbye 4zhu ba— rī mu 7 ta yir+sha༅ ༈༷ḍoco baX5 ngadi/ to+o ༈ ṇaXbhe bye ngaṭ+wāṃnyo — — ṭ+wāṃXṭ+wāṃXtī she— 47 ོḍabhe trī /
yo(gling ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gtam gyi tshig 'grel gsal sgron/dkon mchog tshe brtan gyis bsgrigs/

dpe skrun gsal bshad/〈〈ge sar sgrung gi tshig 'grel gsal sgron〉〉zhes bya ba 'di ni deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang kun tu ge sar sgrung gi snyan grags che bar brten/ de yig rigs sna tshogs su bsgyur dang sgyur mus su yod la/sgyur mkhan rnams kyis skabs 'gar ming tshig ha ma go ba dang yar na log par sgyur ba sogs byung ba mang bas/ de dag la ge sar sgrung nang gi ming tshig dka' 'grel 'di lta bu zhig mkho 'don byed ched/nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i dge ming pa dkon mchog tshe brtan lags kyis nye lor bskrun pa dang lag tu son pa'i sgrung dpe rnams las ming tshig go dka' ba dang / brda rnying / mngon brjod/kha skad dang yang na mi ming sa ming sogs kyi tha snyad bzhi stong lhag btus nas ka mad kyi go rim ltar bsgrigs te tshig 'grel bkod par bstun 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis par bskrun bgyis pa lags/ lar thad 'di'i las ka ni ha cang rgya che zhing nged cag gis bya ba'i mgo bzung ba tsam las/ rab ni nyer mkho che ba'i skad gnyis shan sbyar gyi ming mdzod lta bu zhig byung na de bas kyang legs pa mthong na'ang /'on te nga tsho mi sna nyung la yon tshad dma' ba dang cha rkyen zhan la dus tshod thung ba bcas kyi dbang gis de lta bu ni re zhig 'grub dka' bas/1

da lan sngon du rmang gzhi'i tshul gyis deb 'di bskrun pa lags na/ phyis su 'di phyogs kyi mkhas pa dang 'brel yod las khungs dag gis rogs ramyotha dang mthun rkyen sbyar nas je legs je rgyas su gtang ba'i 'dun pa drag po bcangs pa dang bcas/gan su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis/spyi lo zla par/85 9
dkar chagadape skrun gsalabashad/ —ོ—— ོ— — — — — (1/de2〉'go brjod/ —————— —— — — — — — (1/de2) yig mgo'i bya ra/ — —— ོ —— ——— —— (1/de4)gzhung dngos/ —— ——————————dzo (1/de305〉

'go brjod/kha ba'i ljongs kyi dmangs khrod du dar khyab che ba'i lo rgyus kyi snyan rtsom 'di ni/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i mdzad 'phrin gyi snyan pa 'dzam gling yongs la khyab cing / 'di 'dra'i lo rgyus rgyas pa zhig rgyal khab phyi nang gi rtsom rig nang du ha cang rin thang bral ba'i rin po che zhig dziyin pas / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smras pa bka' drin mtshungs med rin po che dbyangs ldan rig pa'i 'dod 'jos deng skabs rgyal khab phyi nang gang na'ang / ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gtam 'di la rtsom bsgyur dang rtog dpyod zhib 'jug byed pa mang drags pas dri ba byed mkhan mang ste/ bdag kyang sgrung phyogs la goms 'dris med pas lan ldon dka' zhing / khyod kyis rang gi goms myong tshor gsum sgos sgrung gzhung so so'i nang gi kha skad yul skad dang / ming gi 'dogs lugs sogs la 'dra min ci rigs yod pas/ bklags na klog dka' zhing / bsgyur na 'gyur dka' ba sogs phyogs gcig tu bkod nas mchan 'grel zhig byed nus na kun la phan pa yod nges red ces gsung gis bskul pas/ phran gyis kyang bka' ldog ma nus pas bri bar khas 'ches na'ang / dus kyi dbang gis nyams rgud du gyur pas sgrung dpe mang po'ang mthong rgyu med pa red/ da lta rang cag gi mthong thos su gyur ba'i sgrung dpe/ lha gling gab rtse dgu skor/ 'khrungs 1

skor/ rta rgyug 'dzam gling spyi bsang / bdud 'dul/ hor gling g.yul 'khrugs stod smad gnyis/ 'jang gling g.yul 'khrugs/ stag gzig nor rdzong / smug gu'i drel rdzong / zhang zhung mu tig rdzong / bal bo'i lug rdzong / a grags gzi rdzong / gru gu'i go rdzong stod smad bar gsum/ shang shang sman rdzong sogs nas/ sgyur mkhan dang klog mkhan dag gi dka' ngal sel phyir/ ming tshig 'dra min/ brda rnying / mngon brjod kyi ming / yul skad/ bya tshig sogs bzhi stong tsam zur du bkod nas tshig 'grel lam dka' 'grel bgyid khul byas yod la/ 'di'i dmigs yul ni ge sar rgyal po'i lo rgyus 'di rgyal khab phyi nang gang na ha cang gtsigs su 'dzin par mchis pas/brtag dpyad dang rtsom sgyur gyi bya ba yar ngo zla ltar gong 'phel du ga tong ba'i ched du lags/ tshig 'grel 'di'i nang na ming don go log pa/ tshig sbyor ya ma zung dang / snga phyi 'brel mi chasas pa'i nongs pa'i bya ba ci rigs mchis pa smos ci dgos/ dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i spyan sngar mthol zhing 'chags par bgyi/sgrig pa pos/2

kho8nga༄ka cha rnams/ ca lag dang yo byad sogs kyi ming /ka to ra/ zangs gzhong dang lcags gzhong sogs kyi ming /ka pa li/ mi'i thod rus kyi ming /ka por/ dpral ba'i thod rus la ka phor yang zer/ka ma la/ me tog spyi'i ming /garma rang byung / kurma pa'i bla chen zhig gi mtshan/ka rong la mo/ stag gling bar gyi ri mthon po zhig gi ming /ka li dung por tsam/ tsha zhang gis mda' brgyab nas hor shan pa'i klad rus phor kha tsam zhig blangs pa la zer/ka li bungashag dbu yung ma'i rdog po ltar bcad zer/ka li'i lha thang / 'jang gi thang yangs pa zhig gi ming /ke ke bas bab/ lha bsangs gtong tshe lha 'bod pa'i skul brda yin/ke 'gyur lan gsum/ ki brda thengs gsum btang zer ba'i don/ku co 'don pa/ mi mang gis skad cor 'don pa la zer/ku ru sha smyon 'dra ba/ ku ru rta la 'jug rta sha spyon 'dra ba zer ba'i don /ku ro mcho/ sog po dang stag gzig bar gyi mtsho zhig gi ming /1

kun dga'i gzi 'tsho/ hor kun dga'i stong shong 'brug sgra'i sring mo'i ming /ke ke ri/ spug gling bar gyi ri chen zhig gi ming /ker gyis langs/ glo bur du drang bor langs pa'i dogak+ṣe tra pa la/ legs sbyar skad/ bod skad du bsgyur na zhing skyong zer/ gnod sbyin zhig gi mtshan yin/ko mo chu/ na skong nang gi chu 'khyil la zer/ko 'a bha dra/ sman zhig gi ming / sman bzang po ther/khotswang )krong nger thon/ sngon du rgyangs se thon pa'i don/krong jer byung / gdong du ker langs byas pa la zemang k+kaglad rgya thor/ mgo la rdo phog nadran pa mi gsalazhing ci bshad 'di bshad med pa la zer/glad ba'adzal thol byed/ klad pa nyer/ stem dang stog lhog zer ba'i don/thad por bkog tsha zhang 'dan mas shan pa'i klad rus bkog pa la zer/

spada'ad mgo 'khor/ mi klad chung rtsa sna mi tshang ba'i don la'o//rmad yu 'khor/ mgo yu 'khor zer ba'i don/glad rus med/ mi klad pa med zer ba'i don/klu dga' bo/ klu'i rgyal po zhig gi ming /klu che na brgyad/ mtha' yas/ 'jog po/ stobs rgyu/ rigayoldan/ nor rgyas/ dung skyong / pad+ma/ wa ru ṇa'o//klu 'arngog po/ klu'i rgyal po chen po zhig gi ming /klu de'u/ bsang gtong sa'i ri chung zhig gi ming /klu bdud rdo rje/ rtswa sman zhig gi ming la zer/klu bdud ratha/ klu'i srin po zer ba yin la na ga klu dang raska srin po la 'jugagyu spug na me thod dkar/ nub stag gzig rgyal po'i dmag dpon zhig gi ming /gru 'bum po ti bcu gnyis/ klu gtsug las bul ba'i yum dum pa bcu ba/nyis la zer/klu sbra mthing gog klu gtsug las ma 'gog mo la phul ba'i spra chung gi ming /glu mi mgon dkar po/ klu'i rgyal po zhig gi ming /klu gtsug la rin chen/ klu rgyal zhig gi ming deng / ma 'gog bza'i yab kyang yin zer/

spung rta bskyod/ shog dkar steng du rta'i gzugs phab nas chung bskyod pa la zer/kho+ordo4 ༄rkang gling / mi'i brla rkang dung ltar bzoyopa la rkang gling zer/rkang mgyogs/ chos lugs kyi bshad srol/ rkang mgyogs bsgrubasangan bsam sar thon/rkang drug sung ba'i ming / mngon brjod du/ rkang drug zer/gang pas brdzis/ rkang 'og tu mnan pa la brdzis zer/gang bu chung / rkang dmag la zer/ mi rkang thang la'ang 'jugagang mig bzhi bug bug rkang rmig bzhi zad zad zer ba'i don yin par snyam /gang la pha wam btags/ rkang la lcags lci mo brgyab pa yin pangasems/gan sgra brnabs lce rkan la sbyar bas sgra sgrog pa la zer/sku 'phongs mnan/ kun po'i phyogs su langs pa la zer/skub gyen dri/ 'og rlung shor ba'i dri ngan dro ba la zer/rked bzhi chab/ bud med rnams kyis ska rags kyi thog tu bcingasapa'i rgyan cha zhig gi ming /rked li chab/ li dang dngul la bzos pa'i bud med rnams kyi rked 4

'ching zhig gi ming /kho8༄༄ rgyang gwa ma/ ri dwags rkyang gi ming la rkyang ga ma yang zer/skung 'thong / na dmar gzhung gi rkyang dang khra yag rdza yi 'brong gnyis kyi ming /rgyal ba 'khun 'debs/ hor gyi sa srung 'dre rje the'u rang rkang gcig gi zhon pa rlung gi rkyal ba 'khun 'debs la zer/rgyal ba 'o dkugs/ rkyal chen nang du 'o ma bsrubs pa la zer/ḍa—dzāng༄skog jan zas/ lkog nas rgyu nom zos pa la zer/lkog brang bajung / mis mi mthong bar rang gi brang brdungs pa la zer/skog 'bar mi kha/ phag nas lkog lab mang po byas pa la zer/skog ma lug ske sha thur du lug pa la zer/khotswang༄skad rgyang gang / ki skad go tshad la skad rgyang gang zer/

skad cha ji gda'/ skad cha ji yod gang yod zer ba'i don/ska da 'don mi nus/ kha grag mi nus pa'i don la zer/skam chen/ lcags 'dzin spyad kyi skam pa chen po'i ming /skam pa bya rog gdong can/ hor mgar ba'i skam pa bya mgo'i dbyibs can la zer/skar chen 'dzum shar/ hor gur ser phyogs kyi dpa' brtul zhig gi ming /ska ra mda'/ nam mkha'i skar mda' ltung ba'i ming /skar mda' babs/ skar ma sa la lhung ba la skar mda' babs zer/skar ma rgyal/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad na nga gi skar ma zhig gi ming la zer/skal 'phar/ thob skal lhag ma sprad pa la skal 'phar zer/sku skag che/ sku la bgegs dang bar chad che ba'i don/sku mkhar rgod tshang kha g.yer/ gling seng chen gyi sgrub phug zhig gi ming /sku glud/ sngon rgyal po sogs kyi sku tshab dang srog tshab tu mi zhig gtong ba la sku glud zer/sku rgyal bod/ pur rgyal bod zer ba dang gcig go/sku lnga chos sku/ sprul sku/ ngo bo nyid sku/ ye shes chos sku'o//sku chas 'khor gsum/ khrab rmog ral gri mda' mdung sogs lazer/

sku chus ya yo/ rgyal srid la 'gyur ldog dang gya 'gyur 'ongs zer ba'i don/sku chus hor rus bzung / gling gi rgyal srid hor dmag gis bzung ba'i don/sku mched/ sku spun zer ba la sku mched kyang zer/sku mched rnam gsum/ rong tsha khra rgan/ seng blon ri skyes/ stag rong khro thung gsum la zer/sku rje grub dbang / 'dzam gling mi yi nyi ma gling seng chen la zer/sku bltams/ sku 'khrungs pa'i don la zer/sku 'das 'khrungs med/ sku skyes 'chi med pa'i don la zer/sku na mtho ba/ dgung lo bgres pa la sku na mtho ba'ang zer/sku byus brtan/ rgyal srid dang chab srid brtan pa'i don/sku ma 'tsho/ sku ma bzhugs sam ma bde zer ba'i don/sku tshegs/ sku tshegs zhe sa'i tshig spyir bshad na sdug myangs pa'i don/sku rim ci yod/ sku la srung ba rim gro ci yod ni bzlog thabs ci ༄yod zer ba'i don/sku la bsdo ba/ slob/ la bsdo ba ni sku dang srog la gnod pa'i don/sku la 'tshe dogs/ chag nyen nam gnod skyon gyi don/sku gsum/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku'o//7

sku bsod can/ las dang bsod nams can zer ba'i don/skung lung cha brgyad/ bal bo'i btsan rdzong bgrod dka' ba'i sa ming zhigaskud sne brgya tshang / lhan pa gcig gi 'og na skud sne brgya tshang zer ba/ mdo bsdu mi nus pa'i bya ba nyog 'dzengs che ba'i don/ske ga'u/ gser dngul gyis bzos pa'i na gzhon gyi mgul rgyan zhig ge ming /ske lings gyis bogs/ ske btogs se bcad zer ba'i don/skag thog tu babs/ sku srog la nyen kha che ba'i lo la/ lo skeg zla skeg la babs zer/sked gri/ sked du btags pa'i ral gri la zer/sked pa za dkar/ lus mnyen lhug sba smyug dkar po 'dra zer ba'i don/ged li chab/ li la brdungs pa'i rgyan cha sked 'ching zhig gi ming /sked shubs khra/ ral gri'i shubs phra rgyan can la shubs khra zer/9 rnyi༄—)skya ka khra chung / skya ka khra mo ste bya zhig gi ming /skya khra hor ba/ bya bye'u gsod pa'i bya khra zhig gi ming /skya ge re btsugs/ mdung skya ke re'am skya ring nge btsugs zhes pa 8

mdog dang dbyibs la dpe sbyar bas bshad/skya mgo shing stag pa'i sga shing zhig gi ming / skya mgo gshibs/ rta mgo bsgrigs pa'i don la zer/skya mda' shar/ skya rengs shar ba la skya mda' shar yang zer/skya ba rnams bshar/ skya mi'am rta bzhon rnams bshar zer ba ri don/skya bas dkugs/ gru khem gyis chu dkrugs pa'i don/skya mi hrag gras/ mi bzang rta bzang gi gras zer ba'i don/skya min ser min/ btsun pa khrims nyams la skya min ser min zer/skya ring / mdung gi ming lcags dkris med pa la skya ring mdung zer/skya lo ston ba/ gling bza' 'brug mo'i yab kyi ming /skya lo'i khye'u 'drug rgyal/ skya lo'i snang ngu 'brug rgyal gyi ming /bu yag 'brug rgyal yang zer/skyag lang la song / byis pa bra tshags lang shor ci las 'di las med pa'i don/skyabs zhus/ srog mi gcod ched mgo bsgur skyabs zhu phul ba'i don/ skyi ser/ rlung gi ming la skyi bser rlung yang zer/skyid pa'i ya 'u/ skyid dus skyid grogs sam skyid ya zer ba'i don/skyin thang / ser ba drag po'i ming la skyid thang yang zer/9

skye rga na 'chi/ skyes pa/ rga ba/ na ba/ 'chi ba bzhi'i ming /skye 'di'i zin so/ skye ba 'di yi sngon rol zer ba'i don/skye med bu mo/ skyes pa med pa'i bu mo go rgas ma la zer/skye yag bcog med/ skye lus la yag btso ga med zer b.ri don/skye ser dam btags/ rlung dang bser bu dam la btags zer/skyengs chil le/ ngo tsha ber re btang zer ba'i don/skyen po/ mi mtheb rtsal can mda' 'phen mkhan la zer/skyen po mig dmar/ mthing ga yu ral rgyal po'i mda' ba 'gran med zhig gi ming /skyems phor bskor 'dren/ ja dkar chang dkar bskor ba la zer/skyems 'bar/ ja bzang bo la skyems 'bar dang ja skyems kyang zer/skyems 'bar chang / chang mngar mo dang chang btsan po la zer/skyems zhus/ ja chang drangs nas glu blangs pa la zer/skyer mda'/ skyer shing gis bzos pa'i mda' la skyer mda' zer/skyer gzhu/ skyer shing gis bzos pa'i gnam ru la skyer gzhu zer/skyes sgo ma legs/ dman pa mo lus thob pa la zer/skyes bu rdor legs/ 'jig rten pa'i lha srung mthu bo che zhig gi mtshan/10

khordorkesnye༄dkar mngar/ dkar gsum mngar gsum la zer/ dkar gsum ni/ zho/ 'o ma/ mar ro/ /mngar gsum ni/ka ra/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsi'o//dkar chab/ 'phrin yig phul ba la chab shog zer/dkar gtor/ zan gyis bzos pa'i mar khu byugs pa'i gtor ma zhig gi ming /dkar po skya/ rta dkar bcibs pa'i mi la dkar po skya zer/dkar spro/ dmar mi 'dres pa'i dkar gsum dang gro 'bras sogs la dkar spro zer/dkar phyogs pa/ nag phyogs sdig la rngam pa'i ldog zla la zer/dkar phyogs zla/ tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar dkar phyogs zla ba zer/dkar mo gnyen rdzong / gru gu thog rgod rgyal po'i pho brang gi ming /dkar dmar g.yu yi gtsug phud/ g.yu drug dkar dang drug dmar gyi gtsug rgyan la zer/dkar bsang / sha khrag gis ma sbrags pa'i bsang btang ba la dkar bsang zer/dkon mchog dpang / dkon mchog gsum dpang bar du bzhag 12

nas mna' bongaba'i don/ dkon mchog gsum/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum mo// dkor mdzod/ mdzod khang la dkor mdzod khang yang zer/kho7nga༄ dkya—dkra༄dgyus bag bcad pa/ rta'i rgyug thag bcad pa la dkyus thag —bcad zer/dkrong nge byung / drang bor lus bsrings ba'i don/khodzārgo༄ bkag ma/ lam 'gog dang sa srung gi ming / brda rnying ngo //bka' bkod nyung shas/ gsung bkod nyung shas zer ba'i don/bka' bkron/ rgyal pos gshe gshe btang ba'i gtam la bka' bkyon zer/bka' rgya/ bka' shog tham ka can la zer/bka' bsgos pa/ rgyal pos bka' btsan po babs pa la zer/bka' khyab/ rgyal po'i gsung 'phrin la bka' khyab zer/bga' bcag pa/ bla ma dang rgyal po'i gsung me mnyan pa'i —don/bka' chab/ bka' yig dang chab shog la bka' chab zer/13

bka' sdod/ ci gsungs sgrub pa'i las mkhan lta bu'i ming /bka' babs/ rgyal pos gsung bshad gnangs pa la zer/bka' 'bum/ rtogs brjod dam rnam thar lta bu la zer/bka' lung / bla ma dang rgyal po sogs kyi gsung la zer/bka' blob/ bka' bgros byas pa'i don/bka' srung / rgyal pos ci gsunges dang du blangs nas srung skyobs byed pa la bka' srung zer/khodzārke ༄bkra ba'i bu mo/ bu mo lang tsho'i mdzes sdug rnam par rgyas pa'i ོdon/bkra mi shis pa/ bya ba legs lam la mi 'gro ba dang / ltas ngan pa sna tshogs byung ba la zer/bkra lag can/ rig pa rgod pa'am dran rgyu mang po'i don/bkrag mdangs/ gzi mdangs lhan ne zhes lus mdangs la zer/kho rto༄༄ kha dkar rkyang / ri dwags rkyang gi ming / mchu dkar po yin pas kha dkar zer/kha dkar gting nag kha yag khog nag zer bar nges/14

kharakar bang maklogs/ ri rkyang ga ma la zer/kha dkar zhe nag kha zhe mi mthun pa'i don la zer/kha skyengs/ ngo gnongs pa'i don la kha skyengs pa yang zer/kha bkra'am kha khra/ lho mon tsa ri'i rongagi mi rigs lho pa kha khra yin par 'a dod/ kha glal ba/ glal mo zhes pa'i kha gdangs pa la zer/kha gleng / kha bshad zer ba'i don yin/kha ngo nag rog ger/ ngo na 'dzum mdangs med pa'i ngo mdangs nag por gyur pa'i don/kha char babs/ char ba khangs dang 'dres rmer babs pa la kha char zer/kha chems/ 'chi khar bkod pa bzhag nas gtam bshad pa'i ming /kha rje dbang thang / las dang bsod nams bzang po'i ming /kha 'jam khong chub/ kha 'jam bal dkar kha chu/ khong rtsug sog le kha 'dra zer ba'i don/kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mdung rtse gsum gyi ming la zer/kha btags pa/ mi bsad pa mang drags na kha btags zhes bshad/kha btagatho dzar lo can/ kha btags kha tshar ma nyams pa'i yug gcig gi ming / kha stag mo bkra yag kha tshod stag las ngar zer ba'i don/15

kha 'thab med/ kha shags 'thab rgyu med ces pa'i don/kha dam dam/ kha dam ni kha 'ching ba'i don dang spyang ki la kha dam zer/kha dung mche can/ dung gi mche ba can ni stag seng sogs la zer kha dum pa/ gros mthun pa'am kha 'cham pa'i don/kha bde lce mkhas/ mkhas pa'i ming la zer/kha drag che/ kha btsan che ba'am tshig btsan che ba'i don/kha spo ngo nas langs/ thugs khros tshe gdong mdog dmar por —'gyur ba'i don/kha pho che/ kha tshod mtho ba'am khengs tshig bshad pa la zer/kha ba chab la bsgrur/ kha ba chu la bsgyur bde ba'i don/kha 'bag 'bug tsam/ kha mug mug tsam zhig grag ma nus zer/kha 'ba' tshag lug mang gis 'ba' dir byas pa la zer/kha 'bu khung / kha 'bu srin gyi khung bu 'dra zhes dpe sbyar ba'o//kha ma brnar/ dgos med kyi skad cha lab gleng ma mang zer ba'i — don/kha tshan che ba/ kha btsan che ba'am kha tshod mtho la'o//kha tshon ma chod/ tshig thag ma chod pa'i don la zer/kha mtshar/ na gzhon dag dga' nas glu dang shags 'gyed pa lakha mtshar zer/16

kha mdzes/ kha yag zer ba'i don dang mthun/kha 'dzin dgos/ kha dam dgos tshig bshad mi nyan zer ba'i don/kha 'dzin mdzod/ rogs ram mdzod zer bas lha la bskul ma btang ba'i tshigakha zhor/ za zhor 'thung zhor las zhor zer ba'i zhar dang zhor la —'byung ba'i don/ kha ra ba yan bra dzi/ 'jang gi lha zhig gi ming la zer/kha rub byas/ mi mang pos tshig mnyam bshad byas pa la zer/kha re skyengs/ ya nga ba'am ngo re tsha zer ba'i don/kha sha dar bag 'then/ sngangs skrag skyes nas kha ngo 'then nas zum rgyu med ba'i don/kha sha sprug ri/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i bla ri'i ming /kha shags 'thab/ phan tshun tshig rtsod dang bshad re byas pa'i don/kha gom che ba/ kha mkhas lce bde la kha shom can zer/kha so bags me/ so sgra thag thag byas pa la zer/kha gsad ngo bstod dam ngo dga' byed pa'i tshigakha basprus/ rdzun tshig dang g.yo sgyus mi bslus pa'i don/kha hub kyis tshig kha thug pas bsregs na a tsha med ces dpe zhigakhang gog khang rul lam khang rnying zhig po'i ming /khams klong thang sgrol ma/ ma 'brug mo dang gling gi dpa' brtul —17

che rgan dag gis mjal phyag byed sa'i lha khang zhig gi ming /khams 'dri byas/ 'byung khams 'dri ba'i gtam la zer/khams ma 'tsho/ sku ma bzhugs gshegs so zer skad/khams rong bo spang thang / stag gzig dang gling dkar gnyis kyi sa mtshams shig gi ming /khams gsum/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med khams so//khab 'dun ma/ gnyen sgrig gi bya ba la khab 'dun ma zer/ brda rnying ngo //khas 'ches/ khas blangs zer ba'i don/ / kham pa skya/ rta kham zhon pa'i skya mi la kham pa skya zer/khu 'phang / kha ba chung ngu ser ba lta bu'i ming /khu bo/ a myes yang myes sam a khu'i ming /khu bo dmar leb/ gling ge sar gyi sku spun rong tsha dmar leb la zer/khu bo spyi dpon/ khu bo a myes kyi don/ a skyes spyi dpon khra rgan gyi ming /khu byug gre 'gyur/ bya khu byug gi skad lta bu'i snyan zhing 'jebs pa la zer/khu tshan/ sha nye ring dang phu nu pha chan gyi ming /18

khu ye/ ba glang rwa med mgo ril la zer/khug rta/ bya kha la yug gi ming / char sdod bye'u yang zer/kher 'khyar/ kher 'khyams dang kher 'gro zer ba'i don/kher 'gro chig sdod/ gcig 'gro gcig 'dug zer ba'i don/kher 'gros/ grogs med gcig pur 'gro ba la zer/khe rting rul/ shing sdong gi rtsa ba rul ba'i don/khebs chen/ dpon dbang sdud can la khebs chen dpon zer/khebs gdan/ rta khebs zhes gdan gru bzhi ma'i ming /kho mo rog rdzong / stag rong khro thung gi rdzong gi ming /khog snying brdabs/ snying khong nas lding ba'i don/khog stod lha khang / lus kyi stod khog yangs pa lha khang gi gzugs su bkod/khong ne galu thog gling stag rong phyogs kyi dpa' rgod cig gi ming /khol byed/ g.yog po'i ming / g.yog byed pa la khol byed pa'ang zer/khol mo/ mgar ba'i yo byad dbugs sgam gyi ming / khol sgam yang zer ༈༄khrags dkar chab/ dar chags pa'i chu'i ming la zer/19

khyi kha ra mchu/ khyi yi kha dang ra ma'i mchu zhes shan pas gur dkar la mtshang 'bru byas pa'i gtam/khyi khar lag mgo khyi'i khar rang lag bzhag ces pa'i don/khyi gwa ba gzhug nag khyi thod dkar rnga nag zer ba'i don/khyi rgya bo/ khyi rgya rgyalam rgya dmar zer ba'i don/khyi ngan rengs pa/ khyi 'dris log can la zer bar snyam/khyi dom bu/ khyi nag po thong dkar la dom bu zer/khyi gda' li/ khyi ltogs kyi ming / rgyags med gda' ba khyi dang 'dra zer/ khyi nag nang 'dzeng / phyi dgra ma thub par nang 'khrugs byas pa'i don/khyi phag gnyis kyi mtshams/ khyi lo'i lo mjug dang phag lo'i lo mgo'i bar la zer/khyi phor/ khyi lto ldud spyad kyi khyi sko la zer/khyi dbyug khyi la deg nga/'i dbyug pa'i ming / khyu dbyug kyang zer/khyi mo tshang ro/ khyi mo tshang log ma la khyi mo tshang ro ma yang zer/khyi 'dzing / khyis rmug re 'cha' re byas pa'i don/khyi ra pa/ ri dwags pa'i ming la zer/khyi lag skya sug rgo mig khro thung gi mtshang ming / khyi'i lag pa/ skya ku'i sug thi/ rgo ba'i mig ces mtshang 'bru byas ba'i don/20

khri legs/ dzidar ma'i ming / khyi legs chung chung zer/khyi lud/ khyi skyag gi ming / khyi lud kyang zer/khri bsha' rgya ru/ gling gi mi dman zhol pa zhig gi ming /khyim sgo phug khyim gyi sgo kha dang phug tho gnyis la sgo phug zer/khrim sa bzung / gzhis khyim bzung ba'i don/ 'khor khyim bzubayang zer/khung dkar/ mdzo yi ming / khyung dkar mdzo yang zer khung chen zar 'dzing / khyung chen sder 'dzing zer ba yin/khung tor/ dbu rmog gi rtse mo'i rgod sgro dang zhwa tog gi ming /khung lding bsgrigs/ bya khrung khrung gi 'phur lding bsgrigs pa la zer/khung ri gnam rdzong / 'di yang gur dkar mkhar gyi ming grangs shigakhro shug zung / bza' mi gnyis zer ba'i don/kho ོtram̐ nga༄khu mkhar gnam rdzong / rong tsha khra rgan rgyal po'i mkhar rdzong gi ming /khra glag spyang gsum 'dzoms/ bu blo rig rtsal gsum mam bde myur can la zer/khra chung ling gis sgrib/ mig ling tog gis sgrib pa long ba'i don/21

khra chung a 'bras/ mig gi 'bras bu la a 'bras kyang zer/khra bo gzi/ gzi khra zhes rang byung gi rdo las grub pa'i rin po che zhigakhra bo'i ru 'dren/ dmag dpon gyi ming / ru 'dren ni dmag 'dren pa la zer/khra bo sha sha tshon po gzug gcig gi ming / sha gzug gcig zer/khra btsan zla ba/ hor gur dkar phyogs kyi dpa' brtul zhig gi ming /khra yag rdza/ ri mthon po g.ya' sha can la khra yag rdza zer/khra ring / mdung gi ming / mdung lcags dkris can la khra ring mdung zer/khra lag 'dzoms/ blo rig pa can la khra lag can zer sa yod/khrag gi tang lo/ khrag gi mar me zer ba'i don/ khrag gis brdzis 'dra/ dpa' bo'i ging / dpa' rgod khrag gis brdzis 'dra zer/khrag thaba.argyu/ legs sbyar skad/ khrag gi mchod yon zer ba'i don/khrag gi yur chu/ mi bsad drags pas khrag rka chu la drangs zer/khrag 'thung he ru ka / gling chos skyong ber nag gi srung ma gur mgon la zer/khrag mang zags/ khrag mang po bzhur zer ba'i don/21

khrag dmar shur rna/ khrag bzhur ba'i don/ khrag dmar tsar re yang zer/khrag zhag khrag mtsho'i ming / khrag la zhag chags pa'i don/khrag thor/ khrag dmar byugs pa'i gtor ma la zer/khrag ral can/ dbu skra dmar po la sgro btags nas khrag gi ral ba can zer/khrag jos bkang / khrag dang ro yis sa gzhi bkang zer ba'i don/ khrag lam 'then/ khrag bzhur nas lam 'then pa lta bu la zer/khrab dkar blog spul/ khrab dkar mo slog zul chad chad zer ba'i don/ khrab nag zil ba'i thog rdug gling seng chen gyi sku khrab kyi ming /khub rje nyi ma 'bum thub/ gru gu thog rgod rgyal po'i gung blon zhig gi ming / khrab byang / khrabakyi a long la khrab byang yang zer/khrab ma gnyis/ mi khrab gyon gnyis la khrab ma gnyis zer bar snyam/khram shing / dmod las byed tshe khram shing zhes shing byang zhig gi steng du ri mo 'di 'dra ma mabris pa la zer/khram ba/ g.yo sgyu can dang jag pa rkun ma'i ming /khri snyan sa le/ ri dwags legs po zhig gi ming /khri gdugs/ nyi ma'i ming / khri gdugs nyi ma yang zer/23

khri gdugs mdog gser mdangs nyi ma'i mdog lta bu la zer/khri gdugs brag rdzong / gling 'om bu'i a ne dpal seng gi rdzong la zer/khri gdug 'byon ran/ nyi ma 'char ran pa'i don la zer/khri mon/ btson khang gi ming la zer/khri btsan ri yag hor gur ser phyogs kyi dpa' rgod cig gi ming /khri ral/ mnga' bad ga khri ral ba can yin/khri shor rgyal mo/ mtsho sngon po'i ming / khri shog rgyal mo yang zer/khrims mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug srong btsan sgam po'i bcos khrims la'o//khrims yo gzur/ khrims mi drang ba'i nye ring ngam yo gzur byas pa la zer/khrims g.yo jog khrims srol drang bo min par g.yo sgyus khrims bca' ba la zer/khrims shing rtser skyon/ mi khrims la thogs tshe gsal shing gi rtse ru btesas pa'i don/khrung khrung mgul ring / bya khrung khrung mgrin ring la zer/khrums stod gla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla brgyad pa la zer/khres po/ khur bo'i ming / bud shing khres po gcig zer/khres po 'khur rogs/ khur bo 'khur grogs zer ba'i don/24

khro rgyal stobs po che/ gling ge sar gyis bdud 'dul skabs bsgrubs pa'i lha zhig gi ming /khro rgyal ber dmar can/ khro rgyal gos dmar can zer ba yin/khro thung yin par sems/khro chu khol ma/ khro lcags bzhus pa'i zhun chu tsha mo la zer/khro chu'i pha wang / khro lcags pha bong zer ba'i don yin par snyam/khro chen wa bse/ bon po'i lha mchog cig gi mtshan/khron pa/ chu mig gam lteng ka sogs kyi ming /khrom ra/ mi mang tshogs sa'am tshong ra lta bu yin/khrom zhog 'bum skyid/ ge sar rgyal po'i btsun mo ne'u bza' la zer/khrom srang / rgya srang ngam gzhung lam mi mang 'gro lam la zer/ dzārte—༄mkhan pa/ rtswa ldum zhig gi ming / mkhan dkar ni bsang rdzas shig kyang yin/mkhan po/ bla ma sogs la 'dogs pa'i chos ming zhigamakha' 'gro sde lnga/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin 4chen mkha' 'gro/ pamamakha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'o//mkha' 'gro seng gdong / seng ge'i gdong ba can gyi mkha' 'gro 25

zhig gi ming /mkha' lding ga ru ṭa/ bya rgyal khyung gi ming / ga ru ṭa legs sbyar skad/ bod skad du bsgyur na khyung gi ming /mkha' lding mig sgrib/ stag ro nga khro thung gi gdams ngag/ cig gi ming /mkhar gong / rdo dkar mkhar gong zer ba'i rdo zhig gi ming /mkhar gyang hrul bo/ mkhar kyang zhig po la zer/mkhar thang rdzong 5ring mo/ dpa' dmu spyang rin chen dar lu'i rdzong /mkhar mi 'gyur pho brang stag rtse/ sga skya lo'i ston pa rgyal mtshan —gyi rdzong /mkhar spug po lcags dkris/ dpa' seng stag a dom gyi btsan rdzong /mkhur tshos/ 'gram pa'i mkhur ba'i ming /mkhal zho/ mkhal ma zho sha zer ba'i sman zhig gi ming /ḍa 4r+shaṣe—ra 'khar ja gsang ba 'brug grags/ gling gi khrims rnga zhig gi ming /'khar gsil/ dge slong gi yo byad cig la zer/26

'khums pa/ bsad pa'am bkums pa'i don/'khor lo lnga/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo/ lte ba sprul ba'i 'khor lo/ gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo'o//'khor sa/ gnas sa 'bab sa'i don la zer/'khor gsum/ dpa' bo'i drag chas mda' mdung ral gri sogs — la 'khor gsum zer/'khos chung / mi rgyu mid gnyom chung nus med la zer/khoshārnyi༄'khyag dkar bcag 'phro/ dar bcag 'phro la zer/ dar la chab rom yang zer/'khyir/ bya tshig ste bskor ba'i don/ gdugs bskor ba la gdugs 'khyir zer/'khyil rogs gser sprul/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i dgra lha zhig gi ming /159 zhakhru—༄'khreng ba/ zhe chags pa'am sems 'khreng ba'i don/'khren pa/ chags zhen che ba'i brda rnying / khyim la 'khren/ 27

( —— 4—rakyig ne goms pa/ gling spyi dpon rong tsha khra/ ca/na gyi ming /ga bur dbang bo/ zla ba'i ming / ga bur 'dzin yang zer/ga ma bong / bong bu'i ming / bong bu nga/ ma'ang zer/ga zha/ gad mo'i ming ha ha zhes pa'i don/ga la bar/ mdun du'am drung du zer ba'i don/ga le khad kyi/ thugs ma brel zer ba'i brda/ga la gu ces/ brel mo'i ldog phyogs dal ba'i brda/ga ler phebs/ dal bar phebs zer ba'i don/gag pa/ khyim bya'i ming / bya gag gi skad brda gtong dus zer/gāṅga/ rgya gar gyi chu chen zhig gi ming /gang bdog gang yod tshad zer ba'i don/gang ba bzang po/ gnod sbyin zhig gi ming / gnod sbyi'o/ gang ba bzang bo zer/gang zag sems ldan rmi la zer/gangs dkar lding la/ deng dus ldang la che tso nga zer ba de e yin the)mab//gangs rgan/ gangs te se lta bu la dpe sbyar/gangs can/ kha ba can te bod yul la zer/28

gangs pa bod/ gangs can bod ze ra ba dang don gcigargangs 'dres/ gangs ri dang rdza ri 'dres mtshams zer ba'i don/gangs zhabs su song / kha bas 'og tu mnan pa la zer/gangs ri khol dum/ gangs la mda' brgyab te khol khol dum dum du gtor ba'i don/gad rgyangs/ bzhad gad chen po'i ming / gad rgyangs sgrog pa'ang zer/gad pa chu rdzong / hor gling gi sa mtshams shig gi ming /gad mo 'ba' tshag mi mang bgad nas sgra skad di ri ri'i don/gan rkyal/ kha yar bltas sgal nyal byas pa la zer/gar rkyal du mnan/ phyir sgal du mnan pa la zer/gan rgya/ yid ches pa'i thel tham can gyi yi ge la zer/gan mdzod/ mdzod khang gi ming / rnam sras gan mdzod zer/gan snyo la/ lha khang ngam gtsug lag khang gi ming /gab khungag sbas sa skung sa la gab khung yang zer/gab nas brnad/ lkog tu bskungs nas bsdad pa'i don/bakhasatshig gzhan gyis rtogs mi rung ba'i gsang tshig la gab tshig ——kyang zer/ gab rtse/ gdan brtsegs mtho dman ran pa la zer/29

gar chang / 'bras chang la gar chang zer bar snyam/gar 'dzing ci cha med/ gang dang gang la 'dzing ba'am khro ba la nges pa med pa'i don/gal 'gag gal che sa'am gnad che sa/gal bo che/ don gnad chen po la zer/ga ra btsogs/ rgya'am rnyi btsugs/ pa'i don/gal la thug gu thug gam sdug thug pa'i don/gas sru ba/ gos kha'am srub kha zer zhig ral gyi ming /ging pho/ g.yog po'i ming ste brda rnying /ging mo/ g.yog mo'i ming ste brda rnying /gu gu rta/ khro thung gi rta gu gu rog po zhes pa'i rta nag cig la zer/gu gu rog cog stag rong khro thung gi zhon rta'i ming /gu ne g.yer mo thang / a mdo'i sa na g.yer mo thang zer ba de —ngos 'a dzin par sems/gu yangs/ sems rgya che ba'am gu dog po min pa'i don/gu yangs gnam gyi rgyal po/ stag zhu gur dkar rgyal po'i ming /gu ru/ legs sbyar skad/ bsgyur na bla ma yin/gu ru rdo rje gro lod/ gu ru mtshan brgyad nang gi ming gcigagu re rog chung / stag gzig gi ri ming zhig la zer/ gung thun/ dgung thun te nam gung gi thun pa'i ming 30

gung blon/ nang blon gyi ming ste/ gung dang bka' blon zhes pa'i bsdus tshig dgung blon yang zer/ gung za/ seng ge'i ming la zer/gum pa/ shi ba'i ming / shi ba la gum pa zer/ gur dkar skyengs/ gur dkar ya nga ba'am ngo tsha bar zer/gur dkar skun sha bskung / gur dkar dong du sbas nas rkun mas rkun sha sbed sbed zer bas dma' 'bebs kyi gtam/gur dkar sgal bshu/ gur dkar sgal shun bshu dgos zer/gur dkar byur 'dre/ phung 'dre'am gnod 'dre gyod sems can la zer/gur khang / sbra gur ram khang pa rlum po la yang gur khang zer/gur mgon/ chos skyong zhig gi mtshan la zer/gur dang ka cha/ gur dang yo byad zer/ ka cha yo byad la zer/gur b.ribs/ gur 'gyel ba'am log pa la zer/gur la gri shan byas/ gur la ral gris brgyab pa la gri shan zer/49rna srub med/ hor gur dkar la gur chen srub med zer ba'i bzhugs gur zhig yod pa de la zer/tha sartag gus sbyor dang rtag sbyor zer ba yin/ge thung rgyal po/ stag rong khro thung gi ming la ge thung yang zer/ge je bud/ dmag mang nang nas krong nger ram lhang nger bud pa'i 31

don/ge re langs/ mi gcig pu yar langs pa'i don/ kher langs sam ger langs yang zer/ge sar byes nas byon/ ge sar phyi rol nas thon zer/ byes ni yul gzhan la zer/ger thub gar ba skya ring / stag gzig gi dpa' bo zhig gi ming — la zer/ger 'tsho gnyan po/ gling gis bsten pa'i lha srung zhig gi ming /ger re sdug gcig pu sdug pa'i don yin par sems/gel ba/ shing gi yal ga'am shing thur la'o//go bkrag go mtshon gyi 'od 'phro ba la zer/go kha/ khyim du bza' ba 'du sa'i khor yug la go kha zer/go khrab kyis ma brtan/ khrab rmog phub gsum gyis mtshon sne la brtan pa'i don/go rgan lding shes/ stag rong khro thung gi zhon rta zhig gi ming la zer/go rgyab pa/ khrab rmog gyon pa dang 'khor gsum btags pa la go rgyab zer/go bgos pa/ dmag mang phyogs phyogs su skor khag bgos pa la zer/go sngon can/ go khrab sngon po can la go sngon can zhes tshig sna bsdus 32 ོ

pa yin/go bo rus mid/ bya rgan go bos rus pa mid payorus mid zer/sga ma chod/ so khrab mda' mtshon gyis ma phig pa la rgo ma chod zer/go mtshon sna dgu/ khrab rmog phub/ mda' mduX ral gri/ zhags pa star chen mdung thung sogs so//go mdzod/ mtshon cha dang go khrab 'jog sa'i khang pa la go mdzod —zer/go bzung / dmag sna dmag gis bathung ba la go bzung zer/go ro bra rgyab/ stag gzig gi sa ming zhig la zer/go li bsgag stag gzig rgyal po'i mtshang ming zhig go gsar gyon/ khrab rmog gsar gyon dag la zer/go gsum gyi thal/ go kha gsum gyi thal ba ster zhes dmod tshig4 themago lag mtshon cha'am me mda' sogs la'o//go hrags/ mtshon cha sra ba'am mkhregs po la zer/gog po/ lus rgas 'khogs sam khang rul rnying ba lta bu zer/gong khri/ bla ma dang rgyal po'i bzhugs khri la zer/gong ba len mi/ ngo ya 'bud mi'am 'gran ya byed mi zer/gong thog dngos po khyad 'phags can la zer/ gom lob byas/ le lo byas pa'i don la zer/gor ma/ rdo yi ming gor ma rdo ther/

gol ba/ 'chub/ rnga/'a ming / lam 'chug pa la lam gol ba'ang ther /thos chu zi dmar po/ gos chen dmar po'i ming la zer/gos chen mang ma/ po/sa mang nag zer ba'i don yin par sems/bos nang sha can/ gos nang ma can zer ba yin/gos yug gcig gos bubs gcig gi don/gob/ hrul/ gos ngan chad po'am gyon gos rnying ba la zer/gwa ba glang mgo mthing gi lha srung glang bo gdong dkar la zer/gwa'u/ dngul las bzos pa'i gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan/ga'u gser rdzong / dpa' bo chos lu dar 'phen gyi btsan rdzong la zir/kho8 4 ༄ gya chu'i 'gros/ 'bab chu'am sbrul gnyis la zer/gya gyu'i tshig tshig mi drang ba dang mi bden pa'i don/gya rta/ sa tsha sar skyes pa'i shing zhig gi ming /gya chom pa/ zas nor longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i don/gya tshom/ ma brtags pas bya ba byed pa'i don/gyag klo ga lam gyag gyog dang bya ba nyog rdzab la zer/gyang gog khang ngarnying ba la gog po yang zer/gyad kyi ba bo/ shugs chen gyad kyi do ya la ya bo'am ya bu zer/34

rgud thabs mkhan/ lus rtsal dang shugs rtsal byed thabs mkhan/gyad rdo/ gyad mis 'gyog pa'i rdo la gyad rdo zer/gyad mi/ mi shugs chen stobs can la gyad mi zer/gyad mi thang la brnabs/ gyad dmag mtshon khas shi ba la zer/gyad mi bzhi sdeb/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i zla bral gyad mi bzhi — la zer/gyam kha/ chu'i gram kha la zer/ skad gsar bcad ma byas gong gyam pa zer gyal rgyal/ rkang ba mi drang ba'i 'theng rkang can la zer/gyi na ba gsum/ mi dman pa'am dbul bo gsum zer ba'i don/gyi ling / rta mchog gi ming la zer/gyen sdog 'bangs kyis gong rim la ngo ya byas par zer/klo dum/ mkhar zhig ro'i gyo mo chag dum can la zer/klong gud/ dngos po chud zos su btang ba la zer/klod gzhi/ rtsod pa'i gzhi slong mkhan la zer/gyol thang can/ rkang ba 'theng rkang can la gyol bo zer/9ོtram̐ng—༄ gra ma bcag spu rtse ma brlags sam spu mgo ma bcag zer ba'i don/gra mi 'grigs/ dper na wa lpags khyi lpags gnyis lhan gcig tu 35

sbyar na gra mi 'grigs zer ba lta bu'o//grag tshad/ sgra grag tshad sod sod rgyob rgyob zer/grags yer che/ snyan pa'i grags skad che ba la zer/grang la bsil/ tsha ba'i dus su grang bsil ldan pa la zer/grang lhags/ grang rlungabaser bu'i ming la zer/grab mtshungs/ rta gcig 'dra/ khrab rmog gcig 'gral zer/grabs bshom/ sta gon dang gra sgrig byed pa'i don/gram rdo/ gram kha'i rdo 'dra zhes mang po'i dpe/gral gong / gral 'go'am gral gong ma zer ba'i don/gral mtha'/ gral mjug gam gral rnga'i don/gral tshes/ da kur phyogs zla stod la zer/gral 0/ra gshags/ gral dkyil nas mi yar 'ded mar 'ded zer ba'i don/gri 'gram g.yug mi'i gam du bcar nas gri g.yug pa'i don/gri 'thab byas/ phar tshur gris rgyag res byas pa la zer/gri ya zi skam phran/ gling rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi ral gri'i ming /gri la /theb ngar byas/ gri kha'i rno rtul la mtheb reg byas pa la —zer/gri la mos/ gri la dad dang gri la dga' ther ba'i don/gri rub/ mi gcig gi steng du gri mang pos brgyab pa la gri rub theraka36

gri'i dakha' 'apa/ ral gri'i yu bar dar btags pa la dpa' lung zer/ grib so gug dgung phyi dro'i nyi ma la mgor yol tshe grib chen gug pa la zer glu gu/ skud pa bsgril ba'i gong bu'i ming dang byang gru gu'i yul gyi ming /gru gu'i dkar mo gnyen rdzong / byang gru gu'i thog rgod rgyal po'i mkhar rdzong la zer gru gu'i ge sar/ byang gru gu'i thog rgod rgyal po'i mtshan/gru mdung gis brgyab/ lag pas gru tshigs brgyab pa la gru mdung gis brgyab zer/spru btsas pa/ mnyan pa'am chu ba'i ming la zer/gru 'dzin/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas po ta la la zer/gru shan/ gzings dang ko gru lta bu'i ming /grub chen pa/ mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'am rdzu 'phrul ston nus pa la ther /grub chen sa ra ha/ rgya gar gyi grub chen brgyad cu'i thog ma'i ming /bod skad du ngasgyur na mda' bsnun zer/grub pa rgyal mo'i tshe mdud/ grub pa rgyal mo gling rag lha mo zhig gi mtshan/ des gnang ba'i rang lus sru/nga nus pa'i mdud pa la tshe mdud zer/37

grum pa'i thur ma/ ri dwags grum pa'i rtsi ba rus la zer bar snyam/grul bum/ yi dwags kyi gras su gtogs pa'i rigs shigagre khung chud pa/ mid thag gi phugs su bcugs pa'i don/gre 'gyur/ skad snyan po la gre 'gyur can yang ther/gre ba gseng / skad gdangs bsgrags pa la zer/gre mdzub byas/ mid thag nang du mdzub mo btang ba la ther/gro bo jam chen/ hor gyi sa ming zhig la zer/gro bzhin zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla bdun pa la zer/grog tshang brdol/ mi mang grog ma'i tshang brdol 'dra zer ba'i dpe la sbyar/grog tshang bye 'thor/ grog tshang bye ma'i phung bo gtor gtor zer ba'i don/gros che tsacha mi rta gyong gud che tsam byung ba'e don la zer/ gros kyi blo ya/ gros kyi 'dri ya'am gros kyi kha ya ther/ gros ra/ gros tshogs byed sa'i 'du ra'i ming /gros mol/ gros bsdur bgyid pa'i don/grwa sa/ dgon pa'i ming / grwa sa yang zer/ḍa rge༄— ༄ gla gos ma reg gla gos ma gyon pa'i don yin par sems/38

gla po rog po/ gla rtsi 'dzin pa'i gla pho'i ming /gla ba 'dzin pa'i rgya/ ri dwags gla ba 'dzin byed kyi rgya 'am rnyi la —zer/glag mo mkhal dkar/ bya glag mkhal ma'i thad na dkar thig can la glag mo mkhal dkar zer/glag mo khra 'bar/ hor gur nag phyogs kyi dmag dpon zhig gi ming /glag rog mo/ ri bong dang lu gu gsod mkhan gyi bya glag la zer/glags ma khel/ gnod pa byed ma nus pa la glegs ma rnyed dam ma khel zer/glagabasashig 'tshol dgos/ gnod skyon zhig byed dgos zhes pa'i don/ glang rgan ber gas bzhud/ glang rgan dbyug pas brdungs zer ba'i don/glang chen khar 'bebs/ chu bo gārgo'i ming la zer/rmang chung gnya' khra/ glang chung gnya' ba khra khra can la zer/spang chen 'gying rdzong / shar smug gu nyi ma btsan rgyal gyi mkhar rdzong gi ming /glang chen sna zhags/ glang bo che'i ming / sna ring bas sna zhags zer 39

zang gnya'/ hor gur dkar la zer/ gnya' ba ha cang sbom nas chags glang lta bu red ces mtshang ming btags pa red/glang gdong / dbang phyu4/ gi bu che ba tshogs bdag yin par snyam/glang rog nag glang bo nas/ po la glang rog kyang zer/glang shad dmar po/ chags glang ngam glang thug la zer/glang hrul/ gling thug chen po la glang hrul lam glang 'khogs zer/glal ba/ kha gdangs pa'i don/ glal ba'am g.yal ba'ang zer/gling dam/ra ya bdag gling gi mgo dpon dang mgo bdag zer ba'i don/gling ga skyed mos tshal dang khrus la 'jug sa'i chu rdzing sogs la'o//gling gi chags chen mi bzhi/ spyi dpon khra rgan/ seng la ri skyes/skya lo'i ston pa rgyal ma tshan/ stag rong khro thung ngo //gling gi bu spug gwa ba/ hor gyis rgya tsha la gdong gwa le zhes ngan ming btags/gling gi byad kha/ gling byad kha phur kha zer ba'i mthu dmod mo'i ming /gling gi 6ga nu/ gling gi bu chung zer/ brda rnying la a nu zer/gling chos la 'phan/ gling dkar mes po khra rgan rgyal po'i yapa kyi mtshan/gling rje mi yi nyi ma/ gling rje ge sar rgyal po la zer/40

gling bu/ sgyug mas bzos pa'i 'phred gling lta bu 'a zer/gling bzhi/ shar lus 'phags gling / sto 'dzam bu gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan no//gling bzhi'i lte ba/ gling bzhi chags pa'i lte ba ri rab lhun po la zer/gling sa mthong ba kun smon/ sa dngul ri'i phyogs dang rma chu'i g.yas g.yon la zer/gling ru/ gling dmag zer ba'i don/ brda rnying la dmag la ru bzhi'ang zer/ gling ru'i dpon chen bzhi/ dgra lha rtse rgyal/ gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar yag stag rong gzig 'phen/ chos lu dar 'phen/gling ru btsan po/ gling dmag btsan po zer ba'i don/gling la zhe sha gnag gling la kha nag zhe nag bzung zer ba'i don/glu skyor med/ glu la ram 'degs dang skyor grogs med pa'i don/glu 'ani 'dra bzhengs/ glu 'di 'dra blangs zer ba'i don/glud du song / glud du song ni tshab tu song ba'i don/ sku glud la song zer/glud la rdzongs/ tshab tu gtong ba'am tshab tu phul ba'i don la zer/glegs pu/ glegs bam chung ngu'i ming la zer/glegs bam/ chos kyi ming / chos glegs bam mam po ti'ang zer/41

gleng tshod med/ bshad tshod gtam/ tshod med zer ba'i don/gleng blong mang po/ gros mol dang gros bsdur mang po zhes pa'i don/glen skugs/ glen pa'am skugs pa'i ming la zer/blo gor hon/ gnag phyugs kyi nad kyi ming / gor dang glo nad hon nad sogs la zer/klo gri/ glo la 'dogs pa'i gri la glo gri zer/spo rgyag glo bur ram myur du zer ba'i don la 'jug9 darge —༄ dbang to sdug to/ dga' 'am sdug gam zhes dri ba'i don la 'jugadaga' ldan/ rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po'i zhing khams la zer/chedaga' bo 'jog po/ klu'i rgyal po gnyis kyi mtshan la zer/dga' bde/ dga' ba dang bde ba'i don/ tshig sna bsdus pas dga' bde zer/dga' 'bri ldong gsum/ bod kyi gdung byung ba'i rus ming gsum gyi ming /dga' rab dbang phyug bdud dga' rab dbang phyug yin par sems/dga' le 'khyil le/ dga' dga' spro spro zer ba'i don/dgu phrugs/ phyag dgu phrugs su 'tshal/ dgu gsum la dgu phrugs 42

zer/dgu mig gsum pa/ sme ba dgu'i nang gi re'u mig gsum pa gsum mthing la zer/dgu tshigs/ gnam gyi sgal ba'am gnam gyi ska rags kyang zer/dgung skeg lo skeg zla skeg zer ba'i lo'i 'tshubs cha che ba la zer/dgung stong lam/ nam mkha' stong ba'i lam la zer/dgun gyi lhags pa/ dgun gyi grang rlung la lhags rlung yang zer/dgun ra ba/ lugs rnying gi hor zla bcu ba la zer/dgun gsum/ lugs rnying zla bcu ba bcu gcig pa bcu gnyis pa gsum la zer/dgun gsum sha mgo sha mgo sha khral la zer/ dgun gsum sha khral blangs pa la zer/dge skul/ dgon pa'i sgrig khrims kyi bdag po'i ming /dge bcu/ mi dge bcu'i ldog phyogs dge bcu zer/dge bcu'i nyi ma/ dge ba bcu'i dge mtshan nyi ma'i gzugs su bkod do//dge ma/ dge ba sgrub mkhan jo mo lta bu la zer/dgo ru rwa rtse/ ri dwags dgo ba'i rwa las bzos pa'i du ba 'thenaspyad kyi ming / dgong ja kha/ phyi dro'i dgong ja skabs zhes pa'i don/ kha ni dus 43

la 'jugadagong nyi ma'i grib so chu khar/ dgong phyi dro'i nyi grib chu khar phog pa'i tshad bstan/dgongs khrel med pa/ thugs mi dgyes pa med pa zer ba'i don/dgongs pa khad kyis/ thugs bsam dal bar thongs zer ba'i don/ dgongs pa gting nas 'a khyags/ thugs brgyal gting nas —snyebazhengs zer ba'i don/dgongs pa ma tshom/ thugs khrel ma mdzad zer ba'i don/da god brgyal/ dgod kha shor drags nas brgyal ba la zer/dgon gnas/ 'brog gnas sam dben gnas la zer/dgon dung can/ rtswa med chu med mya ngam thang lta bu la zer/dpo/sa dogs med/ dogs dgos don ci yang med zer ba/khordokhro༄dgra mgo rdog pas mnan/ dgra mgo rkang paca/ brdzis pa la zesadagra slo rgyag tu byung / dgra klo bur du byung zer ba la glo rgyag tu byung yang zer/dgra chen bzhi/ bdudo/ hor/ 'jang / mon bzhi la zer/dgra ltag gcog dgra mgo bcom zer ba'i don/44

dgra phar brgyab/ dgra phar bsad zer ba'i don/dgra bla g.yu 'drug sngon mo/ gling ge sar skyobs pa'i dgra bla zhig gi ming /dgra bla'i bsdong chen/ bse mkhar dang lab brtsas sogs la zer/dgra zun/ dgra dang gnyen gnyis la dgra zun zer/dgra la mgo 'bul/ dgra la mgo skur ba la zer/dgra la pyag rgya bca' ba/ dgra la thal mo sbyar ba'i don/dgra la sang thug nangs thug dgra la nang thug dgung thug zer —ba'i don/dgra sha pha/ sdang dgra bo zer ba dang don mthun/dgra sha phas mthong na/ sdang dgra bos rig na zer ba'i don/dgra lha ma thad/ dgra lha rtse rgyal ma bu gnyis la ma smad kyang zer/dgra lha rtse rgyal/ gling rgya tsha dbon gyi bu thu bo la zer/dgra lha'i tshems gos/ mtshon cha 'gog nus pa'i khrab lta bu'i gosazhig la tshems gos zer/dgra lha'i tshogs su rdol/ dgra lha'i tshogs kyis bzhes zer ba'i don/ngadornyi༄dkyis dgyes mdzad/ dga' dga' spro spro byas pa'i don/45

dgyes pasarta 'al bstan/ dga' bas gdong bstan zer ba'i don/dgyes 'dzum/ dga' bas 'dzum mdangs bstan pa la zer/ḍa rnorge— )mgar thel rkang gcig hor mgar ba'i bsten lha the'u rang rkang gcig la zer/mgar dbang phyug mgar gyi rgyud pa gling gi dmag dpon zhi ga gi ming /mgar ba'i bu dod/ mgar ba'i bu skal lam bu tshab zer ba'i don/mgar bza' chos sgron/ hor mgar ba'i bu mo la zer/ ge sar gyi ja ma'i gras yin/mgur dom/ rta ske dang mdzo ske la btags pa'i rtsid dom dmar po la mgur dom zer/mgul gwa'u ma mo'i bla rdo/ gling seng chen gyi mgul rgyan gwa'u'i ming la zer/mgul gwa'u nor bu 'od 'bar/ rin thang gzhal du med pa'i nor bu'i mgul rgyan zhig la'o//mgul rgyan/ rin po che dang g.yu byu ru'i ske rgyan la zer/mgul g.yu/ mgu'/ du 'dogs pa'i g.yu drug dkar zhig la zer/mgo ske phrad/ mabo/ ske breg zer bar snyam/46

༄mgo skyes/ skra'i ming / mgo skyes nag snum lan bu zer/mgo dkar shi spur/ na chung sngon du shi bas rgan rgon rjes su lus pa la mgo dkar shi skyur zer/mgo chung / yang shed can gyi mi la mgo yang ngam mgo chung zer/mgo mnug khur mid/ mgo rnga ma bltas par mid pa la zer/mgo dung phor/ mgo'i klad rus sam klad phor la zer/mgo 'bul/ mgo btags lus 'bul la mgo 'bul yang zer/mgo gtsug sgro can/ rma bya'i ming / gtsug sgro can yang zer/mgo 'tsho dka'/ mgo thon dka' ba'am mgo khebs dka' ba la zer mgo rdzi/ sde 'go 'dzin pa'i 'go dpon lta bu la zer/mgo lar mi theg mgo bo yar mi 'khyogs pa la mi theg zer/mgo yung rdog breg pa/ mgo ske la phug breg pa ltar zer ba'i don/mgo galu ral can/ seng ge'i ming / seng g.yu ral can yang zer/mgo ril/ mi ral ba med pa'i mgo rdo la mgo ril yang zer/mgo ru thur med/ mgor rwa co med pa zer ba'i don/mgo'i la thod/ mgo ras kyis dkris pa'i ming / la thod dang dar 4 thod kyang zer/mgo se/ mgo skra'i dkar nag 'dres pa la mgo se zer/mgon gang ba bzang bo/ lug lha'i ming / gnod sbyim zhig la 47

zer/mgon thub pa/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la zer/mgon po pyag drug chos skyong zhig gi mtshan la zer/mgon tshe dpag med/ mgon po tshe dpag med ces tshe lha zhig gi ming /mgyogs bul/ mgyogs bul ni dal mgyogs la zer/ bul ni dal ba'o//ḍa rdornyi )mgrin rgyan/ ske rgyan dang mgul rgyan zhes rgyan cha'i ming /mgrin bcu/ srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu'i ming /mgrin bzang / bong bu'i ming / mngon brjod du mgrin bzang zer/mgrin ring / rnga mong dang khrung khrung la zer/ 'di nas rnga mong la'o//mgron gnyer/ mgron du bsu ba'am mgron po'i sne len pa la zer dzārno༄'gangs chen/ rten khams chen 'gangs chen zer ba'i don/'gug kyu/ lcags kyu'i ming / sa cha la las 'gug kyu'ang zer/48

'go snam/ phrug ma ras 'dra ba zhig gi ming la zer/'go ba'i lha lnga/ yul lha/ pha lha/ ma lha/ dgra lha/ srog lha'o//'go gco/ 'go 'dren nam 'go dpon la zer/'gog bden/ sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung spangs pa la 'gog bden zer/'go mo'i spang spug jo ru'i ming la zer/ dgra pha rol pas ngan smras byas pa red/'gog tsha jo ru/ gling ge sar chung dus kyi mtshan la zer/'gong bo/ mi ma yin pa'i the'u rang lta bu la zer/'gongs mi rung / tshad las 'da' mi rung ba'i don la'o//'gol sa/ mi khyi'i skad mi thos pa'i gnas dben pa'i ming /'gos rdo rje rnam rgyal/ gtsang g.yas ru'i dmag dpon zhig gi ming /khodzārnyi༄'gying rigs gangs seng / 'gying rogs gangs seng dkar mo zhes seng chen gyi dgra lha zhig la'o//'gyur khug glu blangs tshe skad snyan po 'gyur bag can la zer/'gyur ldog ye ma mchis/ 'gyur ldog gtan nas ma yod zer ba'i don/

'gyur ro cog lo tsā bas chos bsgyur pa thams cad la 'gyur ro cog zer/'phyogs ste gas/ yar 'gyogs pa'i ldem shing la zer/7——r+shagre ༄'gram g.yas dkar rtsi byugs/ 'gram pa g.yas su dkar rtsi byugs pa'i don/'gram bcar ba/ gdong thug ma/sa gri 'thab byas pa la 'gram bcar zer/bgram pa sbyar/ mgul du 'khyud nas 'gram pa sbyar ba la zer/'gram chu ldang / zas za 'dod skyes nas kha nang du chu ldang ba'i don/'gran pa'i zla bral/ sus kyang 'gran pa'i zla med zer ba'i don/'gran med rgyal po/ gling seng chen rgyal po la zeng/'phre 4ldog rta bong gis 'gyel log brgyab pa'i ming /'gro khams/ 'gro ba yod do cog la zer/'gro rgyal mtshan seng ge bod mnga' bdag gdan khri rgyal po'i nang blon zhig gi ming /'gro sdod/ 'gro 'dug zer ba dang don gcig go/'gro ba rigs drug dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha mi lha min no//50

'gros ldan/ rta gom pa can gyi ming / 'gros ldan rta pho zer/'gros mang ba/ gom 'gros mang po zer ba'i don/ 7/༄rga gi zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla bcu gcig pa la zer/rgan byis/ rgan pa dang byis pa gnyis zer ba'i don/rgab rgab rgyug rab be rab be rgyug zer ba yin par sems/rgal spul/ rta rgyab thed dang rgal rul can zer ba'i don/rgas 'khogs/ lo lon rgan rgon la zer/rgyan dkar/ rgun 'brum dkar po la rgun dkar zer/ rgun chang / rgun 'brum las bzos pa'i chang la zer/rgod rgod kher 'gro/ dpa' rgod kher 'gro byas pa'i don/rgod rgod mang / bu rgod rta rgod mang po zer ba'i don/rgod thang spug bya rgod kyi rigs shig la zer/rgod po klu bdud ram/ mthing g.yul ral rgyal po'i 'gran zla med pa'i dpa' bo zhigargod tshang kha g.yer/ hor gyi sa ming zhig la zer/ r+shang༄ tha rgyag la mo/ rta la sga myur du rgyob zer ba'i don/ 51

sga cha kha tshang / sga dang glo rmen/ srab dang srab mda' srab skyob/sa sogs la zer/sga cha sprad/ sga srab sprad pa'i don la zer bar snyam/sga bde'i spyogs rdo/ gling sga bde chos skyo nga gi 'phen rdo la zer/sga 'phreng / rta thog nas lag 'dzing byed pa'i don la zer/sga ru shog kha/ gling sga bde'i dmag ru'i shog kha zer/lga tshag grug ge ra/ dmag rta sogs gra sgrig legs po byas pa'i don/sga lhu bzhi/ rta sga cha tshang ba zhig la zer/sga 'i snga ru/ rta sga'i sngon la snga ru zer/sga'i phyi ru/ rta sga'i rjes la phyi ru zer/lgang gi grib so/ phyi dro'i ri sgang gi grib so la zer/sgang zung la btsas/ sgang gnyis kyi so ba zer ba'i don/sgang gsho nga / ri'i sgang dang lung ba'i gshong la sgang gshong zer/sgab khung 'dar/ rkang pa'i sgyid khung 'dar ba la zer/tham po/ thugs mkhas pa'am dgongs zab che ba la zer/lgam barming / thugs dgongs zab mo brtan brjid che ba'i don/sgar bkod gnang / dmag bkod 'then pa la sgar bkod kyang zer/rgar mkhris/ dmag sgar gyi thag nye sar bsdad pa la mkhris su bsdad zer/52

thar dpon/ bla ma'i sgar dpon dang ru dmag gi dpon po la sgar dpon zer/rgal rnag sgal tshigs nang gi sgal rnag la zer/skul bskyongag g.yo ba'am 'gul ba'i don la zer/ zheg chos/ mdzes pa'i rgyan cha la sgeg chos zer theg 'chang ma/ mdzes sdug ldan pa'i na chung ma la zer/sger ru 'bum tsho/ zur dmag 'bum tsho zer ba'i don/ sgo rgya/ sgo la thel tse btab pa'am mtshams tho bzhag pa la zer/sgo gyad kyis bcag sgo chen gyad dmag gis bcag pa'i don/sgo 'gog sgo srung gi dmag la sgo 'gog kyang zer/sgo them/ sgo'i stegs bu'am them skas la zer/sgo'i mkhris su thon/ sgo'i 'gram du thon zer ba lags/ sgo zhol/ sgo 'og gam sgo'i mar bsham zer ba'i don/ sgo la rdog tho btang / sgo la rkang thes brgyab zer ba'i don/sgo gsum/ lus ngag yid gsum la zer/sgo bzhir so dang rkang rgya btsugs/ sgo bzhir so ba nyul ma bzhag zer ba yin par snya ma/sgong sgong / 'ba' 'bur ril ril zer ba'i don/sgom grwa/ dgon sde che chung la sgom grwa zer/sgom chen 'phyi ba/ rtswa gzan 'phyi ba la zer

|༄ ༄rgya skyegs khu ba/ shing tshos/ dmar po zhig la zer/rgya kha rgod reg shes/ gling ma sru mdzangs ma zhig gi ming /rgya khrab chu le tshem/ rgya yis bzos pa'i go khrab zhig la zer/rgya gri mya zi skam phran/ gling rgya tsha'i ral gri skam phran gyi ming /rgya gling drug 'gyur/ smyug gling bu ga drug can la gling bu drug 'gyur zer/rgya gram sa/ rdo rje rgya gram lta bu'i sa'i chags dbyibs la zerargya tong khun/ rgya nag spyi'i ming / tong khun nam stong khun yang zer/rgya dug ha la/ rgya dug nag po zer/ ha la nag po'i don/rgya nag zhing sa/ da lta'i bshad srol yin na zhing chen zer ba 'dra/rgya phrug sro ma badz+ra/ rgya'i yul nas 'khyams pa'i bu chung zhig gi ming /rgya 'bras dkar mo/ rgya nang nas thon pa'i 'bras dkar la zer/rgya dmar tsug ge gdong la dmar mdangs rgyas pa la zer/rgya tsug tsug 'grarmo ra gzengs shing ngo mdangs dmar ba la zer/rgya tsha stangs tshul/ rgya tsha'i brtul zhugs dpa' nyams la zer/rgya tsha bu ro gwa glen/ phyi dgras gling rgya tsha la glen pa gdong dkar 54

zhes ngan bshad byas pa red/rgya tsha zhal dkar/ rgya'i tsha bo yin pas rgya tsha zer/ gdong dkar bas zhal dkar zer/rgya tsha har gyis bzhings/ rgya tsha glo bur yar bzhengs zer ba'i don/ rgya mtsho brdol/ rgya mtsho 'phyur ba ltar zer ba'i don/rgya mtsho lud pa/ rgya mtsho yar 'phyur ba la lud pa zer/rgya mtsho'i gos can/ sa gzhi'i ming / mngon brjod kyi ming /rgya rdzong nags/ nags rdzong ha cang stug po rgya che ba la zer/rgya bza' lha dkar/ rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi ma yum gyi mtshan/rgya la de 'dra/ gal te de 'dra zer ba'i don lags/rgya snyo khri bu yi stag mig mon shing khri rgyal po'i dmag dpon zhig gi ming /rgya a zi'i bu mo ga zi/ stag zhu gur dkar rgyal po'i btsun mo snga ba'i ming /rgyags dum/ bro kha bro chas sogs kyi ming la zer/rgyang grags can/ grags snyan ha cang che la phyogs gang gis go ba la zer/rgyal po thugs tshom/ sems la dogs pa skyes pa'am the tshom skyes pa'i don/55

rgyal po sa tham skad pa/ sa tham rgyal po zer ba'i skad grags can zer bar snyam/rgyal po'i lha zhal mi mjal/ rgyal po la zhal mjal ma nus zer ba'i don/rgyal po a gnam/ hor gur dkar rgyal po la zer/rgyal phrug ka ra/ gling gi dmag dpon zhig gi ming la zer/rgyal ba rigs lnga/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rin chen 'byung lda na/snang ba mtha' yas/ don yon grub pa/ rnam par snang ca/dzad do//rgyal bo rol stabs/ 'gying ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa la zer/rgyal mo zhal dro ma/ rgyal mo kha dro bkra shis ma zer ba lags/rgyal sgo / rgyal po'i shing rta shong ba'i sgo chen la rgyal sgo zer/rgyal gzhis/ rgyal po'i gzhi khyim la rgyal gzhis zer/rgyal zla/ lugs rnyi nga hor zla bcu gnyis pa la zer/rgyal sras stag lha khri rgyal/ hor gur ser rgyal po'i sras kyi ming /brgya dpon/ dmag brgya phrag gcig gi 'go dpon la zer/brgya 0 gu ru bkrongs/ gal te bla ma bkrongs song na zer/rgyang g.yer che/ rgyang grags che ba'i don la zer/rgyab pha ming / a pha a khu a myes yang myes la zer/rgyab ma mi thar/ lam 'phrang dog nas dmag rjes ma mi shong ba'i 56

༄don la zer/rgyab gzhis dmag rgyab phyogs su sdod pa'i dmag zer ba'i don/rgyab gzhis ya bdag rjes sdod gzhis khyim gyi bdag po zer ba'i ོdon/rgyab li bskur/ rjes su bskyur ba la rgyab tu bskyur yang zer/rgyal kha mi gco blon kha gco/ rgyal po'i gsung las blon gtam ོgtso zer ba'i don/ rgyal khams bskor/ phyogs thar myul ba'am phyogs mthar 'khyamasapa la zer/rgyal chen sde bzhi/ yul 'khor srung / 'phags skyes po/ spyan mibazang / rnam thos sras so//rgyal mchog mi yi nyi ma/ gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul gyi mtshan la zer/ rgyal mchog lha sras/ 'di yang seng chen rgyal po'i mtshan la zer/rgyal po stag zhu can/ hor gur dkar rgyal po la zer/ stag lpagayokyi zhwa gyon pa'i don/rgyal po'i sku byus/ rgyal po'i chab srid dang srid jus zer ba dang —don rgecigargyal po mi khro5sku med/ rgyal po thugs brgyal mi bzhengs ka med zer ba'i don/ 57

rgyu skar dbang bo/ zla ba'i ming / rgyu skar dbang bo'am rgyu skar rgyal po'ang zer/rgyu zhags/ rgyu ma'i zhags pa zer ba'i thag pa lta bu'i ring bo'e do‘ na/rgyu rlon gyi chu thag rgyu rlon gyis rmu thag ltar lda ldi 'then pa'i don/rgyu shor rtsa ra/ rgyu nor dgra lag tu shor na phyir rgyu skyin len pa la rtsa ra zer/rgyug grogs rkyang chung / rta rkyang rgod 'pher ba'i rgyug grogs lha zhig gi ming /rgyud sde bzhi/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med rgyud do// rgyud mangs/ sgra snyan pi wang gi ming la zer/rgyus med/ ngo mi shes pa'i mi la rgyus med zer/kho hūṃ ༄ )spu ma mkhan/ mig 'phrul ston mkhan la zer/sku ma'i bang chen/ gling la mig gis mi mthong ba'i bang chen zhig yod pa de la zer/spu lus/ gdags gzhi'i phung bo 'a zer/thed gsum/ 'brog thab thab mgo gsum can la zer/sgrogs rdo/ gyad mis 'phen nga 'i rdo chen la skyogs rdo zer/58

( dz+nyā ca)sgra gcan 'dzin/ sangs rgyas kyi sras dang gza'i rigs shig la'o//sgra mi snyan/ byang gling gi ming / byang sgra mi snyan zer/ sgra 'dzin/ rna ba'i ming / sgra 'dzin nam thos 'dzin yang zer/sgra 'dzin bu ga rna ba'i bu ga zer ba'i don/sgrub phug chos sgrub sa'i brag phug lta bu la zer/sgro dras pa ltar/ chur brgal na sgro bcad par 'dra zer ba'i don/sgro mdongs/ rma bya'i gtsug sgro'i ming la zer/sgro shubs/ ko ba'i shubs can la sgro shubs zer/ sgrog sum rtsa/ rta sgrog char lung gsum can la zer/sgrog 'ching / lham sgrog la sgrog 'ching yang zer/ḍa shāng༄nga rang a lugs/ nga rang gi dran lugs zer ba'i don yin/nga ro drag po/ skad gdangs drag po'am skad gdangs che ba'i don/nga ro'i dbyangs/ skad gdangs kyi don la zer/ nga la gson rgyu/ nga la nyan rgyu zer ba dang gcig mtshungs/nga las nu/ rgya gar 'phags yul gyi rgyal po zhig gi ming /

nga ga dgyus/ spyi'i skad la ngag dkyus ma yang zer/ngag 'khyal/ don med pa'i rdzun tshig dang ngag 'chal smra ba la'o// ngag gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyangs can ma la zer/ngag bcad pa/ tshig mi smra ba dang drang srong lta bu la zer/ngag 'chal/ rdzun tshig dang don med pa'i gtam sogs la zer/ngag lan 'a mor / tshig lan myur mo thob zer ba'i don/ngang gis grub/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i don la zer/ngang thung / brel ba'i ldog phyogs sems rgyud dal bu la'o//ngang ring / rang bzhin brel tshubs can la zer/ngad ldang ba/ dri zhim thul ba'i don 'a/'o//ngan pa lang shor/ tshod 'dzin med pa'i gang dran na gang laṭa / pa'i mi la zer/ngan spyod sol ba'i tshal/ mi ngan gyi spyod pa nag po so ba 'dra zer ba'i don/ngan tshig shag 'debs/ kha shag 'thab pa'am rtsub tshig smra ba — la'o//ngan g.yo can/ g.yo sgyu zol zab/ can 'a zer/ngan song gsum/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro gsum la zer ngam grog g.yang sa'am gad kha lta bu'i gzar sa la'o//60

ngamakhag na gab/— gdong dang mdog nag po 'jigs rngam can la'o// ngar grogs rgya stag dmar po/ seng chen rgyal po'i dgra bla zhig gi mtshan/ ngar sgra/ dpa' bo dang stag gi ngar sgra lta bu/ngar mdog ston/ dpa' bo min yang dpa' nyams ston pa la'o//ngar gdong rdo thug rkang pa'i ngar gdong rdo la thug zer ba'i dpe —don/ngar ma'i so kha dig pa/ mtshon jon po'i dbal kha nyams pa la spe zer/ngaze 'dzin/ nga las lhag pa'i su zhes nga rgyal 'dzin pa la'o//ngar rogs dom bu snying gar/ ge sar skyobs grogs dgra bla zhig gi mtshan/ ngal dub ba/ ngal ba'am thang chad pa'i don la zer/ca bro dgod ba/— ngu zhor dgod zhor zer ba'i don no// ca 'bod/ ci bya gtol med ngang cho nges 'bod pa la ngu 'bod zer/car sgra 'byin mkhan/ phag pa la ngur sgra can yang zer/ phag gi ming / the cad/ rigs lnga longs sku'i zhing la zer/nges legs/ thar ba thob pa'i don la zer/ngo skyengs pa/ ngo tsha ba'am ya nga ba'i don no//61

ngo stod zulanag 'khor re/ ngo stod rngul chu sham mer zer ba'i —don/ ngo stod a gas sprel 'dra/ gur dkar la ste/ ngo'i ya thod sprerdzasargan zhig dang mtshungs pa'i don/ngo gdong shor/ ngo mdangs shor ba'i don la zer/ngo gnag lhug ger/ ngo nag rog ger zer ba'i don/ngo gnongs pa/ 'gyod gdung skyes te kha skyengs pa'i don/ngo smad rlangs pa phyur re/ ngo smad rngul nas rlangs pa phyur re zer ba'i don/ngo smad rgya bo ra 'dra/ gur dkar la ste/ ngo smad ag tshom lde ma me ra rgya bo zhig dang 'dra ba'i don/ngo tsha rgyu e gda'/ ngo tsha rgyu'am ya nga rgyu e yod zer ba'i don/ngo gdong log pa/ ngo gdong gi mdangs log pa la zer/ngo ya mi pher/ ngo༄'am do ya mi 'ong zer ba'i don/ ngo g.yog gnyis/ gtso bo dang g.yog po gnyis la zer/ ngo re nongs/ ngo re tsha'amyo/ kha re skyengs zer ba'i don/ngo la mchi zhags btab/ gdong la kha chu btab zer ba'i don/ ngo lug khro thung gi sras shig gi ngo la bltas na lug re dgos zer/62

khoni༄ dngangs pa/ 'jigs pa'i ming / dngangs skrag zer/daran 'then/ gzhan lag gi nor khyer na phyir mi sprod pa'i don/dngul dem/ dngul las bzos pa'i ja bra'am ja dem la zer/dacal gdung / dngul gyis bzos pa'i sku gdung la zer/dajul dkar chab lung/ lham sgrog dngul gyi chab lung can la zer/dngul gyi thugs rje chen po/ dngul las bzos pa'i thugs rje chen po'i sku 'dra la'o//dacal gyi ṭaka dngul gyi dong tse'i ming / dngul gyi /ka yang zer/dngul 'gu/ dang po dngul dkar la bcu khol lnga khol la 'gu mo zer bar snyam/dacal chu khro rdzong / gling dkar rgya tsha'i mkhar rdzong gi ming /dngulabum/ dngul las bzos pa'i bum pa la dngul bum zer/dngul 'bum/ mkhar rdzong dang mchod rten la zer/dacal rta mig ma/ dngul rta'i mig pa'i dbyibs 'dra ba la dngul rta mig ma zer/dngul rngom/ dngul dkris can gyi chu zo 'o zo'i ming /dacal yol/ dngul gyi gzhong ba'am yol go la zer/dngos grub rnam gnyis/ thun mong gi dngos grub dang mchog gi 63

dngos grub bogadangos 'gal/ phan tshun dngos su mi mthun pa'i 'gal ba la'o / / dngos can dgra/ gzugs can dgra dang jag rkun gcan gzan so/gas la'o//dngos med bgegs/ gzugs med bgegs lha 'dre gdon ——bgegs sogs cas//ḍa 8rdo—༄canathapag ga(spyig rnga// g.yog po g.yog mo la zer/mngan bgrang / ngan bshad byas te skyon bgrang ba'i don la'o//mnga' bdag rgyal po chen po dang sa bdag gi ming /mnga' bdag gdan khri/ sku rgyal bod dmag gi rgyal po'i ming /mnga' ris/ rgyal po'i mnga' zhabs su yod pa la mnga' ris zer/mngar bo gro zhun/ gro ma dang mar gyis bzos pa'i zhun zas la zer/mngar gsum/ ka ra bu ram zi nga rtsi gsum la zer/ / mngal du zhugs/ ma'i mngal du bu chags pa la mngal du zhugs —kyang zer/mngon sum/ lkog gyur ma yin mngo na sum du yod pa la zer/7 rje/nga—༄ja cha zhon/ rnga la zhon nas rdzu 'phrul ston pa'i don/64

za chad rngog jum/ rnga ma dang rngog ma bcad pa'i rta la rnga chad rngog rdum zer/ nyag skyes gang / rta mang bsad pa'i rnga nyag sgyes gang blangs zer/ja dang ja lcag rnga dang rnga the'u zer ba'i don/ja brna btang / khrims rnga brdungs nas brda btang ba la 'o//ja 'apya bang bsami 'khyud/ dpa' mang bsad pas rnga 'phru bcad pa pang bas mi theg zer/ ja ma'i mgul rgyan/ bla dpon gyi chibs rta'i mgul du btags —pa'i rtsid ldom dmar po la zer/ja rngog rta'i rnga ma dang rngog ma gnyis la zer/za yab/ rnga ma'i rlung g.yab dang lho nub rnga yab zhes gling phran zhigashe'a' ja la sran ma/ rnga thog tu sran mas brgyab pa ltar zhes pa'i don /ja rgasang ldir/ rnga sgu dang 'brug sgra gnyis la zer/jan pa/ las ka las pa'i lag tshags la gla rngan zer/jan pa ster/ dpon la rgyu nor brdzangs pa la rngan pa byin zer/jan byas pa/ gla byas pa'i don la 'jugajam ba dgrapordodul/ gling seng chen gyis mon 'dul skabayo'aphang pa'i phyag mda' zhig gi ming la zer/jams 'jigs/ blta ba mig gis mi bzod pa'i 'jigs su rungasnye 65

ba la'o /jul chu sham me/ lus las jul chu sham mer bzhur ba'i don/rngob lo/ rngog ces yul las byung ba'i lo tsā ba blo ldan shes rab la'o//rngon rgan/ ri dwags pa rgan pa la rngon rgan yang zer/rngon pa/ ri dwags gshor mkhan nam khyi ra pa la'o//rngon sha pha bu/ ri dwags gshor ba'i rngon pa sdig can la'o//brngan pa lkog thos/ rgyu nor lkog zos byas pa'i don/ bangan pa ci dgos/ rgyu nor ci dgos ster zer ba'i don/kho rnyi/ngalnga ba'i bdag po/ gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po la zer/lnga ba'i dbyangs/ dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gyi sgra la zer/lnga ba'i lam/ 'chi ba'i lam zer ba'i don la'o//lnga rig sgra dang gso ba bzo dang tshad ma nang don rig pa bcas la lnga rig zer/ ḍa—r+sha—༄snga 'gras da 'khon/ sngon chad zhe 'gras med/ da lta 'khon 'dzingasamed zer ba'i don/snga rting / snga phyi'am snga gzhug zer ba'i don la'o//66

snga ltas/ sngon du rmi ltas ngan pa'am mtshan ma ngan pa la snga ltas zer/sngags 'chang / gsang sngags pa la sngags 'chang zer/sngags chas zhwa nag can/ sngags pas mthu gtad byed tshe gyon pa'i zhwa nag hor rakha la zer/sngags bzlas/ sngags 'bru ming du bton pa la sngags bzlas zer/sngangs pa/ skrag pa'i ming / sngangs skrag zer/sngam pa 'then/ dbugs 'tshangs te phyir dbugs ring bo 'phangs pa la zer/sngas gdan/ sngas mgo dang nyal gdan gnyis la zer/spun bsu/ mdun bsu zer ba'i don/sngo la rid pa/ sha byang nas lus mdog sngo zhing rid pa la zer/sngo lo'i bu mo/ gling 'brug mo la zer/ skya lo'i bu mo sngo lo zer/sngo bsangs bu mo/ nam mkha'i ming / mngon brjod kyi ming /sngon du bzhud/ sngon du 'gro'am sngon du song zer ba'i don/sngon po g.yab/ rta sngon zhon zer ba la sa cha la las rta la g.yab zer/sngon g.yar dam/ sngon du khas blangs pa'am dam bcas pa ‘pa g.yar dam zer/ sngon song gi rgyu mtshan/ nyadas pa'i dus kyi lo rgyus zer ba'i don/bsngags brdzo da/ mi la bstod bsngags brjod pa la'o//67

ḍa—hūṃ ༄ca co che/ don med pa'i 'ur dir dang ki dir lta bu'o//ca lag dngos po dang yo byad kyi ming / la las ca ga'ang zer/cang te'u/ ḍā ma ru yi ming / legs sbyar skad/cang mi smra ra/ ci yang mi smrar ram ci yang mi bshan zer ba'i don/cang shes/ rta mchog gi ming / cang shes rta pho'ang zer/cang zhes dngos grub ldem pa/ gling tsha zhang 'dan ma'i chibs —rta'i ming /cab cab/ cab sgra di ri ri zhes mi mang gi skad sgra la'o//cal sgrog ri bong cal sgrog zhes ma brtags pa'i don/ci go red/ ci zhig zer ba'i don dang gcig go/ci cha med/ don bya la nges pa med pa'am gtan 'bab med pa'i —tshodon/ci gda' blta/ ci yod la blta zhes pa'i don la'o//ci thod thod/ ci yin yin nam gang byung byung zer ba'i don/ci tsung/ dang ci tshugs/ ci byed dam ci zhig zer ba'i don dang —— 'dra/ci tshugs 'u 'dod/ ci zhig zhu 'dod yod ces pa'i don/cir snang / gang rig rig zer ba'i brda'o//68

nga zhig 'phyis song / cung tsam 'gor song zer ba'i don/ce spyang / spyang ki dang 'phar ba gnyis 'dus pa'i phrug gu la ce spyangazer/cer re long / mig long ba'am mig skyon can la zer/co da byi 'u chung zhig gi ming / co ka drug 'gyur zer/ co ka drug 'gyur/ glu len stangs zhig la'ang zer/co 'dri ba/ mtho 'tsham pa'am smod par byed pa'i don/cog ri'u/ ras dkar chung chung la zer/chog ro ban de/ lo tsā ba cog ro thu'i rgyal mtshan la zer bar snyam/rtsong dril gyi sgra/ cong dang dril bu'i sgra grag pa'i don la'o//cod pan/ gcud/ rgyan nam dbu rgyan gyi ming la'o//col chung / bsam med byis pa lta bu'i ci bshad med pa la'o//khodo~X༄gcags pa/ yid la bzung don/ yid gcags kyang zer/gcan 'phrang / sa 'gag dog sa'i ming / gru gu'i gcan 'phrang dmyal ba'i 'phrang las dogagacam gsag bcos ma'i kha yag ngo bstod kyi tshig la zer/gcig gnas/ rang gcig pur gnas pa'i ri dwags bse ru lta bu la zer 69

gcig shor gnyis shor/ gcig rjes gnyis mthud/ gcig rgyug gnyis rgyug zer ba'i don/gcin rtug gcin skyag zer ba dang gcig mtshungs/gcung po/ rjes skyeb5 nu bo'i ming / brda rnying yin pa 'dra/gcen po/ sngon skyes phu bo'i ming / brda rnying yin pa 'dra/gcer bu rdo khur/ gos ma gyon pa'i sha rjen steng du rdo khur ba'i don/ gces ka byed/ sems ha cang phangs pas gces spraru/ byed pa'i don/gces phrug lang shor/ gang gi tshig la mi nyan pa'i byis pa lang shor la zer/gcong can/ rgyu gzer gyi nad can la gcong nad can zer/gcong nad/ rgyu nad kyi ming / lo lon byis pa gcong gis khyer zer/gcong rong / g.yang sa'am chu brag 'thab pa'i dog sa la'o//(—— rno/—༄ bcu dpon/ dmag mi bcu phrag zhig gi 'go dpon la zer/bcu 'dzom sha bo'i rwa/ sha rwa bcu lag can 'a zer/bco lnga'i nya 'dra/ bco lnga'i zla ba nya gang ba 'dra zer ba'i don/70

bcom barmags/ dmag sgar bcom pa dang brlags pa'i don/nga85—༄lcag tshan brgya bzhud/ lcag gis brgya brab zer ba'i don/lcag phod/ chab mgo can gyi ska rags la zer/lcags go bgos/ lcags khrab gyon zer ba'i don/lcags gos/ lus skyob go cha'i ming la zer lcags mda'/ mda'i bye brag lcags mda'i rigs la'o//lcags zhwa/ dbu skyob rmog dkar la zer/lcang lo'i zar bu/ skra'i lan bu sil ma la zer/lcam dral/ a che'am btsun mo bud med dag la'o//lcam sring / bla ma dang rgyal po'i sring mo la lcam sring zer/lcam lag lag pa'i sor mo myum kyi yal ga lta bu 'brel ba'i don/lce gnyis/ sbrul dang ne tso la zer/ skabs 'gar bud med la'o//lcebs 'gag rang srog rang gis bcad pa'i don//tsho sna~X54 da cha ga ba/ srin 'bu zhig gi ming / 'bu a tsag ba tsag zer/cha ngan/ 'phrin yig ngan pa zer ba'i don/cha dang bang mi/ yig khyer dang pho nya'am brda rgyag sogs la'o//71

cha 'phrin btang / skad dang yi ge btang ba'i ming /cha ma/ ska rags dngul chab ca na la cha ma'am chab sked zer/cha bajug na/ dpe bzhag na zer ba'i don dang ga cigachargyalang rdeng deb/ bub cha rdung rdung zer ba'i don/cha 'a na/ 'phrin nam yig lan zer ba'i don/cha lugs/ gang dang gang gi cha dang lugs su mthun pa'i rdon/chaḍā rno cha'o/ chos so chosashe so dgra la chos zhes bskul tshigacha shas rim 'dzad/ chab srid mar ngo'i zla ba ltar zer ba'i don/chag sgo / nyen kha'i don/ chag sgo che ni nyen kha che zer ba'i don/chag grub ba rdza zhunge sa/ phyong god gtong nges can red/chag grum rang gis nyos/ gyong dang pham kha khur ba'i don la zer/chag 'jigs med/ skrag sgo 'jigs sgo med zer ba'i don/chang nyil du zasad/ mi rta mang po bsad drags pa la zer/chag phebs/ sa gang du thon pa la 'chag phebs pa zer/chags chen/ mi chen dang dpon chen la zer/chags sdang / rang phyogs la chags pa/ gzhan phyogs la sngang ba'i don/chagab zhen/ 'dod sems che ba la chags sems che ba yang zer/chang gi nying khu/ chang gi yang snying la nying khu zer/chang gi zi la ba/ chang gi thigs pa phran bu thor ba la zer/72

sang 'gag chang snyal ba'i sbang ma ngamang 'gag zer/ chang zang / chang gi snyigs ma la sbang ma zer/chang rdza/ chang 'jog snod kyi rdza ma la zer/chang sings/ chang gi gzhug chu btsir skog lta bu 'a chang sings zer/chang gser mdong gang / chang gser dem gang zer ba'i don/changs bzung / lag pas 'dzin sa'i ming / gzhu'i changs bzung ngam gshol gyi changs bzung yang zer/chad byas/ kha chad tshig chad dam sa tshigs dus tshigs bgos pa la'o//chad las/ nyes chad bcad pa la chad las bcad zer/chadalhag chad pa'am lhag pa zer ba'i don/chan gri/ ras sogs dra byed hes gri sogs kyi ming /chan thug 'bras thug gam nas thug la zer/chab kyis bkrus/ chu yis bkrus ni chu yis 'khrus byas pa la'o//chab dkar gru mdo/ chu dkar lung mdo zer ba'i smug gu'i chu ming zhig chab sgo/ phyi sgo'i ming la chab sgo zer/chab sngo lu/ chu chung sngo mo zer ba'i don/ brda rnying du chu la chab zer chab sngon mo/ chu sngon mo'am chu dwangs mo zer/73

chab sngon cho 'i kha zheng / chab chu bo'i kha 'eng che ba zer ba'i don/chab to/ gcin nga/ gtong spyad kyi snod kyi ming 'a/ zer/chab dang chu rlangs/ chu dang rlangs pa mnyam 'grogs zer ba'i don/chab 'og tu/ mnga' 'og tu gtogs pa'i don/chab la drangs/ chus khur ba'i ming la chab la dwangs yang zer/chab shog bka' shog dang 'phrin yig la zer/char ldan dus/ dbyar kha'i dus la 4 ra ldan dus zer/char la skyo/ char la dga' ba'i don/ sha la skyo ba'am chang 'a skyo'ang zer/chab srid/ rgya' sri da la chab srid kya/nga zer/chabs cig lhan cig gam mnyam gcig zer ba'i don/cham la phab/ gtan la phab pa'am dgra cham la phab kyang zer/char skyob/ char gdugs sam shog gdugs lta bu la zer/char dga'/ khug rta'am 'dag pa'i tshang can gyi bye'u chung zhig la'o//chal mar brnal/ thang mar brdal ba'am bcal du bkram pa'i don/chas da bro chas dang dmag chas sogs la'o//chig skya ba/ skya mi gcig gam rang gcig pu'i don la'ang zer/74

chig thub/ dkar po gcig thub ces sman zhig la zer/ chings yig phan tshun 'dum sgrig byas pa'i yi ge'i ming /chibs sga/ ma ma dang dpon po'i rta sga la chibs sga zer/ zhe sa'i tshig chibs skyel/ skya mi mang pos lam du bskyal ba la chibs skyel zer/chibs kha hor la babyur/ seng chen hor 'dul du 'gro ba la zer/chibs khar/ rta'i gong du zhon pa'i don la'o//chibs dpon/ skya dmag gi 'go dpon la chibs dpon zer/chibs drel 'jom gling nyin 'khor/ spug gu'i rgyal po'i chibs drel la zer/ drel des 'dzam gling nyin gcig bskor nus zer ba'i don/chibs gzhol/ rta las babs pa'i don/ chibs gzhol la chibs gshol yang zer/chibs bsu/ skya mi mang pos sngon du bsus pa la chibs bsu zer/chibs stegs/ rtar zhon sa'i sa stegs sam sa them lta bu'o/ / chibs ma bshol/ rta las ma babs zer ba'i don/chibs rdzi/— bla dpon dag gi rta la bdag byed mi la chibs rdzi zer/ chu kha rab so/ chu'i brgal lam la rab dang rab so yang zer/chu 'khor zhing lud/ chu 'khor zhing yar 'phyo ba'i don/ lud ni 'phyo ba'i don/ 75

chu grog chus ba༅/la ba'i grog mo'am gad ka lta bu la'o/ /chu lcebs la btang / chu la mchongs nas shi ba'i ming /chu chubs brag lcebs/ chu dang brag nas mchongs pas shi ba la ོzer/chu stod/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad nang gi skar ma zhig gi ming la'o / /chu stod zla ba/ lugaca/ rnying hor zla drug pa'i mi/nga la'o/ /chu'i bcud/ tshwa khu la chu bcud dam chu rnyi/nga ( shāng zer/chu zergethongs/ nam ma kha'i ming ‘ra chu ma thongs zer/chu /rnyi nga zla/gar tsho / byang chu dkar po la chu snying dkar mo zer/chu ༅ da'/ chu rma do zer ba'i don/ brda rnying ‘ ba mdo la mda' zer/chu gnas hor pa/ chu srim chen po'i ming la zer/chu ba/ yu ba'i ming / pad ma'i chu ba zer/chu bur/ chu khar cha gas pa'i chu lgang bu la zer/chu bo bzhi 'bab/ gāṅgā sirdzu pak+ṣu si tā bzhi la zer/chu bo si tā/ rgya gar gyi chu chen zhig gi ming / rma bya'i khar 'babang la'o(/ /chu bo gāṅga/ rgya kar gyi chu chen zhig gi ming la zer/ glang chen khar 'bab la'o/ /chu bo sirdzu/ rgya ba / ra gye chu chen zhig gi ming la zer/ seng ge'i khar 76

'bab la'o chu bo pak+ṣu/ rgya gar gyi chu chen zhig gi ming / rta mchog khar 'bab la'o chu bo rab med/ chu chen la brgal lam med pa la rab med zer/chu 'dzin dkar po/ sprin dkar po'i ming la zer/chu 'dzin dpung bu 'thug po/ sprin phung ha cang 'thug po'i don/chu 'dzum dkar po/ chu yi lbu ba dkar po la zer chu sprin 'khrigs/ char drag 'bab tshe sprin nag 'khrigs 'dra'i —don/chu byab pa/ dbyar kha char babs tshe chu glo bur du rgyas pa'i don lozer/chu mig 'bum chung / chu mig mkhar chung zer ba'i don/ 'bu chung ni mkhar chung zer ba'i don/chu zi dmar po/ zi skud dmar po'i ska rags la zer/chu thom/ chu zo'i ming / chu zo 'o zo zer pa la zom zer/chu yi chom skun/ nyi ma'i ming / mngon brjod kyi ming/chu rwa 'gyu gang / chu 'brong rwa gang la chu rwa 'gyu gang zer/ gter/ rgya mtsho'i ming / chu gter rlabs kyi phreng ba mkha' zer/chu len thar/ chu len pa'i dmag sgar khag la zer/

chu 'ing / smyug ma dang 'om nag la ngos 'dzin/ snying bo med pa'i khong stong zhig yin pa 'dra/chu shel dbang bo/ zla ba'i ming / mngon brjod kyi ming /chu shel me long / nya gang zla ba'i ming la zer/chu srin gre phug nya mid chu srin gyi gre phug ni mid thag gi phug la zer/chu srin grong / rgya mtsho chen po'i ming la zer/chung grogs/ chung dus kyi grogs po la zer/chung ma lo'i pang / chung a ma'i pang nas gnyom lag rgyas zer/ chung ma las nu zho/ chung dus a ma'i nu zho 'thung zer ba'i don/chung a thig chung byis pa zer ba e yin snyam/chun po/ phyogs gcig tu bsdam pa'i don/ me tog chun po'ang zer/chus khyer/ mi rta mang po chus khur zer ba'i don/ chus mi 'jig chus mi gnod zer ba'i don/ mkhar rdzong smug po chus mi 'jig zer/ che tshu/gas/ dpon tshugs dang mkhas tshugs bzung ba la zer/che zhe/ a che dang ma sru che nga'i ming / a zhe gnam smin dkar mo zer/ched mngags/ ched du mngags pa'i pho nya'am bang chen la zer/78

chen chung / khyim bdag mo che chung gnyis la zer/chen mchog kham pa rwa ring / hor gur dkar gyi bla g.yag zhig gi ming cho gar rtsed sa/ bya ba byed sa dang glu gar len sa la zer/cho nge 'debs/ ngu ngag byed pa'am smre ngag 'don pa la zer/cho 'brang / rigs rus bzang po'am mchog tu gyur pa'i do na/cho lo gnangs/ go gnas dang go sa gnangs pa'i don/chog mi shes/ 'dod zhen ha cang che ba la zer/chon chung / sbra'i zur chon dang 'dabs lung la zer/chon thag sbra gur 'degs pa'i thag pa la chon thag zer/chom po/ rkun po'i ming / chom rkun zer/chol kha gsum/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha gsum la zer/chos kyi 'khor lo/ snying ga'i ming / snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo zer/chos 'khor lha ldan/ lha sa'am dbus gzhung gi khor yug la'o//chos gos/ bla btsun gyis gyon pa'i chos gos la zer/chos rgyal sku lnga/ sku'i rgyal po/ gsung gi rgyal po/ thugs kyi rgyal 4 po/ yon tan gyi rgyal po/ 'phrine las kyi rgyal po'o// chos gos rnam gsum/ snam sbyar dang bla gos mthang gos gsum la zer 79

chos rgyud bzhi/ bya rgyud/ spyod rgyud/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ rna' 'byor bla med rgyud do/ /chos sgron bkra shis/ hor mgar ba'i bu mo'i ming / mgar bza' chos sgron bkra shis zer/chos 'phan nag po/ smug po gdong gi spyi mes chen po'i mtshan/chos rdzogs pazhwachen po/ gsang sngags kyi zab chos bla med rdzogs ba chen po la'o//chos ra/ grwa mang 'tshogs nas bgro gleng byed gnas la zer/chos lu dar 'phen/ bar gling 'om bu'i phyogs kyi dmag dpon mdung ba chos lu dar 'phen la zer/chos longs sprul gsum/ chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum la'o//ḍadzā~X—༄mchan khebs/ dmag dpon gyi g.yas g.yon du bcar nas 'gro mi la'o//mtshan gyi chung ma 'phrogs/ seng lcam 'brug mo hor gyis 'phrogs pa'i don la zer/mchi ma dku/ mig nas mig chu bzhur ba'i don la'o//ma chi ma srang/ rdog tsam/ mig chu sran ma'i 'bru rdog tsam thor zer/mchi ma'i phreng ba/ mig chu sham sham du babs pa'i don la zer/80

mchig gu/ rang 'thag gi ming / thog rdo'i ming la zer/ mching bu/ nor bu slad ma'i ming / mching bu ni rdo phal ba la zer/ma la ba nas gzan/ khang bye'u rgya ril zer ba'i bye'u chung de la zer/mchil ma baspur/ kha chu'i ming / mchil ma 'phangs zer ba'i don/mchu stod/ bya'i yal mchu la mchu stod zer/mchu mid/ bya'i mal mchu la mchu smad zer/ mchu tshugs byed/ kha yon mchu yon/ kha zur mchu zur byed pa'i don la'o// mchog dkar/ gzhu yi ming / mchog dkar gzhu mo zer/mchog gsum/ dkon mchog gsum la zer/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun no//mchong gi drel mthur/ smug gu rgyal po'i chibs srab rin thang bral ba zhig la zer/mchong gigazhug gu mchong gi mjug ma'am mchong gi rnga ma can zer ba'i don/mchong gur spyag po/ sga bde chos skyong ber nag gi mkhar rdzong lozer/81

mchong lha spug po/ hor pā thur phyogs kyi dpa' bo zhig gi ming /mchod ka 'phangs/ ja phud chang phud ma chod pa la mchod ka 'phangs zer/mchod sbyin brgya ba/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi mtshan la zer/( r+shazle༄ 'chang bzung / lang / pas 'chang sa la zer/ gshol gyi 'chang bzung dang gzhu'i 'chang bzung zer/'chab pa/ sbas pa'i don/ mi 'chab po mi sbed do zhes pa'i don/'chal gtam/ don med kyi ca co snying bo med pa'i gtam la'o/ /'chal lab/ mgo mjug med pa'i skad cha mgo g.yog rdzun gtam la'o//'chi bdag gshin po'i rje bo'i ming / gshin rje'am 'chi bdag kyang zer/'chi med lcags rdo nag po/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i nang blon zhig gi ming /'chi med gso byed/ 'chi ba 'joms pa'i bdud rtsi'i sman la'o/ /'chi ltas/ bkra mi shis pa'i gnas tshul sngon du byung ba la 'chi ltas zer/'chi la ma 'tsher/ 'chi ba la mi skrag gam mi 'jigs zer ba'i 82

don/'chol gtam/ rgas po'i gtam mgo rnga med pa'i ldab ldib smra ba la rgas po'i 'chol gtam zer/ 8nga༄ja skyems/ btung ba'i ja'i ming / ja skyems dang gser skyems zer/ja mdong / ja dkrug spyad kyi snod mdong mo la zer ja mkhar phyug mo/ seng lcam 'brug mo'i pho brang la zer/ja mkhar srug po/ seng chen rgyal po'i pho brang shar rgya nag gi ja tshong bas brtsigs pa la zer/ja snyigs/ ja'i snyigs ro la zer/ bu thang rnyed ja ro'i nang nas rnyed zer ba'i don/ja thun zhig ja 'thung yun zhig la ja thun zhig zer/ja bra/ ja dem dang ja mdong la zer/ja tshags/ ja btsags spyad kyi lcags tshags sam shing tshags la zer ja mdzod/ ja 'jog sa'i khang pa'i ming / ja khang ngam ja mdzod zer/ja lan chen lan chung / ja de'u che chung la lan chen lan chung 83

zer/ja 'u zi/ rgya yul nas thon pa'i ja zhig gi ming /ja lo'i phung bo/ ja snyigs sha ro'i phung bo zer ba'i don/ja byu zi hu chag shu phing / ja'i bzang ngan rab 'bring tha gsum zer/jarbaka la ma rings/ jab/ 'gro la ma brel zer ba'i don/ja'i nying khu/ ja'i /bol mgo la nying khu zer/ji ga ji zhig gam ji 'dra zer ba'i don/ju thig mo 'debs spyad kyi mo thig la zer/ju zhags/ mo ma'i yo byad thig gu dkar nag khra gsum la zeposkojus nyes/ rgyal srid dang dmag srid legs lam du ma song ba'i ——don/jus legs/ rgyal srid dang sde srid legs lam du 'gro ba la'o / /jus shor/ srid dbang lag nas shor ba'i don/jo jo/ sngon skyes phu bo'i ming la zer/jo ru/ gling ge sar chung ngu'i dus kyi ming la zer/jo bo 'dam rdza/ 'jang yul gyi 'dam ri zhig gi ming /jo btsun/ dge slong ma la jo btsun yang zer/jo shāka rnam gnyis/ jo bo shākya mu ne dang jo bo mi skyod rdo rje la'o//84
