ḍa —4rte༄mjal rten/ sku 'dra'am mchod rten sogs la'o// mjal dar/ kha btags gos btags sogs la zer/mjal phrad/ ngo thug pa'am mdun drung du song ba lazer/mjug jum/ rta rnga chad dam rnga rdum/ zer ba'i don/mjol mo/ bye'u chung zhig gi ming / bye'u 'jo la mo zer/khoṭ+wā/rdi—༄ 'jag skya/ rtswa 'jag ma skam po la 'jag skya zer/'jag spyil/ rtswa khang chung ngu la 'jag spyil zer/'jang kha sha sprug ri/ 'jang sa tham rgya' po'i bla ri la zer/'jang gi zo dor/ 'jang gi lha srung gi ming / brda rnying dang bon gyis ming btags yin pa 'dra/'jang bza' chos sgron/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i sras mo'i ming /'jang g.yu lha thog rgod/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i sras kyi ming /'jang la se bo/ 'jang gi ri bo mthon po zhig gi ming /'ja' sna lnga/ 'ja' kha dog sna lnga'i gur khang phibs/'jig rten dbang phyug lha spyan ras gzigs kyi myo/ tshan/'jig bskal/ dus mtha'i 'jig pa'i bskal pa la zer/85

'jig rten rme sa po/ lha tshangs pa'i ming mes po tshangs pa gdong bzhi zer/'jig rten gsum/ steng lha'i 'jig rten/ bar mi'i 'jig rten/'og klu'i 'jig rten gsum la'o//'jigase pargyad skyob ma/ rje btsun sgrol ma'i ming la zer/'jigs pa'i ngar sgra/ dpa' bos ga zha dang ngar skad sgrog pa la zer/'jug pa bcu pa/ khyab 'jug gi ming / dgra 'thab 'jug pa bcu las lhag zer/'jigs mi dgos a 'u ci/ skrag mi dgos snying chung ngam bu chung tsho zer ba'i don/'jog po/ klu'i rgyal po zhig gi ming / klu rgyal 'jog po zer/'jol lo lo/ bal dkar kha chu 'jol lo lo zhes mar dpyangs pa skola'o//khodo/nga༄rje 'gran med rgyal po/ gling rje mi yi nyi ma seng chen rgyal po la ོzer/rje thod breng rtsal/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi mtshan/ /rje bran zung / dpon g.yog gnyis zer ba'i don/86

rje mo pher nges/ rgyal mo yong nges sam thub nges zer ba'i don rje yi mgur lha/ srong btsan sgam po'am khri srong lde btsan rnams —kyis bsten pa'i lha srung rnams la mgur lha bcu gsu la zer/rjes skyes/ nu bo la zer/ rjes skyes kyang zer/rjes ra ril tsam/ rkang rjes ra ma'i ril ma tsam zer ba'i rnan/kho+ornying༄ljags brkyangs/ ljags lce'i ming / lce brkyangs zer/ljags mchil btab/ kha khrus sam kha chu btab pa la zer/kho+onya nga༄nya rkang khyi la shor/ nya rkang khyis rmug pa la zer/nya skam la bton/ nya mo skam sar blangs zer ba'i don/nya 'ching / lham sgrog dang lcags sgrog la zer/nya spu 'dar / 'jigs nas nywa spu 'dar ba la zer/nya drug zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla bcu ba la zer/nya nyog lus stobs zhan pa'i rgan rgon dang byis pa sogs la'o//nya dazal ba kha che/ hor chu kham pa gzhung drug gi gru kha srung pa'i nya chen zhig 'a zer/nya ba'i a mgo lcags mig hor chu kham pa rab med srung ba'i mi shi 87

btsan skyes zhig la'o// nya mo rgya la chud/ nya mo dol dang rnyid kyis bzung ba'i don/ nya tsha a brtan/ khro thung gi sras dpa' bo do zla med pa zhig la —zer/ nya zor 'gug mo/ stag rong khro thung gi ral gri'i ming /nya bzhi spom po/ sug bzhi sbom po g.yag dang 'dra zer/nyag ga nyag ga kheṭarga ka zer ba'i don/nyag phran/ mda' yi ming / mda' nyag phran zer/nyag phran bem gzugs la gtad/ mda' sne gling la ma gtad sa rdo sogs la gtad zer/nyan rna pa/ pho nya'am so ba bya ra mkhan la zer/nyab nyob/ shes pa mi gsal zhing le lo'am sgyid lug sogs la'o//nyam nyes/ dmag jus nyes nas mi rta nyam nyes su gyur pa la zer/nyam thag pa/ lus sems sdug bsngal gyis gzir bas nyam chung la'o//nyam mi nga / 'jigs zhum med pa'i don la zer/nyams dga'/ dga' ba'am skyid pa'i don la zer/nyams zhan pa/ lus kyi gzi mdangs nyams pa'am zhan pa'i don/nyi khri dkar chen/ hor pā thur phyogs kyi dpa' rgod zhig gi ming /nyi zas dus/ dgung phyi dro'i nyi ma nub pa'i dus la zer 88

nyi 'bum dar lu/ stod gling gser ba mched brgyad kyi spyi dpon gyi ming /nyi ma gung rgyab/ nyi ma phyed yol tsam la gung rgyab zer/nyi ma grib kha/ phyi dro nyi ma nub kha'am yol kha zer ba'i don/ nyi ma me bzhi/ gza' nyi ma'am skar ma me bzhi gnyis lhan cig/ tu 'dzoms pa la nyi ma me bzhi zer/nyi ma dmar thag chod pa/ nyi ma nub thag chod pa'i skabs zer 75/nyi ma rtse shar/ ning snga mo'i nyi ma ri rtser phogs pa la nyi ma rtse shar zer/nyi ma tsha rting / nyi ma tsha thag chod dus zer bar snang /nyi ma bzhud pa/ nyi ma nub pa zer/ bzhud pa ni nub pa'i don/nyi ma zer re re/ nyi ma ri phag tu 'gro la nye skabs su nyi 'od zer re re zer/nyi ma la rgyab/ nyi ma ri phag tu nub pa zer ba'i don/ nyi ma sang gi snga dro/ nangs ku'i nyi ma'i snga dro zer ba'i don/ nyi ma drod yol tsam/ phyi dro'i nyi ma'i zer thag chad skabs 'a zer/nyi ma'i snga gong / de ring nyi ma'i snga dro zer ba'i dus yin par snyam/nyi ma'i gnyen/ me tog pad ma dang sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la'o 89

nyi ma'i phar stabs/ de ring nyi ma'i phan chad zer ba'i don/nyi ma'i bu/ lho phyogs gshin rje la zer/nying dgos/ dgos pa'i dgos pa la nying dgos zer/nyeng cha/tshams sbyar/ snga phyi gnyis mtshams sbyar ba'am ma'i mngal —du zhugs pa la'o//nyin mo'i mgon po/ nyi ma'i ming / nyin mo'i mgon po'i 'od kyis ri lung khyab/nyin zhag phrugs gcig nyin mtshan gnyis gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ོming /nyung rdog 'dzer/ la phug gri mgor 'dzer 'dzer zhes pa'i don/nye ma nus/ nye sar 'gro ma nus zer ba'i don/nye lam/ gsang sngags nye lam dang 'gro lam nye mo la nye lam zer/nye ring med pa/ nye ring dang phyogs lhung med pa/ bdag gzhan med pa'i don/nyer bsdogs/ gra sgrig dang sta gon zer ba dang don gciganyes chad/ nag nyes can la khrims chad gcod pa la nyes chad bcad zer/ nyes dmigs/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs dang sdig pa'i nyes ོdmigs la'o//nyon sgrib/ nyon mongs pas sgrib pa la'o//90

nyon mongs dug lnga/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyal/ phrag dog go/ stob bzungs/ sha myogs rus myogs deg rdung thal drags pa la zer khonornyi—༄gnyan ger mdzod/ gli5 seng chen skyob pa'i dgra bla zhig gi ming /gnyan gyi gwa ba glang mgo byang g.yu ral rgyal po'i lha srung mthu rtsal can zhig gi ming / banya' shing / mdzo g.yag ske sbrel spyad kyi shing la gnya' shing zer/gnyal nang / stod mnga' ris sa btsan sa zhig gi ming /gnyid du song / gnyid gting log pa'i don la'o//gnyid med a mchod/ hor gur dkar la gnyid rgyu med pa'i a mchod zhig yod pa de la'o//gnyidaye nas mi khug gnyid gtan nas mi 'ong zer ba'i don/gnyis skyes dbang bo/ zla ba dang bya khyung la zer/ kha'i so la'ang gnyis skyes zer/gnyis char mdung 'gran/ gnyis kus mdung 'gran byas zer ba'i don/ gnyibata'athung khu/ glang chen khyu tshogs zhes pa'i don/91

gnyen nye ba/ sha nye ring pha tshan bu rgyud la zer/gnyen ston/ bza' sgrig byas pa'i ston mo la zer/gnyen spun mar dkar/ gnyen pha spun bu spun rnams nang /than pa mar dkar ril bu zer/gnyen dbang / sha nye ring gi ming / nye ring la gnyen dbang mang zer/gnyen med/ gnyen nye du'am grogs mdza' shes med pa'i kher rkyang la zer/gnyen la bsdo/ gnyen la sdang ba'i don/ sdang ba la bsdo nga nga zer/gnyom chung / dgra gnyom chung nus bral bsad pas ci zer ba'e don/brnyas bzhag mi la mthong chung sgos brnyas bcos sam brnyas bzhag byas zer/ nyi༄— — )snyan gyi dbang bo/ rna ba'i ming / snyan dbang ngam snyan gyi dbang po yang zer /snyan dbang gtod/ rna bas nyon nam rna ba'i bu gar gtodazer ba'i don/92

snyigs cha / lnga bdo/ lta ba'i snyigs ma/ nyon mongs pa'i snyigs ma/sems can gyi snyigs ma/ tshe yi snyigs ma/ dus kyi snyigs ma'o/ /snying khams che ba/ dpa' tshod phod tshod stag 'dra ba'i don la'o//snying na ba'i sha len/ snying ha cang na ba'i dgra sha len pa'i don la zer/snying mig rdog 'dra/ snying mig 'bras 'dra ba zer ba'i don/snying 'phyis btang / snying nas smod pa'am 'phya smod byas pa la'o//snying rtsa chab la shor/ ha cang sdug nas sems chu bsags pa'i don e yin snyam/snying rtsa ldang ba/ khong gi snying 'dar ba'am 'phar ldang byed pa la — zer/snying rlung ldang ba/ snying khams mi bde ba'am snying rlung can la'o//snyim pa gang / lag pa'i 'khyor ba gang zer ba dang mtshungs/9 to4 ༄ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa zer ba yin/ta zig rgyal po/ stag gzig rgyal po ming la'o//ta le/ gsal bo'i don/ ta le wa ler gsal le zer/tan tan/ nan tan gyi brda ste/ tan tan tig tig zer/93

tam bu ra/ rol chos pi wang zhig gi ming la zer/ti tsha/ mgar ba'i lcags rdung gdan tsi ta'i ming /tig ta/ mkhris pa'i sman gyi ming la zer/ting nge 'dzin/ sems gnad du phab nas lha sgom pa la zer/ting lo/ mar me 'jog spyad gong bu'i ming la'o//teng lo khrag ges bkang / thugs khros pa'i don/ gdong mdog dmar por gyur pa'i don la zer/ting shags/ rol mo'i bye brag zhig ste la las sil snyan yang zer/til mar/ zar ma'i snum la til mar zer/te lo pa/ rgya ga ra grub chen zhig gi mtshan la zer/te se ri bo/ gangs dkar te se la zer/tog rtse/ sa rko byed rkya 'jor bu'i ming /ཿtsho+o de)༄ gtang rag dga' ston gyi ming / lha'i bka' drin gsab phyir gartang rag 'bul dgos zer/thanatang ma/ rgyal kha'i don/ rgya la kha lon pa la gtang ma lon ma nga zer/gtang ma gnyis/ rgyal kha nyis brtsegs thob pa'i don/gtan grogs/ khyim gcig gi bza' mi pho mo lta bu la zer/94

gtan chags/ g.yo 'gul lam 'gyur ldog med pa'i don/gtan la phab/ bya ba gcig— thog tu phab pa 'i don la zer/ gtam sbyi la mi mched/ gsang gtam dgra la mi bshad pa'i don/gtam glengag gtam gyi gleng gzhi bton pa la gtam gleng zer/gti myag gti mug che bas byol song phag dang mtshungs zhes dran pa mi gsal ba'i don/ gtum dregs can/ 'jigs su rung ba'am nga rgyal can la zer/gtum spyod/ gang la mi 'dzem pa'i rtsub spyod can nam spyi brtol sne can la'o// gte bo/ mi ngan pa rtsod pa'i gzhi slong mkhan la'o/ /gter mdzod/ rgyu nor gyis gtams pa'i khang pa la zer/gtor thor/ rtsam pas bzos pa'i bshos bu zur gsum khrag gis ོbrgyan pa la zer/gtor blog 'phen/ gtor zor 'phen pa la gtor zlog 'phen zer gtor gzan/ khyi ltogs sam pho rog la zer/ khortong༄rta rkang mang bo/ rta pa'am rkang thang la zer/ skya rkang yang zer/rta rkyang rgod/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i chibs rta'i ming /95

rta rkyang rkyang/ spu mdog dmar po can la rta rkyang zer/rta skad 'don pa/ rta 'tsher ba'i don/ rta skad 'don yang zer/ rta khra khyu gcig gda'/ ta khra khra khyu gcig yod zer ba'i don /rta khrab 'khor gsu ma/ rta dang khrab rmog mda' mdung ral gri sogs la'o//rta khrom rgyug rta mang rgyug zer ba'i don yin par sems/rta sga ma gnyis/ steng na mi med pa'i rta sga khur gnyis la sga ma gnyis zer/rta sga ma brgya tsho bcu/ mi sga rta cha 'grigs stong gcig zer ba'i don/rta ngang ba/ ser po'i spu mdog can la zer/rta sngo dkar gwa zhur/ rta sngon gdong dkar la zer/ ga zhur dkar thig la'o//rta 'ching sum mgo ma/ rta sgrog sum lag can la zer/rta ljang dbang bo/ nyi ma'i ming la zer/ mngon brjod kyi ming / rta dzong 'od/ rta ljang nyi ma'i ming / nyi ma'i 'od zer ba'i rdan/rta thang ma/ sga srab bzhag ma myo nga ba'i rta la rta yan ma'am thang ma zer/rta thong sdom can/ bla dngo/na gyi zhon rta'i thong gar rtsid pa dmar po'i sdom brgyab pa la thong sdom zer/96

rta bdun zer mdangs/ nyiXma'i ming / nyi ma'i zer mdangs zer/rta’gdong ri/ rgod ma kha ste khor yug ri mtsho'i dparas dang mnyam pa'i ri rta gdong gi dbyibs 'dra de la zer/rta na so mtho ba/ rta lo na mtho ba la na so mtho ba'ang zer/rta pho'i kha bskorwa gyisdom li/ 4 rta kha 'then nas bskor ba dal bar —byas pa'i don/rta pho kham skya1 rta'i spu mdog dmar ser can la kham skya ze ra/ rta pho gwa ba ya med/ rta pho thod dkar 'gran med zer ba'i don/rta po g.yab/ rta pho zhon pa la brda rnying la g.yab zer/ rta pho hrag lnga brgya/ rta rgod bzang po lnga brgya zer ba'i don/rta bul zag rta gos 'gros med pa'i g.yag lta bu la zer/ rta byang ma/ rtswa chas mang po ma byin pa'i lto ba byang du bcug pa'i rta —la5rta byang ma zer/rta jadina'adigwa byu ra/ rta'i spu mdog nag ser can la bra nag zer/ gwa zhur ni thod dkar gyi don yin/ rta bres 0khab bres kha ni rta ra'am kha ra'i don/ rta bro bajungs/ rta mang rgyug pa'i rmig sgra 'a/ bro brdungs zer/ rta zang / ༄ rta'i rtu lu la rta sbang zer/ rta mi gnyis/ skya mi gnyis kyi don/ mi rta bzhi la go91

rta mi rnams nyi dir byed/ mi rta rnams nyin rer bsad drags ོpa'i don la zer/rta dmag hrag bsdus/ dmag rgod rta rgod phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i don/rta tsha lu me stag nu bo rong tsha dmar leb kyi chibs rta'i ming /rta gzar thog tu dung tho bsgril/ sga stan thog tu sho rde'u 'phangs ba la zer/rta bzang 'dra min g.yab na shes/ rta yi bzang ngan zhon na shesazer ba'i don/rta bzang bres khar btags/ rta rnams kha rar btags zer/bres ni kha ra la'o//rta 'ol ba/ du ba'i mdog can kham nag la rta 'ol ba zer/rta yi kha ru bskor/ rta kha srab kyis 'then nas kha bskor byas pa 'khozer/rta yi kha ru nas bzung / rta'i srab kha nas thung 'dzin byas ba'i ོdon/rta yi bres ra/ rta gso sa'i kha ra'i ming la brda rnying la bres ra snye zer/rta yi sha thag rta sga'i snga ru dang phyi ru la btags pa'i rgyun thag ——la'o /

rta ra ra/ ra ra ni dkar po'i don/ rta dkar po zer/rta har ma/ rta ma btul ba'i rta rgod la rta har ma zer/rta'i bang lam/ rta'i rgyug lam la bang lam yang zer/rta'u dang nya'u/ mi sde chung khag 'ga' zhig gi ming la zer/rtags brgyad ri mo/ bkra shis rtags brgyad te/ gdug4/ gser nya/ bum pa/ pad+ma/ dung dkar/ dpal be'u/ rgyal mtshan dang 'khor lo bcas so//rtags mtshan rgya ris/ thel tse'am tham ku'i rtags mtshan gyi ri ོmo la zer/rtas lag rnab byas/ rtas lag pa rdo la thog nas 'gyel ba la lag rdab zer/rting skyes/ rjes skyes nu bo'i ming ste rting skyes kyang zer/rting ma rim bzhin/ rjes ma rim bzhin 'byung zer ba'i don/rting ma mi la ma shor/ rgyal kha mi la ma byin zer ba'i don/ /rting gnon/ dmag gi rjes gnon nam gzhug mnan pa la'o//rting ma zad/ rnga ma ma ldog gam mjug ma rdzogs zer ba'i don/zul phod/ dpa' rtsal dang phod pa che ba la zer/rten mkhar/ lha rten khang dang bzhugs mkhar la zer/nyen zhabrel bsgrigs/ legs pa'i yo byad mtha' dag grabs gsho+o byas pa'i don/

rte'u chu ha la mi 'phen/ rte'u chung ar la mi gtad zer ba'i snye don/( — rnyi4—༄lta bas chog mi shes/ bltas pas tshod mi shes la chog mi shes zer/ltag ga'i gnya' shing / gnya' ltag gi sbrel ba'i shing la gnya' shing zer/ltag rgyab/ mdun rgyab zer ba la ltag rgyab kyang zer/ltag nyal/ phyi sgal lam ltag sgal du nyal ba la zer/lto dkar/ nya yi ming / lto dkar nya mo 'khyug 'gros zer/lto dkar skam sar/ nya mo skam sar drangs zer pa'i don/lto dkar gser gshog nya gser mig la zer bar snyam/lto rgyab/ kha za rgyu dang rgyab gon rgyu la lto rgyab zer/lto 'gro'i rus pa/ klu dang sbrul gyi rus pa la zer/lto ltogs nas/ pho ba ltogs nas zer ba'i don/lto stong / pho ba stong zer/ zas ma zos lto ba stong bar 'dug zer/lto phud sa/ zas slong sa'am lto ba rgyag sa la zer/lto 'phye/ sa 'og lto 'phye ni sa bdag lto 'phye la zer bar snyam/lto mtshal zhig byin/ zas za thengs shig byin zer ba'i don/sto slong ba/ zas slong du 'gro ba la lto slong du 'gro zer/100

( dhe ———4)sta gon/ grab shoms sam deng sang gra sgrig zer/sta gri/ dgra sta'i ming / star gri yang zer/sta cher brag ri pham bshig gling seng chen gyi phyag mtshan star gri zhig gi ming /stag gi ya bo/ stag gi 'gran ya'am do ya zer ba'i don/stag gur/ stag lpags kyis bzos pa'i gur gyi ming /stag spam gzig sgam/ stag gzig gi pags pas btum pa'i sgam la'o//stag sgar/ stag gur can gyi sgar khag la zer/stag thul/ stag lpags kyis bzos pa'i gyon gos la stag thul zer/ stag dong / mda' shubs sam mda' ra la zer/stag mo bang gang / dpa' bo'i khyu tshogs thang gang zer/stag spyos nam/ myos bzi ba'am dga' ba'i don/ stag bzi nas mchongs zer stag tsha ngo lug stag rong dpon po gzig 'phen gyi tsha bo'i ming /gdong la bltas na lug re ster dgos pas ngo lug zer/stag tsha dom smyon/ gling gi dpa' rgod a ya med pa zhig gi ming /stag zho 'thung dus nas sha stag phrug gis maḍi/ nu zho 'thung dus 101

za ba sha khrag yin pa la zer/sta ga gzig 'ol mo lung ring / stag gzig gi nor rdzong phab sa'i gnas kyi ming /stab/ ri mo can gyi dgu tshan/ stag lpags gcig gtsos pags rigs sna kha dgu 'tshams rtags su phu'/ ba la dgu tshan zer /stag rong gnyis/ mon sde'i grangs kyi ming ste/ nyin gyi stag sde dang srib kyi rong sde gnyis tshig sdud byas pas stab/ rong gnyis zer/stag rong bstan chus/ stag rong gi sde srid dam chab srid la bstan chus zer/stag rong mog gi dar 'phru bcad/ stag rong dpon po gzig 'phen hor gyis bkrongs pa la'okustag rong dug mtsho dmar po/ stag rong shog chen bco brgyad la zer/stag ral/ mda' dong ngam mda' shubs la zer/stag shar ba/ skyes pa gzhon nu'i ming la zer/stag seng kha sprad/ dpa' bo'i ming la zer/ dpa' rgod stag seng kha 'thab 'dra zer ba'i don/stag sog gong ba/ stag gzig dang sog po gnyis la stag sog ces 102

tshig sdud byas/ gong ba ni la rgya zer ba yin/stag lha khri dkar/ mon shing khri rgyal po'i mkhas mdzangs can gyi nang blon zhig la zer/ stag lha khri rgyal/ hor gur ser rgyal po'i sras kyi ming / zing gi sa bkrongs/ stag lha me 'bar/ bon po'i lha srung lhag lha zhig gi mtshan/stang ma thob pa/ stang ma rgyal kha'am rgyu nor thob pa la 'jug gtanga'adi yang bris yod/ stabs re gzab na/ ha cang dogs zon dang gzab gzab byed pa'i don/steng ma/ thog ma'am dang po zer ba'i don/stes dbachos/ stabs legs 'grigs pa'i don la zer/stong 'khun rgyal po/ stong 'khun rgya nag gi ming / rgya nag rgyal po la zer/sto nga rgya ga 'ug gu/ rta mchog zhig gi ming / mgyogs 'gro stong las lhag yin zer/stong mchod btang / mchod me mchod pa stong phul ba la stong mchod btang zer/stong 'jal ba/ mi bsad rjes rgyu nor byin pa la stong 'jal zer/stong dpon/ stong dmag zhig gi 'go dpon la stong dpon zer/103

stong dpon ma bā tsā na/ bod skad du bsgyur na stong dpon ye shes chen po zer/stong ba'i dbyings/ nam mkha' stong ba'i khams la zer/stong lam/ nam mkha'i ming / stong ba'i lam yangs kyang zer/stong log bya ba ci yang ma 'grub par phyir log pa la stong log/ zer/stong shong 'drug sgra/ hor gur ser gyi dmag dpon zhig gi ming /stong shong sprug po/ stag gzig rgyal po'i bzhugs gur la zer/stongs grogs mdzod/ dpung gnyen dang rogs ram mdzod zer — ba'i don/stod yag la ser bo/ hor gur dkar nag ser gsum 'tshos/sa ོsa'i ri zhig la'o//stod 'a/ dwags/ mnga' ris byang phyogs kyi yul zhig la zer/ston pa rgya' rtsa tshan/ seng lcam 'brug mo'i pha yab skya lo'i ston pa ོrgyal mtshan 'a/ zer/ston gsum 'bru mgo blangs/ ston zla gsum la 'bru khral blangs ོzer ba'i don/ston pa gtso 'khor gsum/ sangs rgyas dang / sha ri'i bu dang /moṅgal gyi bu'o//ston gshen rab/ bon po'i bla ma gtso bo zhig ba zer/ stongaza chen g.yu rgyal/ byang gru gu rgyal po'i ma/tshan la zer/1(/4

9 rdorte ༄ brtan ma bcu gnyis/ bon skyong ba'i lha srung brtan ma bcu gnyis la ze ra/brtan bagling / brtan cing brjid pa'i don la'o//ḍa rdornyi—4 blta bsamub ngom pa/ blta bas chog mi shes pa'i don/9— rdo ༄—) tha skar zla ba/ tha skar skar ma zhig gi ming / tha skar zla ba hor zla dgu ba la zer/ tha gru yangs pa/ rgya che zhing khor yug yangs pa la tha gru yangs pa zer/tha mal ba/ shes rig mi ldan pa'i spyir btang gi mi la zer/tha tshig mna' bor ba'am dam bcas pa la zer/ tha dzi ga bsgos/ bka' bsgos dam bzhag byas pa'i don/ tha tshig shor/ khas blangs dang dam bca' nyams pa'i don/tha gzhug tha rnga ma zer ba'i don la'o// tshabag nag lcags lung / zhags thag lcags kyi a long can la zer/105

thab shos gang tsam thag tshad gcig tsam zer ba'i don/thag hrul/ thag pachad po 'a/ thag hrul kyang zer/thags shing 'ur lu/ thags 'thag spyad kyi stag shing la zer/thags bzang / lha min gyi rgyal po zhig gi ming / so la'ang thags bzang tshems dkar zer/thang dkar rgod po/ bya rgod mdog dkar po la thang dkar rgod po zer/thang dkar lding lding / rgod thang dkar 'phur 'phur zer ba'i ོdon/thang dkar lding tshod ma zin/ rgod thang dkar 'phur tshod ma — zin na zer ba'i don/thang dkar lag rnyir tshud/ bya rgod rnyi yis bzung zhes dpa' bo bsad pa la zer/thang chad pa/ ngal dub ba'am mnyel ba'i don/thang chen pad ma yar 'khyil/ hor dmag tshogs sa thang chen zhig gi ming /thang stong sprul pa/ grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i sprul pa zer ba'i — don/thang nag 'phur shes/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i phyag mda' zhig gi+oming /106

yang nag rgyal/ hor gur nag phyogs kyi dpa' rgod zhig gi ming /bangaramaraphangazhi ling / thang chen mtha' mi mngon pa'i don la zer 4thang spyag margod kyi rigs shig gi ming la zer/bang rtswa ra pad+ma stong ldan/ hor ser po'i rtswa thang zhig la zer/ thang log 'gyel gsum/ rta bong lta bu'i 'gyel log byed pa la —— thang log 'gyel gsum zer/thang shing 'ba' lo/ thang sdong gi thog gu la 'ba' lo zer/than skad/ bkra mi shis pa'i skad ngan la zer/ban bya nag po/ bya khra ta la than bya nag po zer/ than bya bse bo/ hor gyi bya chen bse bo la zer/ thab chas/ slang skyogs khol mo sogs la zer/thab chen/ mgron po 'bab sa'i gsol khang chen po la zer/ bab rdo/ ri thang nas ja skol tshe rdo yi snyed pu gsum la thab rdo zer /thabs bral/ thabs bkod pa ci yang med pa'i don/thabs shes gnyi / snying rje chen po'i thabs dang stong nyid rtogasopa'i shes rab gnyis la zer/thabs jugs ba/ thabs zad nas ci bya gtol med du gyur pa la —zer/107

tham ma tham ma ka zhes pa'i sog skad do/ /dengasang tham ga'am dam ga yang zer/thams cad skyobs/ sangs rgyas dang rje btsun sgrol ma la'o//thal mo sbyar/ lag pa'i thal mo snying gar sbyar zer/thal tshan/ dmyal ba'i 'khor 'dabs kyi chu bo zhig la zer/thar ba lar nas med/ thar ba gtan nas med pa'am ye nas med zer ba'i don/thar lam dkar po/ dge ba'i lam la zer/ rnam dkar dge ba'i lam la'o//thil nag dmyal ba'i tsha dmyal zhig gi ming /thig le mchog ma/ lha'i bu mo ha cang mdzes sdug can zhig gi ming /thu bo/ a jo'am bu che ba la thu bo'ang zer/thu mo/ rgyal mo'am gtso mo zer ba'i don/thu ru rta/ rta chung tho ru la thu ru'ang zer/thu le bu yi nag cog hor gur nag phyogs kyi dpa' bo zhig la zer/thug sdor/ thug sha la thug sdor zer/ thug rdzas kyang zer/thug nag 'du khang lha khang gi steng du btsugs pa'i dar rtse gsum —thug ris nag po can la zer/108

thug 'phrad/ mjal 'phrad dam thug 'phrad ni don gcigathug ya mi zhan/ kha ya mi zhan thug ya mi gnyom zer ba'i don/thugs skyo ba/ sun snang skyes pa'am sdug bsngal skyes pa'i don/thugs ngal ma mdzad/ sems sdug ma byed zer ba'i don/thugs rtog langs/ thugs la dogs pa langs pa'i don e yin — sems/thugs ma g.yeng / sems ma g.yeng zer ba'i don/thugs re khrel/ thugs khrel ba ni thugs brgyal bzhengs pa'i don/the mo sha ba rkang gcig mthing rgyal po'i sa srung btsan rigs sha ba rkang gcig la zer/the'u mo kha la ru ba/ bya shang shang yul gyi mi ma yin cho 'phrul can zhig gi ming /the'u rang / the'u rang ni mi ma yin yi dwags kyi bye brag zhig la'o//the'u rang dkar nag khra gsum/ gnam the'u dkar po/ bar the'u khra bo/ sa the'u nag po gsu ma la zer/the'u rang rten ra/ the'u rang 'khor sa'i ra skyes la rten ra zer/the'u rang gsum gyi bla rdo/ the'u rang dkar nag khra gsum gyi bla — srog gnas pa'i rten rdo la bla rdo zer/thel mo rkang gcig hor gyi sa srung the'u mo rkang gcig la zer/thel mo spun dgu/ hor gyi zam pa rkang gcig srung ba'i hor lha the'u 109

rang spun dgu la zer/thel rtses mnan/ tham ka brgyab pa'am rgyas btab pa'ang zer/tho chen mkha' la phyar/ lcags rdung spyad kyi tho chen la zer/tho ru/ rte'u lo gsum lon pa la tho ru zer/tho 'tsham pa/ ngo rgol lam 'gran ya byed pa'i don la'o//tho ru kha rjon/ rta gsar na so gnyis yas mas la zer/tho ru khu gcig gom 'gros med pa'i tho ru khyu gcig dang 'dra zhes pa'i don/tho ru thor mo/ rta chung gi ming / tho ru thor mo'am rje'u rgya mo'ang zer/tho rangs skar chen/ nam langs kha'i skar ma chen po de la skar chen yang zer tho lum/ lcags kyi tho chen la tho lum yang zer/thog gyon/ steng du gyon pa'i lwa ba la thog lwa'am thog gyon yang —zer/thog jug med/ thog sa reg sa med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu la zer/thong lag bye/ lag pas thong 'dzin byas pa tha dad du bkar ba la thong lag phye zer/thod skam pob/ zhu/ thod pa skam po'i dbu rgyan la brog zhu yang zer/thod bcings/ dar dkar gyi thod bcings sprin dkar langs 'dra 110

zer/ pod thogs bu gsum/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i blon po thod pa ོthogs pa'i bu gsum la zer/pod pa'igab yig thod rus steng gi ri mo la thod pa'i kha yig zer/thod phor/ mi'i thod rus kyi phor ba la thod phor yang zer/thod phreng rtsal/ mo rgyan pad ma'i mtshan grangs shig la'o//thod ya/ ngo ya'am gdong ya zer ba'i don/thod pa'i a yig thod pa'i a yig ni thod pa'i kha yig zer bar ——snyam/ thon bag sdom rgya/ gur gyi 'then thag ni 'bu sdom gyi dra rgya lta bu——zer/thor cog spyi bo'i skra 'bur du bcings pa la thor cog zer/thos 'dzin/ rna ba'i ming / thos 'dzin nam sgra 'dzin yang byer/kho8rno༄mtha' 'khob/ gangs ljongs la mtha' 'khob bod yul zer/mtha' 'khob ni chos med pa'i don/cagasar dbus med/ mtha' dkyil med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu la——zer/mtha' rting / mtha' mjug zer ba'i don dang gcig111

mtha' gnyis/ rtag mtha' dang chad ma/tha2 gnyis/ kyi don/ma tha' gzhug rjes su mjug tu mtha' rnga ma zer ba'i don/mthing chu/ mthing ni sngon po'o/ /chu sngon zer ba'i don/mthing nas/ khung rgod/ hor gur nag phyogs kyi dmag dpon zhib gi ming /mthing g.yul ra' thog rje/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i sras kyi ming /mthing ril/ chu bya'i rigs shig gi ming / mthing ril gyol bo'ang zer/mabu stobs bdag po/ dpal phyag na rdo rje la zer/mthu bo che/ mthu stobs ha cang che ba'i mi la ma thu bo che zer/mtheb kor mda' 'phen skabs mtheb mgo la gyon pa'i so/ra gdub 'dra ba de la'o// mtheb mo sgro ba gang / hor dmyo/ga bsad drags pas mdzub mo sgro ba gang bcad zer/mtheb ltong mnyam sprod/ mda' mo ltong la mnyam du sbrad zer ba'i don/mtheb rtsal/ mtheb mdzub kyi rtsal che chung la zer/ mda' 'phen na ca/theb rtsal dgos zer ba'i don/ma mi'u/chung / mthe'u chung ni mdzub chung la zer/112

mtho ri bos gser zhu gyon/ ri rtse la nyi zer phog pa la zer/mthong ba kun smon/ dngul ra lha sde khro kho kha gsum gyi sa la zer/mthong smon yul/ gling sa mthong ba kun smon zhes gling sde chags yul la zer mthong smon lha yi 'du ra/ lha gling tshogs sa rma de'u yag stag thang khra mo la zer/mthong 'dzing / dpa' bo thod thug nas lag 'dzing dang g.yug re rdebs re byas pa'i don/mthong gsal kun shes/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i mo rtsis mkhan zhig la zer/ nga r+shar+sha—༄ 'thag mkhan 'u lu/ 'u lu ni 'thag mkhan gyi lag cha stag ma la skosgrozer/'thab ja lun tsam/ 'thab 'khrugs ja 'thung yun tsam du byas zer/'theng bo/ rkang rgyal gyi don/ mi 'theng / khyi 'theng / rta 'theng gsum la zer 'thor chung / rlung drag 'tshubs nas gnam sa g.yo ba lta bu la 'thor rlung zer/113

tsho rdo ༄)da rgya la rgyal po/ da gal te rgyal po ma phebs na zer/da cha/ dus da lta ba'am da gdod zer ba'i don/da ni nga gdugs kyi snga dro/ da ning nyi ma'i snga dro zer ba'i dom/ da na'i rgyud/ lha ma yin gyi rgyud zer/ da na sbyin pa'i don te sbyin ma'i rgyud zer ba'i don/da ga phod/ da nas bzung ste ma 'ongs pa zer/dwa phrug pha ma med pa'i bu dang bu thol dwa phrug zer/dag pa shel ri/ gangs ri'i dbang bo te se la zer bar snyam/dag byed/ chu dang rtswa ku sha'am 'dag rdzas sogs la zer/dag zhing / chos lugs kyi skad dag pa'i zhing khams zer ba'i don/dwags kong nyang gsum/ dwags po/ kong bo/ nyang bo gsum gyiyul ming la'o//rwa ngas ma'i 'bru/ thig le'am khu ba'i ming la zer/dngas sman/ bu mo'i gras dang ma sru la zer/dwangs rtse/ yang rtse zer ba'i mchog shas kyi don la zer/dwangs bsil/ dwangs shing bsil ba'i chu gtsang gi ming /dad pa gsum/ dang ba'i dad pa/ mngon 'dod kyi dad pa/ yidaches pa'i dad pa'o//114

dan dan/ gal chen rtsis chen drang bden zol med la'o//dan rog snying bo med pa'i shing zhig gi ming / chu shing la zer/dam grib phog mi gtsang grib ngan phog pa la zer/dam rgya/ mthel tse'am tham gas mnan pa la dam rgya zer/dam can mgarab/ 'jig rten pa'i lha zhig gi ming la zer/dam can rdo rje lag pa/ lha srung mthu bo che zhig gi ming la'o//dam nyams/ bla dpon mdun nas khas blangs dam bcas kyi tshig —srung ma nus pa la dam nyams zer/dam tshig khas blangs dang dam bcas pa'i tshig la dam tshig zer/dam tshig sprel/ mna' bor ba dang tshig thag bcad pa la tshig sbrelasazer dar/ dkar 'gying thod/ rgyal po'i dbu la gyon pa'i lwa thod dkar po la zer dar dkar rtsor lo can/ dar dkar dri med kha tshar can zer —ba'i don/dar dkar lug re/ dar dkar bubs gcig la yug gcig zer/dar dkar dzar lo can/ kha btags kha tsharam nyams pa la zer/dar dkar ngal gu/ dar dkar gyi na bza' phu dung med pa'i ring bo la zer/dar dbar lag nog ma song / dar dkar dri mas ma nog pa zer115

ba'i don/dar khra rin chen spung ba/ gling ba spyi'i rgyal dar gyi ming /dar gyi dpa' lung / ral gri'i yu bar btags pa'i ras gos la —dpa' lung zer/dar lcog ri sgang dang sde 'dabs su btsugs pa'i dar lce mang po can la dar lcog zer/dar mdud leb rgan mdangs/ dar gyi mdud pa mdog sna lnga can la zer/dar dpyangs/ lha khang gi ngos dang mi'i mgul du 'phangs pa'i ras gos la dar dpyangs zer/dar spyang grwa ma nyams/ spyang dar ma spu sdug ma nyams zer ba'i don/dar bab can/ gling gi che rgan dag gi sras mo lang tsho dar bab — can rnams la zer/dar ma rdo rje/ gtsang rga/yas ru'i dmag dpon zhig gi ming la zer/dar dmar ral gu/ phu dung med pa'i gos ber dmar po la zer/dar bza' sgron ne —/ spyi dpon rong tsha khra rgan gyi yum la zer/dar yug ring bo/ dar gos ring bo bubs gcig zer ba'i do na/dar rong gnyis/ mon sde gnyis kyi ming / nyin gyi dar sda dang srib kyi rong sde gnyis tshig sdud byas bas dar rong gnyis zer/116

dar seng / seng ge'i ming / dar seng dkar mo'ang zer dal 'gro/ dal 'gro chu'i ming / dal 'bab kyang zer/ dal ba8 rten/ mi'i lus rten thob pa ladal ba'i rten bzang thob ngazer/dalababyorabartso brgyad/ dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu ladage'abyor bco brgyad zer/dal yams nad kyi ming / yamasand dang rims nad zer/de ti bu/ lha ma yin miming / dita'i bu'angadara'i bu mang zesade bra ka ra/ bya shang shang yul mirin chen sbas khung brag phug zhigazhig pa/ smra mi dag pa'i ldab ldib lab ba 'asazer/du ku la'i gos/ gos dkar po ha cang srab bu zhig lazer/du kha/ rgya gar skad/ bod skad du bsgyuran sdug bsngal gyi ming /dug snga/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang / gti mug nga rgyangan zag dogamakhridug ru kha/ ming mdzod kha shas na tho ru chisal zer bangabashad/dug gsum/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mugagasum la'o//dug ha la/ hal nag po'i don/ dug nag po zer ba'i don /dung skam/ dung gi skam4 pa la tshig bsdu byas pas dung skam zer/drang skyong stag lha khri dkar/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i dmag ——dpon zhig gi ming /77

dung gi co ga mdog dkar poyin pa'i sa mtho sa'i bye'u chung — zhig gi ming /dung gi thugs rje chen bo/ rgyu dungalas bzos pa'i bugs rje chen —po'i sku 'dra la zer/dung gi la thod/ rgyalapo lta bu'i dar dkar mithod ba ngasab la zer/dung chen dkar mo rgyang grags/ gling ba spyi'i khrims dung la zer/dung chen gyi sgra btang / zangs mas4bzos pa'i dung ring bo la — dung chen zer/dung phor/ dbral pa'i thod rus kyi ming / mgo dung phor zer/dung zla ba nga la 'phangs/ gling rgya tsha hor gyis bkrongs pa 9 zer/dung shwa/ dung gi shwa rde'u dkar po la dung shwa zer/dung shwa sgril ba/ rgyu no ra gta' la bzhag nas sho brgyab pa la zer/dud kha ci tsam/ khyim tshang ci tsam/ yod zer ba'i don/dud zhags/ dud rlab4'khrigs pa'i don la zer/dur bya/ ro zan bya rgod dkar nag gam rkang ka lazer/dur mal 'debs/ dur sa 'debs pa zer ba'i don/dur zas/ dur khrod du bskyal ba'i zas la dur zas zerakadub kyi lnga ba/ ston mjug gi me tog la zer/dus chos su gyur pa/ bsad pa'am 'i/ ba'i don/118

dus byas ba bzhin/ dus chad byas ba'angadus btab pa'i don/de ga'i mod la/ de ma thag tu zer ba'i don /de mchan/ de 'og tu zer ba'i don dang mtshungs/de po bcu/ dngul gyi de pho ni dngul gyi khyim bya bcu zer ba'i don/de pos ngar skad ra/ nam yar langs bya pho grags dus zer ོpa'i don/der mi skyon a bu rtsi/ de la skyon med bu bzang po zer ba 'dra/de tsug byed/ de ltar byed dang de bzhin las zer ba'i don/de rang yin/ de sha stag gam de kho na yin zer ba'i don/de ring nyi ma'i gdong gang / de ring nyin gcig gorang thad duskyizer ba'i don/de ring gtang ma ma lonang/ de ring rgyal kha ma lon na zer ba'i don/de ring gtang ma rang la thob/ de ring rgyal kha rang la thob thero/ba'i don/ded dpon/ rgya mtshor bgrod pa'i tshong dpon la zer/del yag stag thang / gling gi 'du ra'am rtsa thang che ba zhig gi —ming /do gal che ba/ ha cang bya ba gal che ba'i don la zer/do bsdo ba/ 'gran btsugs pa'am ngo rgol byed byas pa'i don/119

do nub/ de dgong ngamado dgong yang zer/do nub rgas kyi dgong kha/ de ring nyi ma nub kha zer ba'i don/dotshub gal/ bya ba gal mi che zer ba'i don/do zhag da lodang do tshigs zer ba'i don yin/do ya pher ba/ do ya dang 'gran ya yong zer ba'i don/don khag bo/ don dka' pokhag mo ni bya ba sgrub mi nus b.lazer/don khrol phyir thon/ don snying nang khrol phyir phyung ngo zer ba'i — don/don lnga/ glo ba/ snying / mkhal ma/ mtsher ba/ mchin pa'o//don gnyis/ gzhan don dang rang don gnyis la don gnyis zer/don po/ gtso bo'agasnying bo'i donal zer/don ma gal/ do snangam byas ba'amagal chen du ma bzung ba'i ོdon/don yod grub pa/ rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas shig gi mtshan no//don la pha mo sdarab/ don thog tu babs na snying med wa 'dra zengaba'i don/dob dob smra ba/ tshiba'imi gsal ba ldab ldib smra ba'i donadadom mgo glang snying / stag rong dpon po khro thung gi bsten lha zhig bi mingor /dom bu thugs dkar/ dopolpags gdan du bting ba la zer/120

thugs dkar ni dom gyi snying kha na dkar thig cung tsam yod pa —de la'o//dom ra/ dom gyi pags pa thod du gyon pa la dom ra zer/dor skying / na bza' gzhan ma mnabs par ras zha gcig pu gyon pa la dor rkyang zer/dor ma/ sham thabs lta bu'i smad gos zhig gi ming /dol/ bya ri dwags 'dzin pa'i rgya'am rnyid kyi ming /dol lcags gyu/ nya rgya dang lcags kyu gnyis la dol lcags zer/ dol chod du/ tsham tshom dang g.yel ba med par 'bad brtson byas pa la'o /ḍā ru mgo cho gtad med pa'i ḍā ru lta bu'i ngo gnyis ma la zer/nge 'i lung / dāk+ki ni rgya gar skad/ bsgyur na mkha' 'gro zer/mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan zer ba'i don /khodzāng༄ dra rgya 'dzin ba/ nya ba'am nya 'dzin mkhan la zer/dra phad/ ska rags sam lhug gu lta bu la zer/dra ma/ mi ya rab dang bzang bo la zer/ khang pa'i dkar khung la'ang zer drag sngags ye gda'/ drag sngags e yod zer ba'i don/121

drag rtsal zla ba gdong sngon/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal bo'i dmag dngo/na 'gran med zhig gi ming /drag 'an bar gsum/ mi bzang ngam tha gsu myo/ zer ba'i don/drag rim rnams/ mi chen dpon chen mtho gras rnams la zer/drang srong nyag phran/ nyag phran mda'i ming / drang srong mdar mo zer ba'i don/drang srong gza'/ gza' khyab 'jug mgo dgu can la zer/dran pa yal/ dran pa nyams pa'i don la yal ba'ang zer/dran shes shor/ dran pa mi gsal zhing dran shes nyams pa la zer/dri ldan shing / shing se ba la zer/ la las mdzo mo nu shing yang zer/dri ma gsum spangs/ sangs rgyas sam nyan rang dgra bcom la'o//dri rtsi /ba/ thab ku'am sla nga'i steng gi dud dreg nag po la zer/dri mi dku ba/ dri mi zhim pa la dri mi dku ba'ang zer/ dri bzhon/ rlung dang bser bu'i ming la dri bzhon ya nga zer/dri za/ zas su dri tsam za bas dri za zer/ lha'i bye brag kyang zer/dri za'i grong khyer/༅dri za lha'i khongs gtogs te/ de'i grong bye/ ra mi rtag par skad cig nyid la 'jig pas sgyu ma'i dpe ru bkod/dri bzang khang/ pad ma spyi yi ming la mngon brjod las dri bzang khang zer/122

drin pha lu/ drin pha lu'am pha lo ni bu dang bu mos pha la gces ming btags pa yin/drin gatho ba/ bka' drin bsab pa'am bka' drin gzo ba'i don/drug dkar galu yi sgrol ma/ g.yu drug dkar gyis bzos pa'i sgrol sku zhig la zer/drug dmar galu rdo/ g.yu rdo dmar po zhig la g.yu drug dmar zer/dred gas po/ dred rgas na grog ma'i tshang sgo 'grim zer ba'i nus med kyi don la 'jugadred sog dkar/ dred kyi so/ga steng na dkar thig cung tsam yod pas dred sog dkar zer/drel mo nyi ma dgu chod/ hor gur dkar rgyal po'i bzhon pa dre'u zhig la zer/dro la skum pa/ grang ba'i dus su dro tshad ldan pa la zer/9dordo༄ gdangs snyan/ skad gdangs snyan pa'i don/ 'brug gdangs snyan bzhad pa zer/gdan sa gsum/ se ra/ 'bras spungs/ dga' ldan gsum la zer/ gdams ngag man ngag dang bka' lung gnangs pa'i don/ 123

gdugs kyi snga dro/ nyi ma'i snga dro zer ba'i don 'a gas/gdung drug bod/ bod kyi mi'u gdong drug la zer/ 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung / stag lung ga za'i gdung / sa skya 'khon gyi gdung /chos rgyal bya yi gdung / 'od gsal lha'i gdung / sne'u gdung gung ma lha'i gdung ngo //gdung drug dbang phyug gi bu chung ba lha'i dmag dpon gzhon nu gdong drug la zer/ gdung yi ge ma dgagadung rten/ sku gdung me / bsregs pa la zer/gdung spyangs/ gdung bcos byas pa'am gdung me la bsregs pa la zer/gdung ma chag ka ba'i steng gi gdung ma chag zer ba'i don ni/gling gi rgya tsha'am snang ngu g.yu stag sog hor gyis bgrongs pa la zer/gdung 'tshob/ rang rigs kyi sku tshab bam gdung tshab la zer/gdung bzhus/ sku gdung me la bsregs pa la zer/gdu ra gseb/ ka ba dang gdung ma'i bar la gdung gseb zer/gdung kor/ rkang lag gi rgyan cha gdu bu la zer/gdengs can bdepha/ po/ klu'i rgyal po'i ming la zer/gdo nga gi ri mo/ thod pa'i kha yig la gdong gi ri mo yang zer/gdong lnga/ seng ge ri ming / gdong dang rkang lag bzhi'i rtsab124

gcig 'dra yin pas gdong lnga ba zer/gdong lnga ba/ seng ge'i ming / gdong lnga'i khri ni seng ge'i khri zer ba'i don/gdong lnga'i sgra dbyangs/ seng ge'i nga ro zer ba'i don/ba/dong btsan snang ca / gling gser ba'i phyogs kyi dpa' rgod zhig gi ming /gdong bcu ba/ srin po'i rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu la zer/gdong btsan yo dbon/ stag rong dpon po gzig 'phen gyi bu skoskal gyi ming /gdong ra khra rgan po/ gling gi thog ma'i mes po zhig gi mtshan/gdong be ru/ gling ba'i sde shog zhig gi ming la be ru'i shog kha zer/gdong blangs pa/ gdong dang mdun nas bkag pa'i don la zer/bdong ma bzhi dpon/ khro thung la zer/ ma'i nu zhos ma 'grangs par mdzo mo ra ma khyi mo gsum gyi 'o ma blud pas ma bzhi zer/gdong zhal 'joms/ ri yul mnyam du ngo thug pa la gdong zhal 'dzoms zer/gdong bzhi pa/ lha chen tshangs pa la tshangs pa gdong bzhi zer/gzhol spyod/ mi bsrun ma rungs pa shan pa lta bu'i spyodapa la gdoyospyod zer/gdos bu/ gru gzings skyod byed kyi gru khem lta bu la zer/125—

4 7 bad —4na bdag med/ chos kyi bdag med dang gang zag gi bdag med dang /bdag po med pa la'ang zer/bda' ba/ ro zhim po'am ro mngar ba la ro bda' ba'ang zer/bdud khar lcags ri rtse dgu/ bdud klu btsan rgyal po'i ma /bar rdzong la zer/bdud rje khyab pa lag ring / smug gu'i blon chen zhig gi ming la zer/bdud dam sri/ 'byung bo mi ma yin gdon 'dre lta bu la zer/bdud so gnam gyi dbang phyug byang g.yu ral rgyal po'i bla mchod mthu ngan sngapo/ru/ can zhig la zer/bdud sdig can/ 'dod lha'i bdud dga' rab dbang phyug gam sdig pa gang la me 'dzem pa la zer/bdud bla 'brong zangs rwa dmar po/ byang gi 'brong g.yag nu dmar zhig la zer/bdud ru ṭa/ bdud mi srun ma rungs pa zer bar mtshungs/bdud a khyu ru ṭa/ bdud klu btsan rgyal po'i gung blon 'gran med zhig la zer/bdud bzhi/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ phung ba'i bdud lha'i bdud 126

'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi la zer/ bde skyong / thod pa'am mgo rus ka bā li la zer/bde chen 'khor lo/ spyi gtsug gi ming / spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo zer bden skyes/ bden rtags kyi legs skyes sor gdub sogs phul ba spa zer /ḍadzārdo༄mdang skyes sprug gu/ mdang dgong skyes pa'i byis pa la zer/ mdang sum/ nam stod nam gung na ma snad gsum la mdang sum — — zer/ mda' skyob/ go cha'am lcags gos la zer/mda' kha dbe' rtsal/ dpa' brtul rnams kyis lag rtsal dang —mtheb rtsal rta rtsal sogs la brtsis blangs pa la zer/mda' 'khyar/ mda' mo sus 'phangs 'dis 'phangs med pa'i mda' 'khyams la zer/mda' gsum chu/ lung mdo gsum gyi chu zer ba'i don/ ra dang rgod sgro ma/ rgod sgro bstad pa'i mde' la rgod sgro ma zer/mda' 'gran ja yun tsam/ phan tshun mda' 'gran ja 'thung yun tsam byas zer/ 127

mda' rgyang gang / mda' gcig 'phangs pa'i thon tshad la mda' rgyang gang zer/mda' rgyab ma gnyis/ mda' gzhug ma'am mda' rjes ma zer ——ba'i don/mda' dar/ mda' sker dar btags pa'i mda' la mda' dar —zer/mda' dog lung ba'i 'gag 'phrang dog pa'i don la zer/mda' dong ba gang / mda' mda' shubs gang zer ba'i don/mda' gdang sgrig mda' mang mnyam gcig tu 'phangs pa la —mda' gdang sgrig zer/mda' sne drangs/ lha klu gnyan gsum gyis dgra phyogs su mda' sne drangs zer ba'i don/mda' spri ngas byung ba/ mda' 'phangs zer ba la mda' springs zer/mda' pa/ mda' 'phen mkhan la mda' pa'am mda' mkhan yang zer/mda' tshan/ mda' 'gran byed pa'i tshan khag la mda' tshan zer/mda' mtshal ltong / mda'i ltong kha mtshal dmar gyis dhegs pa la mchal stong ma zer/mda' mtshon mang du deg kyang / mda' mtshon gyis mang du 128

brgyab kyang zer ba'i don/ mja' zhig brdzangs/ mda' zhig 'phangs zer ba'i don/mda' 'og dzu btang / mda' mtshon 'og nas bsad pa la zer/mda' ya mi 'ong / mda' 'phenar mda' ya'am tshig bshad na kha ya mi 'ong zer ba'i don/mda' yig jidzings mda' ske la yi ge btags bas sbrings pa la — mda' yig zer/mda' la rgya zhing / mdo na rgya zhing gru bzhi yod zer ba'i don/brda rnying la mdo la mda' zer/ mda' shar byed/ mda' mang mnyam gtong byed pa'i don/mda' bgrings pa/ mda' 'phangs pa'i don la zer/ 4mdung nga〈pes/ mdung sked lcags kyis dkris pa la mdung dkris —zer/mdung gis bkrongs/ mdung gis bsad zer ba'i don/ bkrong ni bsad pa'i don/mdung gi ba dan/ mdung sked kyi rnga rtsid dmar bo la zer/mdung pa/ mdung thogs pa la mdung pa zer /mdung dor/ rgyan dor ba'am tho dang rgyal btsugs nas rtsed mo tshe ba'i don/ mdung so sgro gang / mdung so mdung mgol zer/ mdung mgo sgro 129

ba gang zer ba'i don/ra dung bsor/ mdung phyar ba'am mdung bskor ba'i don/mdur bdar/ mi mang mdun grabs bsgrigs pa la zer/ma dum 'dug pa/ rgyal po'i nang blon dang drung yig sogs la zer/mdun sna sa/ bu mo gnas la 'gro sa'i gnyen tshang la sngon sna sa zer/mdun na 'don/ rgyal po'i bla mchod dang blon po la zer/ma dun sa chos bzang / lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyis chos zhu sa'i—khang bzang la zer/mde'u sne la sbyar tshar/ mde'u sne nas bsad tshar zer ba'i don/mde'u rtse nas zi ra bang tsam/ mde'u rtse nas me lce dum zhig ོchad zer ba'i don/mdo khams lgang drug zal mo sgang / tsha ba sgang / smar khams sgang / spo 'bor sgang / dmar rdza sgang /mi nyag rab sgang ngo //mdo khams chos rgyal/ gling dkar mi yi dbang bo seng chen rgyal thol zer/mdo khams smad/ bod yul la mdo stod dang mdo smad gnyis yodaskopa las a mdo'i yul 'di la mdo smad zer/130

mdo sngagabaska mdo dang sngags gnyas kyi ming bsdus pas mdo sngags zer/mdo gling bde skyid/ mdo khams gling gi bde skyid zer ba'i don/mdong mo/ ja srub byed kyi ja mdong gi ming la zer/4 khodzārde—༄ ra dan spug da ra kha che/ khro thung gilogling gi tsha zhang 'danab la ngan ming btags pa red/ 'dan bu brgyab/ sgo la gtad brgyab pa'i don la zer/ 'dan ma byang khra/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i chos blon grub chen sa rā ha'i rnam sprul tsha zhang 'dan ma la zer/'dab chags/ bya rigs la 'dab chags sam 'dab ldan zer/'dab stong / me tog gi ming / 'dab stong ngam 'dab brgya yang zer 'dar skad shor/ 'jigs skrag skyes tshe skad cha bshad dus skad —'dar ba la zer/ 'dar si li li/ grang nas 'dar sig sig zer ba'i don/'dar 'das/ gshegs gsheg4sam shi shi zer ba'i don / 'di mus bsdad pa/ 'di nas mu mthu da du bsdad zer ba'i don/'di mus bzhag na/ 'di yun ring du bzhag na zer ba'i don/9 131

'du ra bsdus/ gro ga rar tshogs pa la 'du ra bsdus zer/'dun ma/ dmigs/ gtad byed pa la 'dun ma byed pa zer/'dum 'grig gyod dang kha mchu bsdums pa'i don la zer/'dur rgyugs/ rta bang ma 'dur gyis rgyugs pa la zer/'do ba gu gu rog cog stag rong khro thung gi chibs rta'i ming la gebazer/'a do drug rta/ rta pho la dbyibs dang kha dog gom 'gros drug tshang la 'do drug zer/'do rje/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i chibs pa rta rkyang rgod la zer/'do ba gro lo kha dmar/ gling gi skye yag nyi ma rang shar gyi chibs —pa la zer/'do ba gro lo thod skya/ hor sdig spyod shan pa'i chibs pa zhig gi —ming /'do bas na thang khyab/ rta mang khyu yis na ba dang thang gzhung khyab pa'i don/'dod khams rgyal mo/ lha mo'i mtshan/ 'di nas 'brug mo lazer/'dod rgu/ 'dod pa yod do cog la 'dod rgu zer/ 'di la dasazhes 'bri ba'ang yod/'dod yon lnga/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg bya lnga la zer/132

ḍadzāje—༄ 'dre grin gnyis/ chos lugs kyi bshad srol/ mimin 'dre dngasrin po gnyis zer ba'i don/'dre rje she le rkang gcig hor gyi sa srung 'dre srin thel mo rkang —gcig la zer/'dre bya/ 'ug pa'ababya sreg ngala'abyung bya'am 'dre bya zer/'dred sdog thengs gsum/ rtas 'gyel log thengs gsum brgyab zer/'dregs mgo mgo krog krog dang rna ba cor cor byed ba la —'drogs mgo zer/nga8nga༄ rnang bag spre'u sogs 'dogs pa'i thag ngalazer/jung mon/ rnga dang lcags brdungs pa'i dus zhes tshe skabasabastan ngasayin/deg bcog rdung deg gi brda rnying ladeg btsog zer /de'u༅ chab 'apen/ de'u bu chu la 'a ngas zer/ chab ni chulodon/ge'u bzhi/ rdo chung ri ribangade'u zer/ rdo ril bzhi zer/133

rdo dkar gyi bse mkhar/ rdo dkar gyi 'bum khang lta bu la rdo ོdkar bse mkhar zer/rdo mkhar sgong / cong zhu 'dra ba'i rdo dkar po zhig la zenā/rdo ོ//ra ma chag rtse sil le/ rdo bcags nas sil bar btang ba la zer/rdo gong ma chag nyil du btang / rta rmig gi ngar gyis rdo bcag ste sil bar btang ba la zer/rdo mgor mog phyon/ mi dpa' med rdo mgor rmog gyon zer ba'i don/rdo sgrom/ rdo bsgri gas pas gru bzhi sgam lta bu ba zos pa la zer/rdo rje phag mo/ mkha' 'gro ma zhig gi mtshan la zer/rdo rje gdan/ rgya gar yul dbus kyi lte ba rdo rje gdan la'o//rdo rje ngamyal ba/ tsha dmyal brgyad las mnar med kyi ming la zer/rdo rje'i zi ra rdo rje'i me stag ga ma rdo rje'i tsha tsha zer ba'i don/rdo rje g.yu sgro na/ tshe ring mched lnga'i zhig gi ming la zer/rdo rje lag ba/ brgya byin dang dam can gnyis la rdor lag zer/rdo rta lung ba/ 'do rta lung ba'ang zer gli ra gi sa/ ming zhigardo thung hrug ger btang / rdo dum par hrug ger btang ni chag —nyil du btang ba'i don/tsho / pha wang / rdo nag shwa rde'u 'dra ba zer/ rdo stang zil 'ang zer/rdo pha bong cha lang rdab 'dra/ rdo pha bong bub cha rdung 'dra brer —134

— ba'i don/rdo 'kha skon/ r+shasdar ma rdo logo4bskon 'dra zhes smad pa'i——tshigardo la brnab / rdo la brgyab zer ba dang gcig mtshungs/rdo stodagan/ cong zhu lta bu'i rdo dkar po zhig la zer/rdo ma dbar lug grod/ rdo dkar lugo gi grod pu tsam zer ba'i ——don/ rdo a ra nag po/ rdo stang zilanag po la zer ba e yin snyam/rdo'i thu lam/ rdo'i gong bu'am lcags kyi thu lam ni lcags go la ——zer/rdog ga ma thon/ ban 'bras ma byung zer ba'i don/rdog klongagabargyab/ rkang the brgyab zer ba yin nam snyam/ rdog sne rdo la thug 'gro ma shes rkang sne rdo la thug zer ba'i don/ rdog dzeb/0rta la ya deb byed pa la rdog deb zer/rdog pa rdo mkhanatad/ rkang sne rdo la gtad nas rgyal kha blangs ——zer/rdog pas mnan/ rkang bas rdog brdziyobyasab lazer/rdog 'og tu drangs/ mi rtas rkang 'og tu mnan ba'i don la zer/ 135

kho8nga༄lding khang / khang pa bya 'dab can la lding khang zer/ldi nga 'dod/ bya 'phur 'dod yod pa la lding 'dod yod ba'ang zer/ldong gi rgyud/ bod mirus rgyud dga' 'bri sdong gsum las ldong gi rgyud pa zer pa'i don/ldong gi bu rgyud/ bod dga' 'bri sdong gsumalas sdong rus su gtogs pa'i bu rgyud la zer/khoto༄༄snar skad 'don pa/ dpa' zhum ste gnyom skad 'don ba la zer/sdar glu/ skrag glu'am sdar glu zer ba'i don/ring glu ha ra hu5rgyang / khro thung gi glu la zer/ ha ra hu thung ni mgo med—mjug med rgas po'i 'chol nga / 〉 ma — 'dra ba la zer/sdar ma ser chung / snying med ser chung wa 'dra zer bas ngan smras byas/jig pa ra tsa'5bya lnga/ shan pa moru/ glang bo khra 'bar/ nam mkha' sbar 'dzin/ ri bo pang bskor/ rlung nag rjes gcod do//136

jig rwa/ sdig pa rwa tsa zer ba'i 'bu srin zhig gi ming / jig sher gtong / smre ngag 'don pa'am sdug gtam bshad pa la — zer/jing ri mi rgan/ 'jang gi ri chen zhig gi ming la zer/sdug gu ma/ bud med mdzes ma'am mchog gyur ma la ther/sngud shog springs/ yi ge bskur ba la springs pa'ang zer/sdug lhags ba/ sdug grang reg rlung gis sngon nas bsus zer ba'i —don/sdug a thang chad/ ha cang sdug thug pa'i don la ze ra/sdug bsngal khur khyer/ sdug bsngal bzod nus pa'i don la zer/sdug a thang yang thang / sdug yang dang yang du mthong ba'i don la zer/rje brgyad/ lha/ klu/ bdud/ btsan/ rgyal po/ gza'/ ma mo/ lha min rnams so//sde dpon khag dpon po blon po mi rgan che khag la zer/rje lan/ rang sde dngos su mi gtogs pa'i tsha zhang dang mtha' 'dug pa la sde yan zer/ sder kha/ zas sna mang po sder ma'i nang du bsgrigs pa la sder kha zer/lder chags/ ri dwags sder thogs sna tshogs la sder chags zer/ sdongs grogs/ rogs ram dang mgon skyabs byas pa'i don/ 137

sdong dum byag ger/ sdong bo bcad gtubs byas pas dum bu la sdong dum hrug ger btang zer/sdod tshugangasga pa/ 'dug bzod dang 'dug thub pa zer ba'i don/sdom nyams bla ma/ sdom pa dang tshul khrimaru/ nyams pa'i bla btsun la zer/bci ma dgos/ rtsod gleng dang kha mchu 'grikhu/ tu bcug pa la kha mchu bsdums zer/ 7 na4 4——— na kra/ chu srin chen po la na kra zer/ legs sbyar skad/na kra'i grong / rgya mtsho'i ming la na kra'i grong khyer zer/na ga legs sbyar ska da/ bsgyur na klu'i ming la zer/na ga rā dza / legs sbyar skad/ bod skad du bsgyur na klu'i rgyal po zer// chung sman la skyo na chung bamoradaga'azhes pa'i ngon spyomizhe sde'i/ / rigi sbyi da /sdo / 11/ dga' ba'i don/ sha la skyo zer ba sha la dga' zer ba'i don /na mdog na ba med la na khul byas pa la na mdog zer/na mnyam pa/ na zla'am na tshod mnyam pa la zer/na raka dmyal ba'i rming / na raka dmyal ba yan chad zer/na dmar spang / rtswa chu ches mi 'dzoms pa'i na thang che ba la zer/138

na dmar gzhung / rtswa chu med pa'i mya ngam thang 'dra b.ri la zer/na 'obab/ chu shur sa shur la na 'obab kyang zer/na ra tan/ bsam rgyu med/ thag bcad yin zer ba'i don dang mthun/na ro pa/ rgya gar gyi thub chen zhig gi mtshan la zer/ na so gcig rta'i lo che chung la na so zer/na so mtho/ dwagung lo mtho ba la na so mtho yang zer/ rā ga'i grong / klu'i grong khyer zer ba'i don/nag rgyang rgyang shor/ mdog nges can gsal bo ma mthong bas dbyibs la brtag nas bshad pa'o//nag chags/ bud med kyi ming / sa cha la las bud med la na ga chags zer/nag phyogs/ zla ba mar ngo la nag phyogs sam dmar phyogs kyang zer/nag pa bla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla gsum pa la zer nag po skya/ rta nag can la nag po skya zer/nag po 'thong 'dur/ stag gzig rgyal po'i chibs rta'i ming /nag phran/ mda' yi spyi ming la nag phran nam nyag phran zer/nag mo kha tshan za/ nag mo bud med spyi'i ming / nag mo kha btsan che ba'am skad cha mang ba'i don la'o//139

nag ril le 'gyel/ rta thog nas nag ril le lhung song zer ba'i don/nags kyi gar ma khan/ spre'u la zer/ mngon brjod kyi ming /nags ri 'breg 'breg shing sdong gcod gcod zer ba'i don/nags kyi hi ra/ phag rgod la zer/ mngon brjod kyi ming /nang 'khon/ gnyen nye du'i nang ma 'cham par 'khon pa la nang ོ'khon zer/nang gos sprin dkar mdangs 'dzin/ dar dkar po'i tshil ོlen la zer/nang chos/ nang ba'i grub mtha' 'am chos lugs zer ba'i don/na nga nye bas brnyas na/ nang phu nus brnyas na zhe re rmongs zer — ba'i don/nang rtags phyir bstan/ khog nas ci dran phyi'i rnam 'gyur thog tu mngon pa la zer/nang blon/ rgyal po'i gam du bya ba byed pa'i mi la nang blon zer/nang blon sro ma badzu/ ge sar rgyal po'i nang blon zhig gi ming /na nga ma 'cham pa/ rang sde nang ma mthun pa'am kha ma 'cham pa lashezer/nang dme byed/ nang 'khrugs byas pas mi bsad pa la nang dme zer/140

mkha gru gu ldog ldog nang rtsa gru gu lding sding zer ba e yin snyam/nang so/ nang gi gnas tshul mtha' dag brtags mi la nang so zer/nad mdog ston/ lus na na tsha med par yod khul byed pa la nad— mdog zer/na brgya rtsa bzhi/ rlung las brgya dang gcig mkhris pa las brgya dang gcig bad kun las brgya dang snya gcig gsum ga las gyur pa'i brgya dang rtso gcig go/ nam mkha' ma gsal/ skya rengs masharagong zer ba'i don/nam mkha'i mig nyi ma'i ming / nam mkha'i nor bu'ang zer/ nam stong / nyi zla lhan cig gnas pa'i nyin gyi ming /nu bo klu sprul 'od dkar/ seng chen rgyal po'i rjes skyes nu bo'i —ming nu bo rong tsha dmar leb/ ge sar rgyal po'i rting skyes nu bo la zesanub snangab mtha' yas/ mgon po 'od dpag med kyi mtshan/nub phyogabasnyachu lha/ nub 6phyogs skyong chu lha la zer/ nus med g.yag lu/ nus stobs zhan pa'i g.yag lu 'dra zer ba'i—don/ g.yag chung chung la g.yag gu'am ga77ga lu zer/ ne ne gnam sman/ ma ne ne gong sman rgyal mo la zer/ne'u glag bra tsig gsod pa'i bya zhig gi ming la zer/141

ne'u le/ sre mong 'dra ba'i srog chags chung ngu zhig 'a/ zer/ne'u gsing / spang gzhung me tog gis mdzes pa la zer/ne le'u nug phung / brag khung ngam brag gseb tu a bra'i rtug pa ོspungs pa la zer/nor bu rta mgo shang shang rgyal po'i rin thang bral ba'i khyad nor —zhig gi ming /nor bu rta mgo me 'bar/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i rin thang bral ba'i khyad nor zhig la zer/nor bdag rnam thos sras dang dzasnya la la zer/nor dmar mo/ gser dngul rkyang ba kho na la zer/nor srung / khyi yi ming / mngon brjod las nor srung ngam nor skyong yang zer/nor 'dzin bu mo/ sa gzhi'am gzhon nu ma la'ang zer/nor srung gtum po/ khyi btsan po la nor srung gtum po zer/nor 'dzin skyong ba/ rgyal po chen po'i ming / nor 'dzin dbang bo'ang zer/9tsho rgerne——5)gnag sems/ kun la sems ngan 'chang ba la gnag sem/sa can zer/142

gnang bkag rung ba la gnang ba dang mi rung ba bkag pa la gnang bkag zer/gnang chod/ jag pas rta nor chod pa la gonang chod zer/gnang tshur blangs/ rgyu nor tshur thob pa la gnang tshur blangs zer/gnam 'khor lozhwa bas brgyad/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi gzugs su bkod pa yin/gnam dgu thig gnam gyi sgal ba la dgu thig kyang zer/gnam sngo lu/ dgung sngon po'am gnam sngon po zer ba'i don/gnam sngon ma snyob mtho gang / gnam la mtho gang gis reg go nus zer ba'i don/gnam lcags// glog dang thog dang 'brug sgra bcas la zer gorname lcagos khro mkhar/ gling skyes mchog thar ba'i zor sna'i mkhor rdzong la zer/gnam lcags khung rdzong / mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i mkhar rdzong la zer gnam rje/ gur dkar la zer/ gnam gyi rje bo gur dkar zer/gnam thel/ gnam thel dkar po zhes gur dkar gyi skyob lha zhig gi midza la zer ‘gnam thel dkar po'i ten mdung / gnam thel gnas pa'i bla rten dar mdung zhig la zer bar snyam/143

gnam nag mtshan mo'i mun smag 'thibs pa zer/gnam mtsho/ byang gi gnam mtsho phyug mo la zer/gnam yag bang ma bul/ rta gnam yag sngon mo bang ma dal zer ba'i don/gnam ru/ gzhu yi ming / nyag phran mda' dang gnam ru gzhu zer/gnam la bya rgya/ gnam la 'phur lam med pa'i bya rgya bzhag zer ba'i don/ rgya ni rnyi la zer/gnam la 'phur dgu/ bya dang bye'u nam mkhar 'phur ba sogs la zer/gnam lo/ da lo'i lo 'di zer ba'i don dang mtshungs/gnam sa ba/nyis kyi ya bdag gnam sa gnyis kyi bdag po zer ba'i don/gnam lha btsan po/ byang gru gu thog rgod rgyal po'i dmag dpon zhig gi ming / 98)༄mna' bskyal/ mna' bskya'/ ba'am mna' bor ba'i don/mna' dpang / mna' bor tshe bar du bzhag pa'i lha la mna' sadapang zer/144

mna' brgags/ mna' btsan gyis bskyal du bcug pa'i don la —zer mna' ma pher nges/ mna' ma nyan nges can red zer ba'i don/mna' shag mna' ya shag ro gas gnyis la mna' shag zer/mnar med/ tsha dmyal brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig la zer/mnal lam/ rmi lam dang rmi ltas la zer/mnol bsang / btsoka grib gtsang mar byas pa mnol bsang phul —zer gnas nas dbyung ba/ gnas nas phyi rol tu sgyugs pa la zer/kho8nga༄ rna kor/ rna rgyan dang rna long la rna kor yang zer/rna g.yu/ rna ba'i rgyan dang rna long la zer/rnam mkhyen/ sangs rgyas dang mkhas pa la'o / rnam rgyal khang bzang / lha'i dbang bo brgya byin gyi khang bzang la—zer/rnam shes drug mig gi rnam shes/ rna ba'i rnam shes/ sna yi rnam shes/ lce yi rnam shes/ lus kyi rnam shes/yid kyi rnam shes so//sna myur skya khra hor ba/ gling ge sar la ngag gi dpal ster ba'i lha —143

zhig la zer/non po gu se skya ring / 'jang g.yu lha thog 'gyur gyi ral gri ri ming /rdon po gsum/ dpa' bo'i 'a/bor gsum mda' mdung ral gri gsum la zer /( rnyi༄—༄ sna/ shur las me stag chad/ sna khung las me stag chad zer ba'i don/sna nga ca / gzhon nu'am bu chung la zer/ brda rnying la bu chung la snang ngu zer/snang ca dgra khar brdzangs/ snang ngu g.yu stag khro thung gis hor lag tu bzhag pa la zer/snang ca bzhi/ snang ngu g.yu stag snang ngu 'brug rgyal/ snang ngu a 'bon/ dpal gsar zla ba bzhi la zer/snang ngor/ semam la shar ba'am mig lam du shar ba la zer/snang brnyan/ sku gzugs sam brnyan dpar lta bu la zer/snang ba'i bdag po/ nyi ma'i ming / snang ba'i mdzod kyang zer/snam dkar/ bal gyis bzos pa'i snam bu dkar po la snam da shar zer/146

snod drug rgyu ma/ long ga pho ba/ gnye ma/ lgang bu/ mkhris pa rnams so//smon zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla lnga pa la zer/ḍadzāng༄ba dur / dpa' bo'i ming / pa dur ram pa thur zer/ dpa' brtul zhes pa sog skad du zur chagab dur mchong lha smug po/ dpa' rgod mchong lha smug po zer/hor gyi dpa' bo zhig gi ming /mā ra ha/ da bya ga rja zhig dang / lha zhig gi mtshan nam gang yin cha ma 'tshal/pasku/ rgya gar gyi chu chen zhig gi ming la zer/pags bye'u/ pha wang ngam bye'u 'phang ba'ang zer/pang khebs khro zhal can/ pang khebs khro bo'i zhal khyim can la zer/pad dkar 'chang / spyan mas gzigs kyi mtshan/ pad dkar 'dzin yang zer/pad+ma kā ra/ o rgyan pad ma'i mtshan grangs shig la'o//paspa thod breng rtsal/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi mtshan la zer/pami rā ga rin po che shel rdo dmar po 'dra ba zhig la zer/ 147

pad+ma sam bha wa/ slob dpon pad+ma'i mtshan grangs shig la zer /pu lo ma dgra/ lha'i dbang bo brgya byin la zer/pur sgrom/ gdung sgam mam ro sgam zer ba'i don/pu 'u 'dra/ dri bzhon rlung dang 'dra zer ba e yin snyam/pu shud/ khang pa'i mda' yab bam lan kun la zer/pur rgyal yul/ bod kyi ming / bod kyi yul zer ba'i don/pur sbyang / sku gdu nga me la bsregs pa la zer/pe har/ rgyal po'i ming / pe har srid pa'i srog bdag zer/po ta la / lha sa'i po ta la la zer/ bsgyur na gru 'dzin ri bo zer/ po ti/ dpe cha'am glegs bam la zer/9 tram̐ng༄bra gzan ne'u le/ pra tsig gsod pa'i bya chung zhig la zer/za lag tsha ba/ khrel med las rgyu dran rgyu mang ba'i don la zer/bre ta'i yul/ yi dwags kyi yul zer/ bre ta ni bsgyur na 64 dwagayola'o///ḍa rdordo༄dpag bsam shing / lha'i ljon shing bzang po zhig gi ming /dpa' dam/ ral gri ring bo'i ming la zer/148

dpa' kha ran tshod/ phan tshun 'thab tshod bzung ba'i don la/ ོzer/dba' kha lon/ 'thab ya'am ngo ya lon pa'i don la zer/ dba' bgres gzhon/ dpa' bo rgan gzhon mtha' dag zer ba'i don/dpa' mgon mdzod/ dpa' rogs dpung grogs mdzod ces pa'i don/dba' jams ldan pa/ rngams brjid ldan pa 'jigs su rung ba'i don/dba' chag pa/ dpa' rtsal nyams pa'am nus stobs zhan pa la zer/dpa' chos lus la rdzogs/ khrab rmog gyon pa'am 'khor gsub btags pa la zer/dba' snying spyang gsum/ dpa' zhing mdzangs la rig pa ldan pa la zer/dpa' brtul dgyus ma/ dpa' thul gzhung ma zer ba lags/ dpa' bachul zhi ma gson/ dpa' nyams pa'i don/ shi ma gson ni phyi srog chad nas nang srog ma chad pa lta bu la zer/dpa' bang chad pa/ phan tshun 'thab pa mang drags pas lus thang chad pa la zer/149

dpa' thul phyed gron song / gling gi dpa' thul phyed ka hor gyis bkrongs zer ba'i don/dpa' dar 'then/ dpa' bo la bstod bsngags dang kha btags 'then pa la dpa' dar 'then zer/dpal po stag chas can/ stag lpags kyi stod gos gyon pa la stag chas can zer/dpa' po byus shi dpa' bo rgyal khab kyi don du shi ba la byus shi zer/ jus shi zer ba'i don/dang 'a bo'i chos drug khrab rmog phub gsum dang mda' mdung ral gri gsum ste 'di drug la zer/dpa' po'i rtsal gsum/ dpa' rtsal ma nyams lus stobs ma zhan zer ba'i don/dpa' po'i rtsal ma zhan/ mon shing khri rgyal po'i blon de yod cig la zer/dpa' dam 'chang / gri mgo nas bzung zer ba'i don/dpa' zhe nas chags/ dpa' sems nas nyams pa zer/dpa' mdzangs nus gsum/ blo rig rtsal gsum 'dzoms pa la zer/dpa' ya med/ dpa' 'gran med zer ba'i don/dpa' bzi/ nga che/ dpa' nyams ldan pa'am dpa' brjid che ba'i 150

don/dpa' lag snga byas/ mtshon g.yug na lag gang snga byas pa'i don la zer/dpa' lung / ral gri'i yu bar dar btags pa la dpa' lung zer/dpa' lung ma dzub mgor/ ral gri'i lung bu la dpa' lung zer/dpa' lung mdzub mgor dkris pa'i don/dpa' hang ba zhig hang ba ni 'tshabs che ba'i don thugs 'tshabs che ba la zer dpa' a ya med/ dpa' kha ya dang ngo ya med zer ba'i don/dpal mkhar gru bzhi/ la btsas ming la dpal mkhar zer/ de'i stegs pu la zer/dpal mo ngapal thang / stod mnga' ris thang gzhung zhig la zer/dpal rong gnyis/ mon gyi sde khag gi ming / nyin gyi dpal sde dang srib kyi rong sde gnyis gcig tu bsdoms nas dpal rong gnyis zer/dpung khrab brjes/ khrab kyi phu dung yar badzes pa la zer/dpung gi ru 'dren/ ru ni dmag la zer/ dmag sna 'dren pa'i don la'o// daphung gi ru sna/ dmag dpon nam dmag gi 'go 'dren la zer/151

dpung rgyab chad/ dmag dpung nyung ngu rgyab snon med pa la rgyab chad zer/dpung chen btegs pa/ dmag chen lam du chas ba la dpung chen btegaca zer/dpung gdang bsgrigs/ dmag mang gis dpung ba bzhibs te gral tu bsgrigs pa la zer/dpung ba brjes/ gos kyi phu dung dpung steng du badzes pa la zer/dpung ba nyams sgril/ mi mang gis lag gdang sgril pa la zer/dpung bu chung / rkang dmab/ la dpung bu chung gi dmag zer/dpung zla/ dpung ya'am dpung grogs zer ba'i don/dpung grag dmag rgod rta rgod sogs la dpung hrag zer/dpon mgo brgyad cu/ phyogs phyogs kyi dmag dpon brgyad cu la zer/dpon chung lce bde/ hor nya ba'i phyogs kyi dpon chung zhig gi ming /dpon po ḍā ru mgo stag rong dpon po khro thung la zer/ kho ngo gnyis yin pas don la zer/dpon a gnam khri dga'/ hor stag zhu gur dkar rgyal po'i ོming grangs shigadapon lu/ dpon chu nga la dpon lu zer/ go sa chung ba'i don/152

( rdobye༄dbya khral/ dbyar gsum mar khral/ dgun gsum sha khralazer ba'i don/dpyang thag the tshom la zer/ gos sogs 'gel sa'i thag pa la'ang zer/dpyad gsum/ bsreg bcad brdar ba gsum gyis dpyad pa byas ngal zer/dpyid kyi pho nya/ khu byug gi ming / dpyid kyi rgyal mo yang zer/dbyid zla gsum/ lugs rnying hor zla dang po gnyis pa gsum pa la zer/dbyid bla ra ba/ ra ba dang po'i don/ lugs rnying hor zla dang po zer ba yin/ ḍardono༄dbral ko mthug po/ ngo tsha khrel med u tshugs can la zer/dpal ba'i dung por/ hor shan pa'i klad phor thang la 'phangs zer /dpral ba'i dung phor ni thod phor la zer/153

— rno4— ༄spa drug lha sa'i a ma la'i byu ru'i thor lcog la pa cog dang pa sgrug kyang zer/ spang bkong / dgra pha rol pham par byas pa'i don/ spa bkong ba yang zer/spang mkhar na ro dgu brtsegs/ a stag klu mo'i bzhugs mkhar la zer/spar kha da la babs/ spar kha brgyad las spar kha da lcags la babs zer/spar kha brgyad/ li me/ khon sa/ da lcags/ khen gnam/khams chu/ kin ri/ tsin shing / zon rlung ngo //spu kha/ rta'i spu mdog la spu kha zer/ spu kha rkyang rkyang zer ba ltar ro//spu zhag 'khyil le/ spu mdangs ma snog pa'i don sgyur spu nab 'khyil le zer/spur bzhu ba/ gdung me la bsregs pa la zer/ pur bzhu ba'ang zer/spen rgyan/ lha khang 'du khang steng gi spen thog la zer/ spen rgyan yang zer/154

spen bar/ lha khang steng gi spen thog la spen pad kyang zer/ spen lung chung ba/ spen ma'i nags tshal yod pa'i lung ba chung ngu zhig la zer/spo tho/ spang lab gru bzhi la zer/ la las spang sha yang zer/spos dkar shing / shing sā la'i ming / de'i thang chu la spos dkar zer 4ḍahūṃng༄spyang ga ma'i ngu zug spyang kis skad ngan 'don pa la ngu zug zer/spung ke lug shas brnangs/ spyang ltogs pas lug sha za che nas mid thag 'gag pa la brnangs zer/spyang grung can/ blo rno ba'am rig pa can la zer/spyang grung bagling gsum/ mkhas mdzangs brtan gsum zer/brling ni brtan brjid la zer/spyang thong rgyag rgyag spyang gzhon rgyug rgyug zer ba'i don/sprung thong sha gzan/ spyang sha zan zer ba'i nag po'i don la dga' ba la zer/spyang mdog kha pho'i tshig mi mkhas mkhas mdog byed pa la zer/spyang mo wa lu spe li/ mthing hor gnyis kyi sa mtshams kyi ri chen zhig la zer/155

spyang a thong / spyang dar ma la zer/ dar ma ni gzhon pa'i don/spyad lo mang ba/ ngan spyod mang ba'i don la zer/spyan chab shor/ mig chu bzhur ba'i dom/ spyan chab ni zhe sa 'i tshigaspyan mchi zhag sgo na re/ mig mchi ma gor re zer/ rgyun du mig mtha' mchi mas bskor ba la zer/spyan pa/ so ba'am bya ra ba dang gnyem pa 'a 'ang zer/spyan tshugs med/ mig mi 'dzum pa'i don la zer/spyan gzigs/ lha khang mgon khang nang du srog chags sna tshogs bshams pa la spyan gzigs zer/spyan hrig hrig spyan rig rig blta ba la spyan hrig hrig bltas zer/spyi khrab pa/ thun mong spyi'i dpon po la spyi dpon na ma spyi khyab pa zer/spyi bstabs/ spyi'i 'bul ba phul ba'i don/ bstabs ni phul ba'i don/sbyi dpon rgan po/ gling spyi dpon khra rgan rgyal po la zer/spyi za'i bro mchog byang tshwa dkar po la zer bar snyam/spri dpon g.yu sgong brag la brnabs/ spyi dpon khra rgan gyi sras snang ngu g.yu stag hor gyis bkrongs pa la zer/156

9—ṭ+wāṃ4—༄spa ba'i me tog spra ba ni rtswa ldum zhig gi ming / mgo skyes spra ba'i me tog ltar dkar por gyur zer ba'i don/spang khrims/ sprang po la sogs pa la khrims bzhag pa la sprang khrims zer/ sprang gar ba/ sprang pos gar byed pa la sprang gar pa zer/sprang rgan ba/ sprang po rgan pha a ra can zer ba'i don/sprang rgyug sbrang po'i lag gi dbyug pa'am rgyun lcag la zer/sprang smos bu'i gar pa/ a tsa ra lta bu'i mgo lus la sgrom bus ——brgyan pa'i zlos gar rtsed mkhan la zer/sprang nyog nus pa med pa'i sprang dmag nya ga nyog ge zer ba'i don/sprang nyog zar gang/ sprang zas 'khyor ba gang zer ba'i don/sbrang lto slorngo ba/ sbrang pos zas slong ba la sprang lto slong zer/sprang long zha 'theng/ sprang po zha bo long ba gsum la sprang long zha snye 'theng zer/sbyin gyi gdengs ba sprin rum dang sprin phung la zer/ smin gyi me chen/ thog dang glog gi ming la sbrin gyi me bo che'ang zer/smin gyi rol mo/ 'brug sgra'i ming / sprin sgra'ang zer/zin mgrin/ mi spyi'i ming lazer ba yin/157

spri na bar nyi ma/ dga' sdug gi don lan re dga' zhing lan re sduganyi ma'ang sprin bar nas lan re mthong zhing lan re mi mthong ba'i dpe'o//rgyun raba'idakar po'i la thod/ gos dkar sprin ris can gyi ོthod bcings la zer/sprin gyi rol mo/ 'brug gi ming la zer/ mngon brjod kyi ming /spris ma chags/ 'o kha chags pa la spris ma chags zer/sprel bya lag can/ spre'u 'dug mi bzod pa'i bya byed mang ba'i don la zer/sprel bla ra ba/ lugs rnying hor zla bdun pa la zer/ ra ba ni dngapo'i don/7 rno5— pha rgan/ yab dgung lo bgres pa la pha rgan zer/pha chen rus 'u/ pha rus sam pha ming la zer/pha maba' yas/ mtha' med pa'am grangs med pa'i don/pha wang long bu/ rdo nag po gru bzhi shwa rde'u 'dra ba la zer/pha chos ducasapa bcu gnyis/ chos gser yum dum pa bcu gnyis —la zer/pha spad gnyis/ pha dang bu gnyis la zer/ pha bu gnyis zer ba'i 158

don/ nga pha pha khu/ a myes yang myes sam 75 pha a khu la zer/ pha 'bum/ pha chos ma chos zhes pa'i yum po ti bcu gnyis la'o//pha mal bu yis 'dzin/ pha shul bu yis 'dzin zer ba'i don/pha wang/ pags bye'u la pha wang rgan po'ang zer/pha gzhis/ pha myes kyi gzhis ku'am pha khyim la zer/pha bzang bo'i chos brol/ pha mes kyi srol rgyun bzang bo zer ba'i 0 don/pha yi bu/ a pha'i bu zer/ gtam dgos med ma bshad a pha'i bu zer ba'i don/pha rabs zhang rabs/ pha'i rabs dang zhang bo'i rabs zer ba'i don/ pha sa ma khungs/ pha rgyud ma rgyud rigs rus sogs ci 'dra zer ba'i don/ pha srin pos nya khrims bsrungs/ srin pos tshes bco lnga'i nyin sems can gang yin gyi srog mi gcod pas nya khrims bsrungs zer/phag rgod/ ri phag la phag rgod zer/phag nas brgyags/ rgyab nas sam lkog nas zer ba'i don/phag mo rdo rje phag mo zhesapa'i mkha' 'gro ma zhig la zer/ 159

phang 'gro/ pi wang ngam/ sgra snyan la zer/phad bu/ snam bu las bzos pa'i sgyes mo la zer/phan tshun 'gyed pa/ dmag phan tshun 'khrugs nas 'thab pa'i don/phar phyin drug sbyin pa/ tshul khrims/ bzod pa/ brtson 'grus/bsam gtan/ shes rab drug go/phar ma byer chur 'dus/ phar ma 'gro tshur 'dus zer ba'i don/phar lab pa/ tshig phar bshad pa la phar lab kyang zer/phu mda'/ lung ba'i phu dang mda' ni phu mdo'i zer ba'i don/phu nu che za med pa/ phu nu che chung med pa zer ba'i don/phu mda' bar gsum/ stod smad bar gsum zer ba'i don/ phu bo dung khyung dkar po/ seng chen rgyal po'i sngon skyes phu bo lazer/phu re med ba/ thams cad mi mthun pa med par kha 'cham pa lazer/phung po lnga/ gzugs kyi phung bo/ tshor ba'i phung bo/ 'du shes kyi phung bo/ 'du byed kyi phung bo/ rnam par shes pa'i phung bo'o//phung bo chu la bgyur/ bsad pa'i gdung chu la bskur ba la zer/phung bshig sta gri/ gtor brlag byed mkhan gyi mi gte bo la zer/ phub rje za dmar ling drug gling seng chen gyi mda' mtshon 'gog 160

byed 6phub la zer phub rul / rta zog gise rtswa zos 'phro'i lhag baṃ la bub rulazer/ phur bu rgyal gyi nyi ma/ gza' phur bu dang skar ma rgyal labab pa'i nyi mar phur bu rgyal gyi nyi ma zer/the rtse nu dag/ khro thung la g.yang snyes nu dgu zer ba'i rin po che zhig yod pa de la zer/pho kha las kyang mo kha ga / pho mgo las kyang mo mgo mtho zer ba'i don/po rgod zhan/ dba' bo'i bzang ngan 'thab na shes zer/ pho grung po/ pho mkhas pa' rig pa rnon po la zer/rwa // // / /sde / 151 //ji /blo/ 1jo /sprerdo brgya da pa shan ba/ brgya 'a gas pa shan pa ra ba don/polhang gdas tsan/ rdzo snyingakhams che ba la snying gdas can zer/pho sdar ma/ mi sbrag shor dngasnying med la zer/po 'do med/ mi rtsa sna mi tshang ba'am snying por pa'i yilazer/po spyang po/ mi mkhas mdzangs can nam shes rab can la zer /pho 'phyor bo/ mdzes pa'i don/ phyor bo phyor mo zer ba sgeg pa'i don/ pho byes 'gro/ phyi rol tu 'gro ba'i mi la byes 'gro zer/po brang gnam lcags khung rdzong / mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i 161

mkhar rdzong la zer/pho brang seng 'brug stag rtse/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i sku mkhar lazer/pho 'brong so drug 'brong g.yag gzhon pa la zer/ kha gang so drug ni lo brgyad dam dgu'i tshad la zer/pho rtsa shi ye med/ pho bsad nas pho shul bcad zer ba'i don/pho yan 'dug mi rkyang ngam kher 'dug 'khyam po sogs la ze'onapho yugs/ chung ma shi ba'i khyo bo la pho yugs zer/pho rang skag steng / lo sngag zla skag zer ba'i mi la bar chad che ba'ilo la 'odaskag zer /po rog bya nag zer/ rog po ni nag po'i don/pho rog snying rdzong / khro thung gi mkhar rdzong la zer/pho sha mo rgyad med/ pho mabasad/ mo ma 'phrogs zer ba'i don/pho len/ pho bsad la dgra sha len pa zer ba'i don/pho shi kha 'tsher na/ pho 'chi kha sdug na'am rmongs na zer ba'i don /pho gsar/ mi pho gzhon nu la pho gsar zer/pho gsar zan cig 'dra/ pho gdong ka le bu mo 'dra ba zer ba'i don/po gsar mo 'dra ba/ pho gzhon bu mo 'dra ba zhes pasasmod tshig162

btang ba red/po bsod zad/ bsod nams med pa'i mi la bsod zad zer/pod kha 'cham lalta bu'i gos kyi gyon pa zhig la zer/por bubs/ dkar yol gyi shubs la phor shubs zer/kho hūṃ/nga༄phya gtong ba/ gsang gtam dgra la bshad pa la phya gtong ba zer/phya brnar/ mo pas mo 'debs tshe mo brdar byas pa la zer/pyag 'khar/ dge slong gophyag 'khar zhes lag rten gyi dbyug pa lazerazag :tang 'dzodzesab mngapos phyag 'tshal ba la gyang log pa ltar zhes pas dpe la bkod/phyag rgyas btab/ tham ga'am thel rtses mnan pa la zer/phyag dgu phrubakhas/ phyag grangs mang 'tshal ba la dgu phrugs zer/pyag brgya phyag 'tshal/ phyag brgya phrag cig 'tshal ba la brgya phyag zer/phyag brnyan/ nang g.yog la zer/ mngag gzhug kyang zer/phyag rtags/ 'bul ba'am mtshams rtags sogs la zer/phyag brten/ dge slong gi phyag 'khar zhes lag rten gyi dbyug pa la163

zer/byag gdang bsgrigs/ mi mang gral cabasgrigs nas phyag 'tshal ngal zer/phyag dar/ gad snyigs dang khyim phyag la zer/phyag phebs/ byon pa'am yong ba'i don la phyag phebs zer/phyag mdzod sbubs ma/ mdzod khang phugs ma'am nang ma zer b.lodon/phyag zhabs sku rjes/ grub rtags kyis rdo dang brag la zhabayorje dang phyag rjes bzhag pa la zer/phyag zhababasabarkyangs/ rkang lag brkyangs pa'i don la zer/phyag shan bton/ ral gri shubasanas bton pa la zer/phyag shan 'a5byags/ ral gri dgra la g.yugs pa la zer/pyag la 'tham 'tham 'chang / phyag gis dam du bzung ba'i dogal zer/phyi khar bstan/ kha phyir phyogs te phyag 'tshal zer ba'i don/phyi 'jam nang chub/ dgra la 'jam zhing gnyen la rtsub pa'i don/phyi mig blta ba/ kha phyir 'khor bas rjes la blta ba la phyi mig zer/phyi blon/ phyi nas las don sgrub pa'i blon po la phyi blon zer/phyi'i 'byung bzhi/ sa chu me rlung bzhi dang mi'i lus phung la'anga'abyu nga bzhi zer/164

phyi na lo gsum/ phyi na ni yi ge ma dag ba 'dra/ 'phyi na'ang 'gor na lo gsum zer ba'i don/phyi rtsa a long kor kor/ lus kyi rtsa ni ha cang 'phar drags pa lazer/phyi bzhin 'brang/ rjes su brnyegs ba'am rjes su 'brang ba la zer/phyi ru mi 'chad/ gsang gtam phyi la mi bshad zer ba'i don/phyi sha la btags/ rta'i phyi 'phong gi sha thag la btags zer ba'i don/phyi so/ phyi dgra'i gnas tshul brtags mkhan la phyi so zer/phyir du 'brang rgyu/ rjes su 'brang dgos zer ba'i don/phyir 'dengs ba/ phyi ru 'gro ba la phyir 'dengs zer/phyis 'byung gi lung bstan/ ma 'ongs lung bstan zer ba'i don/phyugs sgo zog can/ khyim phyugs la sgo zog yang zer/phyugs /9phyugs zog 'tsho skyong byed pa'i mi la phyugs rdzi zer/phye mar gyi sder kha/ sder ma'i nang du rtsam pa bcags nas phyogayobazhi mar gyis rgyan pa la sder kha zer/phye mar lug tsam/ rtsam sder chen po bcags pa la zer/phyed bgos bsad/ dmag phyed tsam bsad ces zer/phyes song 'gag tsha/ 'gag tsha ni ge sar la zer/ phyi la song ba'i 'gags mo'i bu tsha zer ba'i don/165

kho— ni༄—༄phra rim pa dgu btab/ g.yu dang byu ru mu men mu0tig sogs kyis phra btab pa la zer/phrag dog gzhan rgyu nor phun sum tshogs pa la sdang zhing mi dga' ba la zer/phrag phrig snang ba/ na bun dang smig rgyu rab rib mi gsal ba'i don/phru gu ngu ngu/ byis pa phra mo ngu ngu zer ba'i don/phru ma btab/ dmag sgar btab pa zer ba'i don/( dzārno—da'aphag 'gyel/ 'phag ral byed / 4'am 'gyel log rgyag pa la 'phag 'gyel zer/'phag thung zhig 'phag tshags brgyab pa'i don la zer bar snyam/'phan phyar/ rgyal mtshan dang cod pan lta bu la 'phan gdugs zer/'phar ba/ spyang ki lta bu mdog dmar po zhig la zer/'phar ba rkang nag spug gu'i blon chen zhig gi ming la zer/'phur 'gro/ 'phur 'gro rlung gi shugs can zhes 'jang zhur lha 166

rgan po'i chibs rta la zer/ 'phung 'dre/ rtsod pa'i gzhi slong mkhan mi nag nye can la zer/ 'phung mo/ bud med ngan pa gyod 'dre ma la 'phung mo zer 'phung rgan/ gtor brlag mkhan dang dkrugs shing mkhan la zer/'phongs ba 'dra ba/ dbul bo'am sprang slong 'dra ba zer ba'i don/khodzāṭī༄'phya kha byed/ 'phya smod dang brnyas bzhag byas pa la zer/'phyan ma/ rang 'dod ltar sa gzhan du 'khyam pa la 'khyams mo zer/'phyar rgyag lding gsum/ dmag don 'gro 'dug skor gsum dang 'thab jus 'thab rtsal sogs la zer/'phyi ba nyan po/ srog chags 'phyi ba la zer/ 'phyi ba tshon po shed mong can la nyan po'ang zer/'phyi ba'i a khung / 'phyi ba'am a bra'i khung bu zer ba'i don/'phyor bo/ rgyan gos sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa la mi 'phyor bo zer/ḍadzāno—༄ 'brang lam/ ha cang sa 'gag dog sa'i lam la 'phrang lam zer/'phral dka' phugs brlag da dka' phugs brlag zer bas 167

'phral phugs kun tu mi legs pa'i don/'phral du/ myur du'am glo bur zer ba'i don/'phrigs te langs/ myur du langs pa'am brtags pa'i don la'o//'brin cha phyir bajangs/ 'phrin yig phyir bskur ba'i don la zer/'phrin las rnam bzhi/ zhi ba'i las/ rgyas pa'i las/ dbang gi las/ drag po'i las bzhi la'o//'phru dkar nag khres po gcig rmog gi rtse 'phru dkar nag khur po gcig zer/'phru sngon dmag rnga 'phru sngon po can gyi dmag la 'phru sngon can zer/'phru nag can/ rmog gi rnga 'phru nag po can la 'phru nag can zer/'aspul spyor/ sprul ba 'gyed pa'am rdzu 'phrul ston pa la 'phrul sbyor zer/'phrul zhags 'od bkra/ rdzu 'phrul gyi zhags pa 'od mdangs 'phro ba la zer/'phreng rdog 'dren 'dren/ 'phreng ba 'dren 'dren zhes pa'i don/'phrod smyor legs po/ nyi bzang skar bzang dar ba sbyor ba sogs legs po la 'phrod sbyor legs po zer/168

ḍashā༄༄ —ba kha re re/ ba thab re re'i mtha' na mi bcu re yod zer ba'i don/ba rgan/ ba glang lo lon kha mtho ba la zer/ba nyal ma byed/ glang rgan nyal nyal ma byed zer ba'i don/ba dan/ dmag dar ram dar dpyangs lta bu la zer/ ba dan lce brgyad/ dar lce brgyad can gyi ru dar la zer/ba— spu gzengs/ 'jigs skrag skyes tshe lus skyes ba spu langs pa lazer/ba mo chags/ chu zil chung ngu chags pa la chu bad zer/ba spyo ma/ ba drus ma zer bar snyam/ ba drus ni ba bzhon ma 'o ma can la'o//ba lu dkar po/ rtswa ldum dkar po dri bzang can zhig la zer/ba she longs pa/ ba lang phyugs khyu longs pa la zer bag dro ba/ sku khams bde ba'am zo mdog bzang ba'i don/bag phebs/ lus dal ba sems lhod po bag yangs pa la zer/bag ma/ mna' ma gsar skyel la bag ma zer/ bag med pa/ ci las 'di las med pa'i chang 'thung ngam spyo ba lta bu la'o//bag tsha ba med pa/ dpa' bo la zer/ ngo tsha ba'am 'jigs pa 169

med pa la'o//bang kha/ rta'i rgyub/ stangs la zer/ bang kha dal ba ni ca/gyogs po min pa'i don/bang kha skye na le/ rta brgyu ga na bang kha mgyos/— / po la bang /ba skyen po zer/bang chen pa/ pho nya'am yig khyer brda satong mkhan sogs la zer/bang btang na/ rta brgyu ga na zer ba'i don dang mtshungs/bang i bul/ bul ni da' ba'i don/ rta brgyug na bang ma dal zer ba'i don/bang mi/ pho nya'am mngag gzhug pa la zer/bad lhags/ ba mo dang bser bu gnyis la zer/ tshig bsdus nayobad lhags zer/bad gan/ mkhris pā'i nad kyi rigs shig gi ming /ban rgan/ skya min ser min lo na bgres po la zer/ban 'khums/ yul nges med du 'khyams pa'i btsun pa la zer/ban chung/ grwa ba chung chung la ban chung ngam grwa chung yang zer/ban de/ grwa pa chung ba'i ming / sa cha la las btsun chung la ban de zer/ban ma bun/ mgo 'thoms pa'am dran pa mi gsal ba la zer/ban dbu se/ ban rgan skra dkar can zer/ dbu ni mgo'i zhe sa'i 170

tshigaban btsun/ ban de dang btsun pa gnyis kyi ming tshig bsdus nas ban btsun zer/ban gser zhwa can/ ser mo'am bla ma gser zhwa can zer ba'i don/bab thob can/ 'os pa'i tshig dang skabs su bab pa'i tshig la bab thob can gyi tshig zer/bam mkhar brtsigs/ bam ni mi ro'i ming / ro yi mkhar brtsigs zer ba'i don/bam chen shā mi yi sha la bam chen sha zer/ bam sha ni mi sha la'o//bar thel khra po/ mi min the'u rang la dkar nag khra gsum yod pas khra bo la zer/bar ma do/ phar ma shi tshur ma gson par 'khrul snang byung ba'i skabs der bar ma do zer/bal rgan thu lu/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i dmag dpon che bzhi'i nang gi gcig la zer/bal stan the ba dgu glings/ 'do rje rkyang rgod pher ba'i sga stan la zer/bal ldan/ g.yang dkang lug gi ming la zer/bal mon/ bal yul dang mon yul gnyis tshig bsdu byas pas bal 171

mon zer/bri na ya ga dbang phyug gi bu tshogs bdag gi ming /bu skal/ rang skyes kyi bu med pas gzhan bu blangs pa la bu skalazer/bu kher skyes/ gong na phu bo med/ 'og na nu bo med pa'i bu gcig pu la kher skyes zer/bu khye'u/ bu chung la khye'u 'am a nu yang zer/ bu chung gi ming /bu gwa gwa/ bu gdong dkar gwa le bu mo 'dra ba zer ba'i don/bu chung snying nag bu chung snying du sdug pa zer ba'i don/bu chung bde dga' don grub/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i snyinga'adra'i nang blon zhig la zer/bu rta gang hrag bu rgod rta rgod bzang bo la zer/ gang hrag ni gang bzang zer ba'i don/bu rta dar la drags/ bu rta ha cang dar drags che ba'i don la zer/bu rta'i hrag zhan/ bu rta'i bzang ngan nam rgod zhan zer ba'i don/bu mo go rgas/ gnas sgo gtan nas ma 'grims par rang khyim du rgas pa'i bu mo la go rgas zer/bu mo'i dngas rtse/ bu mo'i yang rtse zer ba'i don yin par snyam/bu mo'i phud gcig bu mo'i nang gi phul byung ngam mchog gyur zer 172

ba'i don/ ngaza bag rnam bzhi/ stag tsha ngo lug tshangs pa'i ngo lug du yag 'brug rgyal/ skyes yag nyi ma rang shar bzhi la gling gi bu yag rnam bzhi zer/bragarto'u/ stag zhu gur dkar rgyal po'i slas po'i ming la zesabung ba'i zil bsir/ rkang drug bung ba'i gshog sgra la zer/bad med cho'aju ma/ bud medalanyes med ba'am cho kha med pocho med zer/bum chung / mkhar rdzong chung ba la 'bum chung ngam bum chung zer/ bur lhag stag dong khra mo'i bsdam thig la zer/bur chang / bu ram las bzosaba'i chang la bur chang zer/brag 'gro/ myur mo'am mgyogs bo yin par dalabs 'gro bskusazer/bul tog byang gi chu snying tshwa dkar po la zer/be re za'i ya mtsho/ gling ma sru che rgan zhig la zer/lha'ihar/ legs sbyar gyi skad/ rgyal po la be har zer/be har srid pa'i spog bdag chos skyong rgyal po chen po'i mtshan lasazer/ beg rtse/ btsan rigs chos skyong zhig gi mtshamabem gog lus rten nam lus phung la gog po zer pal /

bem rig gnyis/ gzugs dang rnam shes kha bral ba la bem rigobral zer/bem po/ mi shi ba'i ro dang / spyir srog med la yang bem po zer/ bem po thang gang / mi ro thang gang zer ba'i dmag mang bsad drags pa la zer/bem po khog rul/ khro thung gis spyi dpon khra rgan la blun rgan khog rul zhes ngan smras btang ba red/bem rig bral/ sems bem po'i 'brel thag chad pa la zer/be'u stag rdzong / gling gi dpa' brtul stag ri gzig 'phen gyi mkhar rdzong la'o//ber ga (berga/ dbyug pa'i ming ste/ brda rnying la ber ka zer/ber ka sne med/ ber ka dbyug pa'i ming / sprang dbyug sne med zer ba'i don/ber dkar can/ ber ni gos lwa'i ming / gos dkar can zer ba'i don/ber 'jam/ gos lwa'am gos tshar 'jam po la zer/ber thul/ stag gzig sogs kyi pags pas bzos pa'i gyon gos la stag thul gzig thul zer/ber thul can/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i dmag dpon zhig gi ming /ber dang phu dung / gos dang phu dung mnyam 'brel zer pas kha 174
