bral med pa'i dpe la'o// — ber nag can/ gos nag can zer bas gyon gos kyi khyad tshasdo ༄ la bshad/ber dmar/ gos dmar gyi lwa ring phu dung med pa la zer/ber ser po/ gos ser po'i lwa ba ring bo phu dung med pa can la zer/pong ba/ sa'i gong bu'am sa'i rdog po spang tho lta bu la zer/bong bu ga ba/ bong bu thod dkar zer ba'i don/ ga ba dkar thig gi don/bongs ring ba/ lus gzugs brjid pa'am ring ba'i don la zer/bod sgang ba/ bod yongs la zer ba'i don dang mtshungs/bod chol kha gsum/ dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ mdo stod mi yi chol kha/ mdo smad rta'i chol kha zhes pas phyogs khag gsum la zer/bon sku gshen rab/ bon gyi ston pa gshen rab la zer/pon chos nang la bskur/ bon chos de nang ba'i chos lugs su bsgyur zer ba'i don/bon sprul tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ stag rong khro zung gis mthu gdams ngag zhu sa'i bla ma'i ming /bon zhwa khra/ bon zhwa dkar mo rtse rgyal la zer/ 175

bon g.yung drung / bon ming la g.yung drung bon yang zer/7 bye 4 —༄)bya da/ la'i glu/ bya ka la ping ku'i dbyangs rnya na la zer/bya skyel nyen/ dgra la lkog brda gtong ba'i nyen kha yod zer ba'i don/bya khug rta/ char sdod byi'u dang kha la yug gi ming /bya khyi'i tshogs su rol/ ro bya khyi'i kha zas su rol ba la zer/bya gang ga ro zan/ hor gur dkar kyi bla bya bya than bse bo la zer/bya rgan go bo/ rus pa dang rdo dkar za ba'i bya go bo rus gzan no5bya rgod ding ru/ bya rgod gshog pa'i rus pa la ding ru zer/bya mgrin—sngon/ rma bya dang ne tso la mgrin sngon zer/bya dga'/ dpa' bo'i khyu mchog la dga' rtags thob pa la zer/bya gtong mkhan/ dgra phyogs su brda gtong mkhan la bya skye'akhamakhan zer/bya than 'ud sgro ga than bya 'ug pa la zer/ than bya 'ug pa'i stong skad zer/bya than bse bo/ hor gur dkar gyis gling la nyul ma btang ba'i than bya de la zer/bya de phos nam bar/ khyim bya de pho zangs ze can gyis nam brda 176

gtong skabs dmag sgar chas dgos pa'i don/bya spu glungakhrer/ gar 'gro rang dbang zal ba la zer 4 bya bug ron gyi brin/ bya phug ron mirtug pa la zer/ bya brin ni rtug pa'i ming /byu ba thad du ma song / bya ba drang thad gsong ngam bya ba bzang po ma 'grub zer ba'i don/bya byed sprel las mang / bya ba byed pa sprel las lhag zer ba'i don/bya bral/ bya bral ni bya ba med pa'i don la zer/bya ma btang / brda skad dgra la ma gtong zer ba'i don/bya 'dab chags rgyal po/ mkha' lding khyung chen la 'dab chags rgyal po zer/bya 'ur rdos dkrogs ba/ bya khyu la 'ur rdo rgyab nas 'phur du ོbcug pa'i don/ bya lag mang na/ las rgyu dran rgyu mang ba'i don la zer/bya las blo lam la 'gro/ bya ba legs lam du 'gro ba'i don/bya shang shang / dri za'i khongs su gtogs pa'i mi rigs shig lazer/bya shang shang te'u/ rgyud ni dri za grul bum 'dus pa mi ma bya'i rigs shig la zer/177

bya a skya mchu ring / chu bya'i rigs shig gi ming la zer/byang kha'i g.yag rgod/ byang gi 'brong g.yag ru dmar la zer/byang gi brtan ma/ dbu ba'i tshwa mtsho'i gnas bdag la zer/byang gi gtsod pho ru ring/ ri dwags gtsod la zer/ ru ring ni kho bo'i rwa ring ba'i don/byang gling gi ge sar hor sog gi rgyal po'i ming / ge sar dmag gi rgyal po'ang zer/byang chub 'dre 'khol/ rlangs ston byang chub 'dre 'khol zhes lha 'dre bran tu bkod nus pa'i bla ma zhig gi mtshan/byang don yod grub pa/ lha rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhi gi mtshan/byang gnam mtsho/ stod mnga' ris gnam mtsho byug mo la zer/byang bye ri/ gna' snga mo'i mi rigs shig gi ming / bye ri'i byur rdzong ni 'di la zer/byang sbyi'i ge sar/ byang gru gu hor sog gi dmag dpon spyi la zer/byang mas dkyus thag chod pa/ rta byang mas rgyug thag chod pa zer ba'i don/byang bang skya mo/ byang phyogs kyi bye thang yangs pa zhig la zer/byang tshwa dkar mo/ dbu ba'i tshwa mtsho dkar mo la zer/byang la chung gi mda' ru/ sa ming zhig la zer/ byang la chung gi 178

mdo zer ba'i don/byad stems/ mthu gtad dmod mo byas pa'i don la zer/byad bzhin kyang mdzes/ byad dbyibs kyang legs zer ba'i don/byad bzhin leges par brtags na/ gdong dang byad dbyibs legs par brtags na zer/byas kyi yag nyes/ las byas kyi yag nyes sam bde sdug gang 'dra zer ba'i don/ byi glang gnyis kyi zla mtshams/ lugs rnying hor zla bcu gcig pa'am bcu gnyis pa'i zla mtshams la zer/byi ba bra/ a bra dang tsig gu sogs la zer/bying byugs/ rig pa gsal bo ma yin pa'i rab rib ban bun gyidon/byings che ba/ mi mang che shas sam mang drags pa zer/byi sa snying / sdar ma snying med byis pa 'dra ba zer ba'i don/byis ba'i 'du ra/ bsam med byis pa rtsed sa'am 'du sa zer ba'i don/byi sbas rdo chab rtse/ byis pas chu rde'u len pa la dpe sbyar ba'o//byin za'i phung bo/ byin za me'i ming / gdung byin za'i phung bor phul/byu ru 'bo gang / byu ru bre gang blugs zer bar snyam/179

byu ru sha bo'i rwa bcu/ byu ru'i sdong bo sha pho'i rwa lta bu yal ga bcu lag can la'o//byu ru'i tshe dpag med/ byu ru las bzos pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sku 'dra zer/byu ru'i lha rdzong / ngar ba'i rong tsha dmar leb kyi mkhar rdzong dze+ezer/byu ru'i 'od dpag med/ byu ru la sa bzos pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi sku 'dra zhig la zer/byur gyis ded pa/ gyod dang kha mchus ded pa la byur gyis ded zer/byur lha rgan po/ rmu rje sa tham rgyal po'i gung blon zhig gi ming /byus kyi yo lang / sri da jus kyi zings 'tshubs dang 'gyur ldog lazer/byus nyes/ byus nyes dang jus nyes mi/ don gcig rgyal po'i las don ma legs pa la jus nyes zer/byus kyi yag nyes/ chab srid kyi yag nyes sam bzang ngan zer ba'i don/byus phar gor/ chab srid kyi dbang cha shor ba la zer/byas phyi nang brjes pa/ srid jus mngon lkog byas pa'i don la zer/180

byus/me yo 'ong —ba mi dang/ rwang srid jus la g.yo 'gul 'ong mi dpe zer ba'i don /byus shi sde srid dang 'bangs don du shi ba la byus shi dang jus shi zer — bye ma la nyag hor gyi sa 'gag dog sa zhig lozer/bye ri nyil 'dra/ bye ma'i ri bo nyil ba 'dra zhes dmagarta'i dpung grangs la zer bye'u co ga sa mtho sa na yod pa'i bye'u chung skad snyan can zhig la zer/bye'u tsher ma la khrabaskyes/ bye'u chung la khra phrug skyes zhes pa'i bshad srol dpe la bkod pa'o//bye'u 59this/ this khring 'dzul zhes pa'i bye'u chung skya bo zhig yod pa yi na par snyam/byer ba/ bros pa'am so sor thor ba'i don la zer/byes su bteg phyi rol thag ring du song ba'i don la zer/byes song / phyi thag ring sar song ba la byesta song zer/ byon lamo/ phebs lam dang 'gro lam zeraba'i don/byol song / dud 'gro spyi'i ming la byol song zer/ngahūṃng༄ bra nye/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad nang ga skar ma zhig gi ming la zer/181

bra bo/ 'bru rigs dbyibs zur gsum smin myur ba zhig la zer/bra ba'i mchu/ mi kha bra mchu zer ba'i kha ngan lce rno ba la zer/bra rtsam 'bo gang / ram rtsam bre gang zer ba'i don la'o//bra bse rag sa stong mi med bra tsig dang 'byung bo bse rag mang sa rlung bser bus shugs glu len sa la zer/brag skyibs/ brag them mam bya rgod 'bab sa lta bu la zer/brag khreb khrob/ brag shar shur dang pha bong thar thor yod pa'i sa la zer/brag 'phang / brag g.yang sa'am gzar sa'i don/brag phul rdog pa gtad/ sra mo brag la rkang ba gtad zer ba'i don/brag la phur ba brgyab 'dra/ mda' la nus shugs med pa'i brag la shing phur gdabs pa ltar zer/brag gseb 'ug rgan/ brag srub kyi 'ug pa rgan po zhes pas khro thung la sun 'byin byas/brang khang / 'dug khang zer/ bla ma'i bzhugs gnas la bla brang zer/ rgyal po'i bzhugs gnas la pho brang zer/brang / thog ja mo bajungs/ brang lag rnga bzhin brdungs zer ba'i don/brang rgyan/ brang rgyan ga'u dang do shal la zer/brang 'gro'i dbang bo/ gdengs can rgyal po ni klu'i dbang bo la 182

zer 4 brang tshigs bajungs/ lag pas brang brdungs pa'i don la'o//brang g.yogs/ dpa' brtul gyi brang kha'i me long la zer/brang ru sa rdo la brnabs/0 sbal ba lding shed che na brang jus rdo la zer rba'i do nad — bran po bren mo/ g.yag po'am g.yog mo zer ba'i don/bri gang med/ gang stong med pa'am dar rgud med pa la zer/bridi ba/ bslu brid dam mgo 'khor btang ba'i don la zer/ bre kor/ mda' 'phen skabs mthe bong mgor gyon pa'i mtheb rwa la mtheb kor yang zer bre bo la ring / hor sog gnyis kyi sa mtshams kyil ring bo zhig la zer bre bo sog rgyas/ sog ser po'i rgyal po zhig gi ming la zer/bre le sog dkar/ stag gzig gis bsten pa'i lha srung zhig la zer/ze ser kha skya ma/ 'brong gi ming / mchan dang mchu'i spu mardog skya bo yin pas kha skya zer/ bres ra/ rta ra'am rta 'dogs sa'i kha ra la bres ra zer/bro bajungabaska rnga bub brdungs nas bro khrab pa la zer/zo por ba/ lha srung dpang du bzhag nas mna' bskyal ba la zer/18 3

bro ra/ bro gar 'chams sa'i ra ba la bro ra zer/(ོ zlo/ 4—༄ bla mkhar/ rgyal po'i bla srog rten sa'i khang pa la bla mkhar zer/tha gru dpon/ bla slob dpon gsum zer ba'i don la'o//bla rtsol smra ba/ snying ngo med pa'i tshig ldab ldib bab col smra ba la zer/bla lcags dam pa'i dgu sgril/ hor gnam thel dkar po'i bla rten 'gengs chen zhig gi ming /bla mchod/ rgyal po'i rim gro sgrub mkhan bla ma dang a mchod la zer/bla stag 'ol ba mi gzan/ hor rgyal rgyud gsum gyi bla gnasakyi stag zhig la zer/bla bo drang gtam/ bla bo ni a pho'i don/ a pho drang gtam shod ces pa'i don/bla bya khrung khrung / gling gi bla bya khrung khrung gsum la zer/bla 'brong / bdud btsan klu gsum gyi bla zog 'brong ru dmar zhig la'o /bla 'brong rū ring / hor gyi sa sgo srung ba'i 'brong g.ya po/ zhig la zer/1( 3pha

bla ma gser mdog gser zhwa dang ser gos gyon pa'i bla bcun la zer/bla ma'i 'gram/ bla ma'i drung zer ba yin par snyam/ 3rtsa'ibartsong / dgra dga' gnyen sdug gi bya ba byed mkhan la zer/tha bcong rkang 'dres dgra rgyal rang pham byed pa'i blang dor gyi gnas la rmongs pa'i spu 'khogs lang lta bu la zethon bla zangs 'ol ba gshog drug hor rgyal po'i las zog the'u rang — dkar nag khra gsum gyi bla gnas 'khar zangs zhig la zer/ blang dor/ bzang bo len pa'am ngan pa dor ba la blang dor zer/blo khog bar snang yangs po/ des shing skyed che ba'i blo rgya che ba can la zer/blo3spyob chu chugag/ sem sa khung du chu grang blugs pa lta bu zer ba'i sems mi skyid pa'i don la zer/blobasgrobs chag dpa' rtsal nyams pa'am blo stobs zhan pa la zer/blo gter/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dbyangs can ma la zer/blo brnab/ blo —mi bton par 'gyur ldog byed pa'i don/blo rogs/ 4 blo 'dri sa'am yid rton sa'i grogs po la blo rogs zer/ blo shog mangs pa/ blo khog yangs pa'am gu /snangs pa la zer/blo som nyi/ blo the tshom gyi dbang du gyur pa la zer rdzu+o blon rgan/ blon po na tshod bgres po rgan pa la zer 185

blon chen shes gsal rab snang / nub stag gzig rgyal po'i blon chen zhig la zer/blon po rgas mgo gsum/ blon po rgan pa gsum zer ba'i don/blon po dgra 'dul g.yu 'drug smug gu rgyal po'i blon chen zhig gi ming la zer/blon bya nag mig gcig gru gu thog rgod rgyal po'i dmag dpon zhig la zer/blos btang ba/ 'khor ba dang bu bu mo thams cad rgyab tu bskyur ba'i don la'o// (ོ deni ༄ dbang bkod/ rgyal pos bka' btsan babs pa la dbang bkod zer/dbang bang che/ bsod nams dang rgyu nor ldan pa la dbang thang ldan zer/dbang drag rtsal/ dbang lha rta mgrin dmar po la zer/dbang mdog stong skud/ dbang mdog ni dmar po'i don/zhwa mgo'i ca la dmar po la zer/dbang mdog phod ga gos lwa dmar po ring bo la zer/dbang phyogs/ shar phyogs la zer/ dbang bo brgya byin shar mi186

phyogs skyong yin pas dbang phyogs zer/dbang phyug chen po/ lha chen brgyad kyi ya gyal gcig la zer/dbang bo lnga/ mig gi dbang bo/ rna ba'i dbang bo/ sna'i dbang bo/ lce yi dbang bo/ lus kyi dbang bo'o// —dbang bo'i rgyal mtshanata 'ja' tshon gyi ming4 / dbang bo'i gzhu — yang zer/dbu5sku rgya lcang / dbu —skyes sam dbu skra lcang lo'i gzugs sungabakod/dbu dkar/ mgo dkar ram spa dkar can zer ba'i don/dbu gur/ bla brang ngam rgyal po'i bzhugs gur la zer/dbu rgyan/ gtsug rgyan dang con pan sogs la zer/dbu bsnyungs pa/ mna' bskyal ba'am dbu na ba'i don la yang ngo //dbu nyes 'ongs/ dmag don mi legs pa'i jus nyes 'ongs pa'i don la'o//dbu nyes ma shor/ srog shor dang jus nyes ma byung zer ba'i don/dbu nyes shor/ dpa' thul gang che gang dregs kyi mgo ske shor ba la zer/dbu thod byas pa/ phyag 'tshal nas thod pa gtugs pa rlo zer/dbu thon pa/ rang mgo rang gis thorno dgos zer ba'i don dbu 'phang / go gnas sam mnga' thang mtho ba la zer/187

dbu 'phru/ dbu rmog rtse'i rnga 'phru sogs la dbu 'phru zer/dbu zhwa dom nag 'thib zhu/ dom nag gi pags pas bzos pa'i zhwa zhig la zer/dbu ya thod/ dpral ba'i ming / thod pa la ya thod kyang zer/dbu lo/ dbu skra'i ming / dbu lo'am dbu skyes kyang zer/dbu bla/ gong ma'am rgyal pos bsten nga/'i bla ma la dbu bla zer/dbus rnam par snang mdzad/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhig go/dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ g.yas ru/ g.yon ru/ dbu ru/ ru lag gnyis bcas bzhi la zer/dben gnas/ 'brog dgon lta bu zang zing dang 'du 'dzi med pa la zer/dben sa pa/ bya btang ba'am ri khrod pa lta bu la zer/dbo zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla sanyis pa la dbo zla zer/dbon po/ pha'i spun a khu la zer/ bla ma'i dbon po'ang de nas zer/kho8dīske༄dbyar gyi ja gsang / 'brug sgra la zer/ sprin sgra'ang zer/dbyar ja kha sprod/ gos lwa 'brug kha sprod kyi ri mo can la dbyar rnga kha sprod zer/188

nga byar za 'ur/ dbyar rnga 'brug sgra'i ming / dbyar rnga sdir zer ba'i don/dbyar gsum mar mgo bla ngas/ dbyar zla gsubalamar khralablangs zer ba'i don/dbyar gsum bla ba/ lugs rnying bzhi ba lnga ba drug pa gsum la zer/dbyig gi char 'bezungag byang phyogs rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras la'o//dbyig ldan ma/ sa gzhi'i ming / dbyig gi blo gros ma yang zer/ngabyig 'dzin/ sa gzhi'i ming gi grangs shig la zer/dbyings stong ba/ nam mkha' stong ba'i ming la zer dbyings stong ba'i mtha'/ nam mkha' stong ba'i mtha' la zer ba'i don/ 4 dbyingababababyugs khri gdugs/ khri gdugs ni nyi ma'i ming / mkha' dbyings nyi ma zer ba'i don/ḍashārno༄ 'bag sku/ 'dam dang 'jim pa las bzos pa'i sku 'dra la zer/'bag 'bug migagada'/ go med grag med 'jam bcags me bsdad pa la zer/189

'ba' tho/ dpang rgya'e yi ge tham ka can la 'ba' yig gas 'ba' tho zer/'ba' dang li thang / deng dus khams phyogs na 'kha' dang li thang zer ba'i sde ba gnyis yod pa'i chad khungs de la zer bar snyam/'ba' sgra/ ra lug mang bos ska da 'don pa la 'ba' sgra zer/'bar byed rdzas dgu/ drag po'i ngan rdzas dgu zer ba'i dmod mo'i rdzas ngan la zer/'bu dung thabs nas thon/ dung 'bu shubs nas phyir thon zer bas btson las grol ba la zer/ 'bu 'dom 'jal/ srin 'bu nig gi ming / 'bu thod 'jar la zer bar snyam/'bu me khyer/ dbyar mtshan smag 'thibs tshe srin 'bu'i ma/jub / tu me'i 'od 'dra zhig yod pa de la zer/'bu tshag pa/ srin 'bu a tshag ba tshag ce sa pa'i 'bu rtswa gzan cig yod pa de la zer/'bum skyid/ mong ba za 'a 'bum skyid kyi ming / ne'u chung nga /nga zer/'bum sgar btab/ dmag sgar btab pa la brda rnying la 'bum sgar btab zer/190

'byam chung /— mkhar chung ngam chos yum 6chung la 'bum chung zer/4bum dum ba bcu gnyis/ gling gi yum chen wamachung la zer/'bum bdag dpon/ 'bum dmag nyi shu'i dpon hor gur dkar la zer/'bum pa/ mkhar rdzong ngam mchod rten dang 'bum khang sogs la'o//'bum pa dkar chung / 'brug mo'i bzhugs gur la ngos 'dzin/'bum rdzong / dpa' rgod rnams kyi mkhar rdzong la 'bum rdzong zer/'bur 'joms/ tshur rgol ngan pa phar 'joms la 'bur 'joms zer/ 'bur spo tho/ ngos mi mnyam pa'i sa 'bur bo zhig la zer/ 'bur tshugs su bltas/ mig 'bur te sdang mig gis bltas pa la zer 'bod sgrog srin po'i ming / 'bod sgrog rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu la zer/ 'bol gru bzhi/ 'bo la gdan gru bzhi la zer/ḍadzāṭī༄'byung 'khyagabaska khams gi bde ba'am nad kyis gtses pa la zer/'byung 'gyur dus/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su zer ba'i don/191

'byung ba bzhi/ sa chu me rlung bzhi la 'byung ba chen po bzhi zer/'byung po 'dzin ma/ sa gzhi'i ming grangs shig la'o/'byung bo'i bya/ 'ug pa la 'byung bya'am srin bya zer/ḍarnobre—༄'bras gtun/ 'bras rdung spyad kyi gtun shing la zer/'phras ltang gang / 'bras dkar ko sgro gang zer ba'i don/'bras ldan dus/ ston 7/'am tha skar zla ba ste dgu ba la zer/'bras mo'i ljongs/ 'bra sa ljongs rgyal khab la zer bar snyam/'bras sa li/ 'bras dkar la 'bras sa li'ang zer/'bras yos/ 'bras dkar brngas pa'i yos la 'bras yos zer/'bri thu ma/ 'bri mo so gnyis so bzhi la thu ma zer/'bri mar ser po/ 'bri mar bris pa ma dag go /spru mar ser po zer ba'i don/'bri mog rtswa ldum zhig gi ming / mar nang du btab nas bzhus na tshos kha dmar po 'byung / :'bri g.yag ro nga / rog 'bri nag g.yag nag zer/ rog rog nag po'i don/'bya rigs sna lnga/ gro/ naṭan/ 'bras/ sran ma/ so ba lnga la zer/192

'bru mgo dgos/ ston po/sum 'bru khral dgos zer ba'i don/'a zuge16khri'im shis4skam/ skya lo'ilu —yag 'brug gyolal zer/ 'brug gdangs snyan bzhan/ 'thug sgra gisar du grags pa la zer/'byag mo'i phyag rtages/ 'brug mo'i lag rtogs sor gdub la zer /tshonatshug lha/ stag lha/ bri le / stag gizeg gi yul lha gsum gyi ming la zer/ 'breng spul ko 'greng da po la 'breng zul zer/ 'brong rgod/ chung dus ma shi ba'i be'u gda' che ru song ba la zer/'brong rgyal stag rgod/ byang gru gu rgyal po'i dgra lha zhig gi ming /'brong chung ma'u/ 'brong chung ma bu zer ba'i don/ — 'broja nag shugs chen/ hor gur nag phyogs kyi dpa' rgod 'brong nag shugs chen la zer/ 'brong sha'i gang snying/ 'brong gi rkang mar ka rkang snying yang zer ḍadzha tī༄ za dkar/ rba smyug dkar po la ba dkar zer/ za dkaradzo spug phran/ ba sgyug dkar po'i dargyug ba bran bu la zer —zab 'og gori ba/ brag rdo thab tu bsgril nas rdo 'og tu chud pa la 193

zer za mgo khrag mig byang gru gu rgyal po'i bla mtsho mthil sdug4 srung ba'i klu bdud cig la zer/za gling / sba dkar gling ba'i skad snyan la zer/za lcag bsam pa'i don grub/ ge sar rgyal po'i rta lcag la zer/sbar mo'i mthil tsam/ lag mthil tsam zer ba'i don/zar 'dzing / dpa' bos lag 'dzing byas pa la sbar 'dzing zer/zal sprul sdom jig sbal ba sbrul sdom sdig pa ra tsa sogs la zer/spud pa/ ma/gar ba'i rlung sgam la zer/ khol mo yang zer/spur ma rdul len/ sa rdul len nus pa'i shel gong zhig la zer/spe ha ra sog dkar/ rgyal phran gyi rgyal po zhig gi ming la zer/ḍa—ṭ+wāṃ44—༄za ru nag po stong shong / zhang zhung rgyal po'i gzims gur la zer/sbra'i chon chen/ sbra 'then pa'i chon thag ring bo la zer/sbra'i mar log spra'i sgo kha la mar log zer/sbra'i yar log sbra'i ya phug la yar log zer/sbrang dkar/ rngom pa'i ming / sbrang dkar rtsam pa zer/sbrang char/ sbrang— chung phur nus pa'i char sim bu la zer/sbang chang / sbrang rtsi dang sbyar ba'i chang la sbrang chang zer/194

zang ldan zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla bzhi ba la zer/ sa ga zla ba'ang zer/ thil mgo rog rog sbrul mgo nag po zer/ rog rog nag po'i don/spul rgas mgo rwa can/ 'brug la zer/ sbrul rgas rmang rmang rgas 'brug zer ba'i don/thil mgo'i 'dabs/ gling jo rus rma khog gi sa bzung sa'i ming la zer spre'u rtse/ sbra chung la zer/ sbre'u tse bse ru stag kha ma ni gling ge sar 'khrungs pa'i sbra la zer/sprebs ba/ ltogs pa'am skom pa'i don la zer/ngadzāng༄ rum go ma/ bu mo gnas sgo ma 'grims pa'i gzhis khyim du bsdad po la zer ma rgan/ ma dgung lo bgres pa la ma rgan zer/ ma 'khyams/ gzhan du ma 'phyan par lhang 'jags su sdod zer ba'i don/ ma grub rgyal gyi dbu lo/ ma grub pa rgyal mo'i dbu skra zer ba lags/ 195

ma 'gyangs la mo/ ma 'gor myur mo zer ba'i don/ma cib/ dpal ldan lha mo/ 'dod khams kyi rgyal mo dmag zor ma la zer/ma chen/ ja ma chen po zer/ ma byan zer ba'ang yod/ma chen rgyal mo/ sman a ne gong sman rgyal mo la zer/ma dros mtsho/ stod ma pham g.yu mtsho la zer/ma tre ru tra/ bdud po ma rungs pa zer/ ru tra ni drag po'i skadadod/ma brtab gnang / thugs brel ma gnang zer ba'i don/ma 'thor/ phu nu kha ma 'thor lhan cig tu gnas dgos pa'i don snyela'o//ma deb/ ma phyi'am ma yig zer ba'i don/ma dros klu/ mtsho ma dros pa la gnas pa'i klu la zer/ma rā tha ra/ rgya mtsho'i gling bar gyi gling phran zhig gi ming la zer/ma ne ne/ lha chen tshangs pa'i yum a ne gong sman gyi mtshan/ma gnas ma/ gnas sgo 'grims pa'i bu mo la ma gnas ma zer/ma rangs pa/ ma ngaga' ma dgyes pa zer ba'i don/ma sprug stong dpon a grags/ sog smad ga'u shog dgu'i spyi dponala'o//ma mo bla rdo/ rdo stang zil zer ba'i nag po gru bzhi shā rde'u 'jarto196

dam can bla rdo yang zer/ ma mo chu srin gdong tsan/ bon po'i bstan skyong sha za ma zhig la 7 zer ma mdzangs ma/ ma ya rabs shes rgya can la mdzangs ma zer/ma zhang skyid/ gru gu thog rgod rgyal po'i ma yum la zer/ma bzhi khro lo/ gling ma bzhi dpon po khro thung la zer ma yar ma/ a ma dngos ma ma yin par rjes ma la ma yar zer/ma la ya glung / ma la ya ni rgya gar lho phyogs kyi ri zhig gi ming ste de las rlung ldang na tsan dan gyi dri dang ldan pas ma la ya rlung zer/ma 8bag shing zhig gi ming / de'i me tog lam li na'i me tog zer/me lo bal/ ma legs thal lam ma 'grigs thal zer ba'i don/ma sang khra casaspung zhog mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i grogs lha zhig gi 4 ming /ma sang 'aspul gyi rgyal po/ gling seng chen nor bu dgra 'dul la zer/ma sru dung ral can/ dang po bod kyi bu mo rnams kyis dung dkar po'i ral rgyan 'doges pas ma dung ral can zer/ma sru gnyis/ ma dang sru mo gnyis tshig bsdu byarapas ma su4zer/ma gsan/ ma nyan nam ma thos zer ba'i don/197

ma gsang bla bo/ ma gsang a pha drang gtam shod ces pa'i don/ma hā de ba/ legs sbyar skad/ lha chen po zer ba'i don/ma hā cu na/ rgya gar skad/ bsgyur na rgya nag chen po zer ba'i don/ma hā ka la/ rgya gar skad/ mgon po'i mtshan/ bod skad du bsgyur na nag po chen po zer/mang bkur/ mi dbang ngam rgyal po chen po la zer mang thos/ go thos mang ba'am mkhas pa la'ang zer/mang ma rnams/ mi mang che shos sam mang drags pa zer ba'i don/mad pa'i gtam/ mad pa ni bden pa'i don/ bden pa'i gtam zer ba'i don/man ngag gnang / bla mas gdams pa zab mo gnang ba la gdams ngag gam man ngag zer/man tri'i6sku chas cha tshang / rin thang bral ba'i na bza' 'am rgyan cha cha tshang zhig la zer bar snyam/man da ra yi char/ man da ra legs sbyar skad/ me tog zhig gi ming la zer/man tshar 'dar shig shig kha spu dang ag tshom 'dar silasil zer ba'i don/ mar khug phad bu snum 'thung / mar thum rkyal ba'i ming la phad bu zer/198

ma ra grog ka bcu/ mar dkar lhang bu 'dra ba rdog po bcu la zer/mar ngo gsum/ tshes bcu drug dang nyer lnga gnam stong gi bar la'o//mal nyal 'od gsal/ mar nyal ba'i dus kyi rmi lam la 'od gab la zer/mar ltang mang po/ rkyal mar mang bo zer ba'i don/ mar rdogayanacig 'brog pas byis pa rnams la mar lo zer ba'i mar rdog po gcig ster ba la zer bar snyam/mar /nga nas spu bton/ mar ril nang nas spu bton pa ltar 7zer ba'i don/mar me mdzad/ sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi mtshan/mar mdzod/ mar mang 'jog sa'i khang pa la mar mdzod khang zer/mar zan phor ba dgu/ mar thud phor ba dgu zer ba'i don/mar ngo'i phyogs/ tshes bcu drug nas gnam gang gi bar la mar ngo'i phyogs zer/ — mal khri/ gzims khri'am nyal khri la zer/ ḍadzāng༄ mi rkang gling bu/ mi'i brla rkang gi ming / rkang dung yang zer/mi skya/ khyim pa'i ming rab byung ma yin pa la zer/mi skyag lang / byis pa ngan lang ngam skyag lang la btang zer ba'i don/199

mi khyung ru ṭa/ bdud kyi nang blon ma rungs pa zhig gi ming /mi 'khyam gla ba khrab phyon/ hor dmag ni gla mi 'khyam po khrab gyor/ dang 'dra zhes pas ngan smras byas pa'i don/mi rgan rgya bo/ khro thung la zer/ ra ma lta bu'i man tshar yod payorgya bo zer/mi rgod/ klo ba dkar mag lta bu'am dge sdug med pa la'o//mi rgod byi ba ki 'debs/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i sa srung mi min 'dre rgod zhig gi ming /mi mgo dar 'phru bcas/ mi'i mgo dang dar 'phru bcas dpa' rtags la blangs zer/mi mgo'i lab rtse/ dgra dmag bsad drags pas ro mgos lab tse brtsigs zer ba'i don/mi rgya tshug tsug khro thung la'o// gdong mdangs snum zhing dmar ba la zer/mi brgya tsho kha btags/ mi bsad pa thad drags pa la kha btags —zer/mi 'gyangs/ mi dal lam mi 'gor zer ba'i don/mi ngan rengs/ mi gyong po spyi brtol can shing skam lta bu la zer/mi ci tsam gron/ gron ni gyong gud de/ mi rta ci tsam bsad ci tsam200

brlags zer ba'i don/ mi smyogs/ lus —semes nyams pas gang yang sgrub mi dzuban pa la mi lcogs zer/ ཿphyichos bla ma'i rdzun/ mi mkhyen mkhyen mdog lha mthong 'dre mthong zer ba'i g.yo sgyu can la'o//mi marjed zhing / sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i gdul bya'i zhing 'di la zer/mi 'jigs gdong lnga/ seng ge'i ming / gdong dang rkang lag bzhi'i rtsal gcig 'dra yin pas gdong lnga zer/mi nyag chos kyi dbang phyug 'jang gi dpa' rgod zhig gi ming la zer/rigs mi nyag tu gtogs par sems/mi rta gang la gag po yod/ gag po ni khag po'i don/ mi rta gang la dka' khag yod zer ba'i don/ bya shā khag po la gag po zer/mi rtag ba/ 4skad cig skad cig la 'jig pa'i phyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag zer/ mi stegs se ba'i bla ma/ mthing rgyal po'i mchod gnas mistegs pa'i bla ma zhig la zer/ rke / mi thang gnyis/ skya mi dang rkang thang gnyis la mi thang gnyis zer/ mi 'a theng rta 'theng khyi 'theng / 'theng ni rkang rgya/la la zer ye 201

rgyal bo/ rta gyol bo/ khyu gyol bo zer ba'i don/mi dra ma/ mi ya rabs bzang po spyang grung can la zer/mi sde gro yos 'gam 'gam/ mi rta gro yos 'cha' 'cha' zer ba'i don/mi 'drogs mgo ḍā ru khrol/ khro thung la zer/ mgo bde bo ngo gnyis ḍā ru mgo zer ba'i don/mi nag bongs ring / so/ga khu ye rgyal po'i nang blon drug cu'i nang gi ya med cig/ la zer/mi snang ba'i sgra/ rig rgyu mthong rgyu med pa'i stong sgra la zer/mi sbyang spyang mdog mi mkhas mkhas mdog zer ba'i don/mi pher ba 'dra/ las rogs mi nus pa la 'dra zer ba'i don/mi ma yin/ mi ma yin pa'i lha klu 'byung bo sogs zer ba'i don/mi mo yin na/ mi yi bu mo yin na zer ba'i don/mi dmar rgyal po ag tshom/ khro thung la zer/ ag tshom dang man tshar yod pas rgya dmar ra pho 'dra ba zer/mi zhol rta zhol/ mi ngan rta ngan zer ba'i don dang mtshungs/mi zhed pa/ mi skrag mi 'jigs zer ba'i don/mi rabs chad/ rinos rgyud med pa'i shul chad la rabs chad zer/mi ro rtar bskyon/ mi nus med ro 'dra ba rta la bskyon pa red ces zur za'i gtam/ 202

mi ro dbyar lud spung 'dra/ dmag mang bsad pa'i ro ni dbyar kha'i lud phung spungs 'dra red zer/mi la 'gros ngom/ mi la gom 'gros sam rkang grangs ngoms pa la zer/ mi lo bsams/ mi bzang ngam mi 'grigs zer ba'i don/mi sha rta 'khon ma byung / mi shi rta 'gyel ma byung ba'i don la zer/mi shi bogs 'gyel/ mi rta mang bo bsad drags pa la zer/mi shi 'og 'gyel/ steng gi mi shi 'og gi rta 'gyel ba'i don la zer/mi rigs bzhi rgyud/ mi rigs bzhi ni/ bram ze'i rigs dang rgyal rigs rje rigs dmangs rigs bzhi'o//mi bsrun ba/ 'dul dka' ba'am sdig can ma rungs pa la zer/mi sha len pa/ 'khon len dang dgra sha len pa la zer/mi gsan snyam/ rna ba'i mi thos snyam zer ba'i don/mig gis phyir bltas/ 'gro zhor kha phyir 'khor nas bltas pa la phyir bltas zer/ mig gis mi bzod/ mig gis blta mi nus pa la blta mi bzod zer mig gis btsal tshe/ mig gis ltas dus zer ba'i don/mig rgyang gang / mig gis mthong tshad la mig rgyang gang zer/mig 'bras thang lhang / ya thod mig 'bras thang la lhung zhes snang ngu 203

g.yu stag hor gyis bkrongs pa la zer/mig bsgyur sna tshogs/ mig 'phrul sna tshogs zer ba'i don/mis gnyis sngo hrig hrig khro thung skrag ste mig mdangs shor nas mig0sngo lang nge yod pa la zer/mig brda/ mig gis brda ston pa la mig brda zer/mig stong ldan/ lha'i dbang bo'i mtshan/ brgya byin mig stong ldan pa zer/mig 'bur tshub/sa/ mig ches cher bgrad pa la mig 'bur tshugs zer/mig mangs/ shwa dang cho lo rtsed spyad shwa rde'u la mig mangs zer/mig rtsa dmar sgor sgor/ mig rtsa dmar log log zer ba dang gcig mtshungs/mig hrig hrig dpa' bos dgra la mig gis hrig hrig blta zer/sdang mig gis bltas pa'i don/mig ser can/ phrag dog can dang lug pa la zer/mig a 'bras/ mig gi 'bras bu la a 'bras zer/ming grags che ba/ ming grags skad can zer ba dpon po'am mkhas pa la'o//ming gzugs zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla gsum pa la zer/ nag pa zla ba yang zer/204

mid pa zas kyis b.rangs/ zas za/ tshe mid pa 'gag ste dbu gas dbyunge dka' ba la brnangs zer/ minasko) so khra/ bdud klu btsan kyis bsten pa'i lha nag phyogs pa zhig la zer/ sgo'id pa yi na mnog mi shes shes khul min pa yinasgorgyal byayob 'kha zer — zlosgob 'khro'adzibang / mi shugs kyis lcogs rung 'og rtas mi lcogs zer mis 'phya/ gzhan gyis brnyas bcas dang 'phyacad byed pa la zer/mu cor smra ba/ don med smra ba'angangag 'khyal smra ba'i don/sku tig gi lan tshar/ mu tig gi mgo rgya na la lan tshar zer/sku tigasangang sgong / 'brug mo'i mgo rgyan satig ngang ba'i sgo nga 'dra ba bzhi yod pa de la zer/mu to pa/ slong mo'am sprang bo'i ming la mu to pa zer/sku nyegs sgo.a pa rā5dza/ bon gyi bla ma mthu ngan sngags mkhan zhig gi ming la zer/lu ne lha'ajong / stag gzig gi sa rdzong btsan sa zhig la zer/sku ba'i lha sras/ gling rgya tsha'i bu dgra lha rtse spyol la zer/sku zi ser nag drag po'i dzas dgu'i ya gyal mu zi ser nag gnyis la zer/205

mug shir gtong / mu gas 'chi ru 'jug zer ba' don/ ltogs grir shi ru 'jug pa'i don/man chu dwangs med/ dran pa nyams pa'i dug sman zhig la zer/brjed zas brjed chu'ang zer/mun chu rub skabs/ mtshan smag 'thibs skabs dang sa rub skabayol zer/myan ma rub/ kha skad la sa ma rug tshun zer ba la mun ma rub kyang zer/myan sel gyi spu ru/ mun pa sel nus pa'i spu mdangs 'tsher ba'i pags rigs shig la zer bar snyam/me cha/ rno dang rdo gnyis brdabs na me stag mched pa la me cha zer/me tog chun po/ me tog sna tshogs lhan cig tu bsdams pa la chun po zer/me tog yung 'dzin/ ja rigs legs po zhig gi ming la zer/me tog sad kyis khyer/ me tog bad kyis bsad zer/ skabs 'di khyer ni bsad pa'i don 'a/ 'jugame tog a brtan/ stag rong khro thung gi bu chung nya tsha a brtan la zer/me stag mtshal lu/ stag gzig gi dpa' brtul zhig gi ming /me zur/ thab nang gi me 'dru spyad kyi shing thur la zer/2064

mo sman/nams ni/ ma sru dang bud med rnams zer ba'i don/mo rtses bra gsum/ mo ma/ rtsis pa/ bra phab gsum gyi ming /mon rong gnyis/ lho'i mon sde dang nub kyi rong sde gnyis la mon rong gnyis zer/mo sha mo'i gyod dang kha mchu byung ba la mo sha zer/mon bza' me tog spro la ma/ stag rong khro thung gi sras lha rbod 'bum me'i btsun mo la zer/mol mchid pa/ bka' mol gnang ba'am gros bsdur mdzad pa la zer/mos pas zhu ba/ mos pa dad pa'i don/ dad pas zhu ba zer ba'i don/nga— rnyi4—༄byu ngan las 'das/ sdug bsngal las 'das pa'am shi ba la'ang zer/byu ngam thang / rtsa chu ci yang med pa'i bye thang skam po la zer/byung 'das/ 'khor ba las 'das te thar ba thob pa'i don/spyos khu 'brong ru/ chang dang a rag 'brong rwa gang zer/spyos bum/ bu mo gzhon nu'i nu ma la zer/rgyos byed kyi ro ma/ chang btsags zin pa'i snyigs ro sbang ma 5 zer/208

— ḍardorno༄ dmag gi mgo rje/ dmag gi dpon po bamago rdzi zer/ dmag rgar khra mo/ dmag sgar btab pa'i zer/ rta dang 'khor gsum gyi mdog rnam pa sna tshogs la khra mo zer/dmag spa tshabalhunagro/ dmag glas pas tshab tu 'gro ru bcug ba la— zer dmag rgyab snon byed rogs/ dbung dmag kha snon byed pa la ོ rgyab snon zer/ daca/ga 'gro pher ba/ lo chung dmag la 'gro thub pa la 'gro pher ba zer dmag chas sta gon/ khrab rmogarimada' mdung ral gri sogs gra sgrig byas pa la zer dmag rting rdzogs/ dmag mang mjug rdzogs pa la dmag rting rdzogs zer dmag dpon spog shor/ dmag dpon dgra yis bsad pa la srog shor zer/ dmag dpon sengaspen datha 'dul/ skug gu rgyal po'i dmag dpon ya med zhig gi ming / dmag byings rnams/ dmag mang che shos sam dmag dkyus ma ——209

zer ba'i don/dmag gi sbyi khyab pa/ dmag gi spyi'i dpon po la spyi khyab pa zer/dmag zor rgyal mo/ dpal ldan lha mo'i mtshan/ 'dod khams rgyal mo'ang zer/dmangs ma phal cher/ spyi 'bangs phal cher zer ba'i don/dman rigs/ rigs ngan shan pa'am gdol rigs lta bu la zer/dman chung / bu mo'i ming / dman chung bu mo'ang zer/dman shar/ bu mo gzhon gras spyi'i ming la dman shar zer/dam ra gtor/ gzan gtor khrag byugs pa la khrag gtor ram dmar gtor zer/dmar po g.yab/ g.yab ni zhon pa'i don/ rta dmar zhon pa la rta dmar g.yab zer/dam ra spro/ spro ni dga' ba'i don/ sha khrag la dga' ba'i don la'o//dmar dza ra ra/ khrag dmar tsa ra ra zer ba'i khrag bzhur ba la zer/dmar yag stag gi ya 'u/ ri bkra stag gi 'dzum ya zer/ ya 'u'am ya bu ni 'gran ya'i don/dmar yag stag gi mched po/ dpa' bo'i ming la stag gi zla bo zer/210

dam ra yag ri mo can/ gcan gzan stag dang dpa' bo gnyis la zer/dmu gab/ dmu gab ni sems sgrib pa'i don/ khyod kyi sems mgor— dmu gab bskon pa min nam zer/dmya rgod/ mi bsrun ma rungs pa'i dge sdig la blang dor med pa'i ce spyang lta bu la zer/ dmya rje rgyal po/ bdud klu btsan rgyal po la dmu rje rgyal po'ang zer/dmya bdud btsan gsum/ mi min dmu rje/ bdud dang / btsan gsum zhes pa'i 'jig rten pa'i lha gsum la zer/dmya the'u rang/ mi min dmu bdud dang the'u rang sogs la zer/dmus long / ma khog nas skyes dus mig long ba la dmus long zer/dme po/ mi gsod mkhan gyi lag dmar la dme bo zer/dmod mo/ khro tshig dang byad kha'am mthu tshig gtong ba la dmod mo zer khodo/zlo༄ dmyal khams/ tsha dmyal grang dmyal gyi khams/ la zer/daphyal zangs/ dmyal ba'i khro zangs la dmul zang4 yang zer/dbyul gnas bco brgyad/ tsha dmyal brgyad dang grang dmyal brgyad 211

nyi tshe dang nye 'khor bcas bco brgyad la zer/ ‘ོ ོ8nga——༄rma ka li'i lha thang / gling dkar gyi 'du ra thang yangs pa zhib/ la —zer/rma glung dal 'bab/ chu bo gser ldan rma chu lu ma la zer/rma rgyal spom ra/ bod /rwa dkar can kyi yul lha a myes rma chen la —zehādi/rma chu'i rab rtags/ chu'i brgal lam la rab kha'am rab rtags ske zerin/rma nyin/ rma klung dal 'bab kyi nyin phyogs la zer/rma med pa/ nyes pa med pa'am skyon med pa la zer/rma bya'i mjing snol/ ges chen rma bya'i ri mo can gyi gyon gos la ——zer/rma bya'i sgro mdongs/ rma bya'i gtsug sgro'am mjug sgro la sgro mdongs—zer/rma byas dbyar ja thos 'dra/ rma byas 'brug sgra thos 'dra zhing tha ོdga' ba'i don la zer/rma g.yang 'khyil/ rma chu'i ming / dal bur 'khyil ba'i don la'o//rma g.yang phyug mo/ nor bu spungs pa lta bu'i ri bo zhig gi ming la zer/212

rma lu ma/ lu ma ni chu'i ming / rma chu lu ma yang zar/rma grib/ rma chu'i srib phyogs la rma srib zer/rmang nas shishigs/ rmang ni gzhi rtsa'i don/ rtsa ba nas bshigayoso zer ba'i don/mi lam la cha 'dzin med/ rmi lam mi rtag pa yin pas yid ches —dang ཿ 'dzin sa med zer ba'i don/mi yi'i yul/ yul phyogs shig la zer/ gang yin ngos 'dzin cha ma 'tshal/mig bzhi sa la ma reg tsam/ rta rgyugs pa'i bang myur drags pa'i rmig bzhi sa la ma thug tsam zeranazu bag bal skud ring ba zhig la bal rgyan mang po btags pa'i skud thig ring bo zhig la zer/rme ru rtse/ hor shan pa'i rus ming dang yul khams shig la zer/tho mdzo ltar sprel/ 'jang gi bzung dmag rmo mdzo ltar sbrel te ded zer ba'i don/thog dkar gsol/ mgor rmog dkar gyon zer ba'i don/thog gi ja 'aspu phab/ rmog rtse'i khyung tor dang rnga 'phru bcad pa la—zer/thog rje rgyal ba'i thod dkar/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i dbu rmog la zer/213

kho ṭ+wāṃ4—༄sma nga ngagar/ kha spu dang sma ra dkar por gyur pa la zer/chi da gos/ sma da dkris ṭa ma sham thabs lta bu la smad gos zer/span gyi rig byed brgya rtsa/ shang shang sman gyi gzhung chen brgya rtsa ོbrgyad phul ba'i don la zer/sman chung ma/ bu mo na chung la sman chung ma zer/sman ljongs/ ne'u gsing ngam spang gzhung me tog mang sa lazer/sman ngang ngan/ ma rul ma'i ming la sman dal ngan zer/sman byi mo/ ma bu mo zer ba la sman byi mo zer/sman mdzangs ma/ ma gzhungs bzang ya rabs la mdzangs ma'ang —zer/smar ma tses rib can/ bu mo yid du 'ong ba'i mdzes sdug can —zer ba'i don/sman bzang drug dza ti/ cu gang / gur kum/ li shi sug smrel/ka ko la'o//sman lasang/ bu mo chung ba'i don/ sman gsar ni mo gsar zer b.ri don/smang 4 'brupoka/ seng lcam 'brug mo'i ming / ma a 'brug kyang zer/smar lams gli nga / gling sde spyi'i ming la smar khams zer/ da lta 214

khams phyogs na ca'abar khams zer ba de'i ming 'gyur bar snyam/smig rgyu/ dpyid kur thang gzhung na chu'i rgyun g.yo ba ltar snang ba'i gzugs brnyan de la ther 4spug gu jilding shes/— 'do ba smug gu 'phur shes ni spyi dpon khra rgan gyi chibs rta'i ming /spyag gu'i nyi ma btsan rgyal/ shar phyogs spug gu'i rgyal po'i mtshan la zer/spug po skya/ skya mi spug po'am rta smug can zer ba'i don/ spug po'i ma chong / rdo'i rigs kyi rin chen zhig la zer/ mdog sna tshogab4 su yod/spug po gdong / bod kyi rigs rgyud cig la zer/spug spris se/ spug seng nge'am smug bcags se zer ba'i don/ spug rtsi/ sngon lha sa'i bud med dag gis gdong la byugs pa'i tshon rtsi smug po de la zer/ spug zhags 'thibs/ ri mgor smug pa stug pos btums pa la zer/sme ba dgu bsko ra/ sme ba dgu yi thig le tshang ba'i gab rtse zhis/ la ོzer/smo na tsho ga ru ṭa/ smon lam log par btab pa'i mi bsrun ma rungs pa la zer/215

thengab dgu/ gcig dkar/ gnyis nag gsum mthing / bzhi ljang / lnga ser/ drug dkar/ bdun dmar/ brgyadangadakar/ dgu dmar ro//smra sgo gye/ smra sgo ni kha sgo zer/ kha sgo phye dang gtam sgo phye zer ba'i don/smra bcad/ ngag bsdams nas gzhan la smra brjod mi byed ba la smra ——bcad zer/smra b.li rgyal po/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang mkhas pa la zer/smre sngags/ sdug skad btang ste ngu ngag byed pa la smre sngags zer/ḍa phyi4—༄tsa ri ṭa yi gnas/ stod tsa ri'i gangs gnas la zer bar snyam/tsa ko ra yi skad/ tsa ko ra legs sbyar skad/ bya gong mo la zer/tsa ma ra/ tsa ma ra ni rgya gar skad/ g.yag gam 'brong la zer/cun dā ma ṇi/ yid bzhin nor bu'i ming la zer/tse tse/ 'bru rigs shig dang ra ma'i ming tse tse ra ma'ang zer/ḍarge/tī——༄gtsang khang/ lha khang ngalomagon khang sogs la zer/gtsang rgyal gser ldan/ rma klung dal 'bab la zer/ chu bo gser 216

ldan yang zer/gtsang rgyas/ gtsang rgyas chu la zer/ chu bo rgyas ba la gtsang rgyasangazer/gtsang chab/ chu'i ming / gtsang chu la gtsang chab zer/gtsang chab sngon mo/ gtsang chu sngon mo zer ba'i don/gcigs bzung / ha cang gal che ba'am don che ba la zer/gtsug rgyan/ dbu rgyan nam mgo rgyan zer ba'i don/gartsod gnyan gnyis/ ri dwags gtsod dang gnyan gnyis la — gtsod gnyan gnyis zer/gartsod mo druring / ri dwags gtsod kyi rwa ni shin tu ring bas gtsod mo ru ring zer/ngar+sha/r+sha༄btsan skya dpung ring / stag gzig gi dpa' rgod zhig gi ming lozer/btsan rgyal kha so hor mgar ba'i phyogs kyi dpa' rgod zhig gi ོming /btsan dang ma mo/ mi min btsan dang ma mo zer ba'i lha gnyis kyi ming la zer/btsan po shar lung ri drug gling tsha zhang 'dan ma'i mkhar rdzong la 217

zer/rngubacan pos bsgos pa/ rgyal pos bka' babs pa la bka' bsgos zer/btsan ོ // rgyal po'i ming / btsan po dang btsad po'ang zer/btsan da cha/ra srog bdag bon lha zhig gi ming la zer/bcan rdzong gyon pa/ khrab rmog gyon pa 9pa zer/ yang skabs 'gar ma/bar rdzong du bsdad pa'ang btsan rdzong gyo na pa zer/btsan tho nga gsum/ khrab rmog phub ba/sum 'a/ zer/btsan zhan/ btsan gnyom dang drag zhan zer ba'i don/bca ngasna ston/ bu skyes tshe ston mo/ byas pa la btsas ston zer/btsab sa/ skyes sa'am 'khrungs sa zer ba'i don/btsun pa/ bla ma'aca/ rab byung rnams la btsun pa zer/btso na ra/ btson ma 'jug sa'i khang pa la btson ra zer/ btson lto sbag stag btson zas khyi lto lta buri ngan ngon zer ba'i —don e 'i dad snyam/bcon mo/ bud med ba tsan du pa cub/ pa la btson mo zer/— ‘ ༄ ོ ci —ra rtsa 'jing / nye ya'i ming / sha nye ring ngam gnyen nye du sob /sa la rtsa 'jing zer/218

ba gsum/ bla ma/ yi dam/ mkha' 'a gro gsum la zer/ ba 'phung mo khrod/ gyorda rtsa 'phung mo khyod loni zer ba 'brug mo la zer/ 'phung mo ni 'dre mo'amabadud mo zer ba'i don/— drung/ rtsa lam du dbugs bzung ste sgom pa la rtsa rlung zer/ rtsa gsum/ lus kyi rtsa ro ma/ dbu ma/ rkyang ma gsum la zer/rtsad nas phyungs/ dug sdong rtsa ba nas bton pa'am phyungs pa la zor/rtsam khug dzad pu skya thung / phad pu snyes dang khug ma'i ming rtsam khug skya ril zer ba'i don/rtsakhri grub med/ mthu rtsal dang grub rtags med zer ba'i don/rtsal chen 'brong rgod zar 'dzin/ smug gu'i dpa' rgod 'brong sbar 'dzin nus pa zhig la zer/ la ldan khyang chen dar ma/ ge sar rgyalapo'i dgra bla bcu gsum gyi ya gyal zhig la'o//rtsal med 'jag ma glung khyer/ nus pa med pa'i mi la 'jag ma rlung khyer zer/ 'jag ma ni rtswa zhig la zer/rtsi bcud/ mar dang 'o ma sogs la rtsi bcud zer/ rtsi thur/ rtswa rkang gcig la rtsi thur zer/ rtsi rtsi grangs med/ rtsis grangs mtha' yas pa med pa'i don la'o// rtsid skud chun gcig rnga rgyud kyi skud pa bsdam log cig la chun 21 9

gcig zer/rtsis pa grid gsum sgrib med/ stag gzig rgyal po'i phywa pa mo rtsis mkhan zhig la zer/rtse bro la mo jungs/ glu dang bro gar myur mo choms zer ba'i don /rtse mtshar byed/ brnyas bcos dang khyad smod byed pa la rtse mtshar byed pa zer/rtser son/ mchog tu gyur pa'am rtse ru phyin pa'i don la zer/rtso khrag rnyang gsum/ rtso dang khrag gam rnyang ba gsum bsres pa'i ོdon la zer/ yi spyil bu/ rtswa yi khang pa chung ngu'am 'jag ma'i khang bu la zer/rtswa mi shing mi/ mi dma' zhol pa rtswa 'thu shing 'thu la rtswa mi shing mi —zer/ ra pad ma stong lan/ hor gur dkar rgyal po'i rtswa bkag chen po zhig la'o//( hā/nga—༄tsha ba rong / tsha ba rong ni tsha rong rgyal khag bco brgyad la zer/ deng sang tsha kho zer/tsha tsha khrom khrom/ tsha tsha ni me stag la zer/ me yi tsha tsha tha ra ra zer/220

tsha zhang / — sa gzhan las 'ong ba'i ru sde latsha zhang zis tsha zhang 'dan ma/ grub chen sa rā ha'i rnam sprul/ shar za hong rgyal po'i gdung rgyud/ gling tsha zhang 'dan lal zer/tshu sgo cazag ba tshwa can gyi zhing sa la tshwa sgo can gyi zhing sa zer/tshwa do ya me da pa/ ha cang lci mo do 5 med pa tshwa skyes lta bu zer/tshag thal spungs/ rwa tse'i tshag mgo'i nang gi du ba'i tshig ro la ོtshag thal kyang zer/tshag del/ du ba 'then pa'i thal ro la tshag del zer/tshangs pa lha'i me tog gling ge sar rgyal po'i mtshan grangs shig ོla'o//tshangs pa gdong bzhi/ 'jig rten byed po mes po tshangs pa'i ming la zer/tshangs sbyod/ rab byung ngam drang srong la tshangs spyod zer/ tshangs dbang gnyis/ mes po tshangs pa'am dbang bo brgya byin — gnyis la zer/ tshig spobs che/ kha tshod mtho ba la tshig spobs mtho ba zer tshig kha dom/ kha tshig dom dgos gsang gtam dgra la shor mi rung zer ba'i don/tshig 'ba' 'bug mi gda'/ tshig 'ba' ge 'bug ge grag rgyu med zer ba'i don/22/

chig dmar po/ tshig la slad med pa'i bden gtam rjen pa la zer/tshig la bo can/ tshig snying bo can nam nus pa can zer ba'i don/mi pa khrag sdeb/ tshil khrag bsres pa'e don la zer/tshe sprub byed/ tshe ring du gtong ba'i gzungs sngagasashig sgrub pa la tshe sgrub zer/tshe sngo na thod pa'i ri mo/ skyes pa sngon ma'i las kyi bzang ngan la zer/tshe mjug lo rgas pa'i dus la tshe mjug zer/ lo rnga dang tshe rnga'ang zer/tshe thar btang / mi phyugs gang gsod sar khrid nas ma bsad phul ba la tshe thar zer/tshe tshe/ ra pho'i ming / tshe tshe ra yi spu zhod zer/tshe 'pho ba/ 'chi ba'i ming / tshe las 'das pa la tshe 'pho ba'ang zer/tshe ma dud/ tshe sru/nga ba'i phyag mdud dam dgu mdud la zer/tshe bsrings te/ tshe ring du btang ba la tshe bsrings pa'ang zer/tshe ra smad/ tshe mjug gam tshe smad la zer/tshe dbang bskur / tshe la phatsha pa'i chomu / bsgrubs pa'i don la'o//tshe yar stod/ tshe sngon na 4 5 che stod zer ba'i don/ che yi sa ma bsdus na/ tshe mjug ma rdzogs na zer ba'i don/222

tshe bayo ga mi tshe gcig po g.yog byed pa'i mi la tshe g.yog zer/tshe ring mched lnga/ baposhis tshe ring ma/ mthing gi zhal bzang ma/mi g.yo blo bzang ma/ cod pan mgrin bzang ma/gtang dkar 'gro bzang ma rnams so//tshe rogs/ tshe gcig gi bza' mi pho mo la tshe rogs zer/tshe srung spug po/ tshe srog skyob nus pa'i na bza' zhig la zer/tshem zhwa/ rmog zhwa'am lcags zhwa la tshem zhwa zer/tshems phreng rmang nas thor/ kha'i so phreng rtsa ba nas thor zhes pa'i don/ tshong gi shā gam/ tshong khral bsdu ba la tshong gi tho gam bsdus zer/tshong 'dus/ tshong pa tshogs sa'i ra ba'am 'du sa la'ang zer/tshong 'grems ba'i khe ba/ khe ba ni tshong pa'i ming tshong zong 'grems pa'i tshong ba'ang zer/tshong pham kha khur/ tshang khe ma legs pa la tshongarga pham kha khur zer/tshogs gnyis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis chuba'o( tshogs mang zhal ngo / grwa tshosaban mang po'i dge bskos la zhal ngo yang zer tshoms khang / tshoms khang ni mi ma/nga tshogaru/ khang la zer/tshwa rdor me da pa'i yung ma'i tshod khu/ sha dang tshwa po/nga yang med pa'i 223

la phug gi lu ba la zer/( rnozlo—4) mtshang ra/ lug sha'i gzhug gu la mtshang ra zer/ tshang 'di yangabris pa yod/mtshang rgod pa/ mtshang 'bru ba'am skyon 'don pa'i don/mtshang la phog thugs ha cang ma rangs pa'i don la zer/mtshan gyi mel tshe/ mtshan mo'i thun pa la mtshan gyi mel tshe zer/mtshan 'gros brgyab/ mtshan mo 'gro ba la ma tshan 'gros tho rgya ba —zer/ mtshan thogs thag zhag ga cig gam mtshan gcig zer ba'i don/mtshan shag bgyis/ nub mo mtshan brgyab nas song ba la ma chan —shag zer/mtshan gshar/ dmag mang mtshan mo 'gro ba'am gshar ba la mtshanagashar zer/mtshams am zhig sku mtshams dam por bzhugs pa'i don la zer bar snyam/ma tshal chu/ chu mi nga zhig yin la/ ma tshal chu ni chu dmar zer ba'i —don/mtshal tham/ mtshal dmar gyi tham ka brgyab pa la zer/224

po pos skyi kyematshal dmar lha'u/ 'jang mtshal dmar da na ra sa sras la zer/sgyumatshalar/ sa dmar po/ brag dmar po yod sal mtshal ra zer/mtsher sa/ 'brog pa ru 'bab sa la 'tsher sa zer/mtsho skyes rdo rje/ yo rgyan pad ma'i mtshan grangs shig la'o//latsho gtingasha lu/ rdo lu ni rdo chung ngu la zer/ mtsho zhabs kyi sde'u chung ba zer/mtsho span rgyal mo/ mtsho la gnayopa'i lha mo zhig la zer///// 1spros/ ///mi //// //re//rdo//ma na bkrag rgyas/ ma na bkrag mdangs rgyas pa na la zer/mtshon khar 'ba' sha chags/ dgra dmag bsad drags pas 4mtshon khar khrag chags pa la zer/mtshon khar drangs/ mtshon gyis bsad pa la mtshon khar drangs zer/mtshonakha sprel/ mtshon kha 'thab pa la mtshon kha sprel zer/mtshon gyi pha la 'phen/ mtshon gyis bsad pa la zer/mtshon 'u lu/ 'phang shing ngam 'thag thags spyad kyi stag shing la ོzer/225

khodzātī—༄'tshubs sha long long / dmag mang dkrugs drags nas zang jing lang long che ba la zer/'tshe bas ma mnar/ nad kyis mnar ba med pa'i don la zer/'tsher snang med pa/ 'jigs snang dang skyo snang med pa'i don la'o//'tsho bzhes su/ bde bar bzhugs pa la 'tsho zhing bzhes zer/'tsho byed gzhon nu/ lha'i sman pa zhig gi ming la zer/kho — sneng༄dza gad/ dpa' bo'i sha chen dang chang rgod sman btab pa la zer/dza lang / brlang spyod can dang gtum drag can la zer/dza hu'i bu mo chu bo gāng ga'i ming la zer/dzam bu gling / mi'i 'jig rten lho 'dzam bu gling la zer/dzam bu dṛ /k+ṣa/ la las dpag bsam shing yin zer ba yod/ gang ltar shing rin po che zhib/ nges/dzam bha la/ nor lha zhig gi ming la zer/ḍadzārno༄mdzangs spyod/ mdzangs spyod ni shes rab can gyi bya spyod la zer/226

mdzangs glun/ mkhas pa'am blun po la mdzangs blun zer/mdzangs ma/ ma ya rabs shes rgya can la mdzangs ma zer/mdza' gcugs/ bzang grogs sam yid rton rung ba'i grogs bzang la zer/mdza' bshes/ mdza' grogs sam gnyen nye du la zer/mdzub bar shig mdzub mo'i bar gyi shig gi 'du shes med zer ba'i don/ mdze ru/ gzer ༅ma 'dzer ma'i mdze ru zer/mjo khung dbad/ mdzo spu 'jam zhing skyi pags dkarab la khyung ོ dkar zer/ mdzo gwa ba/ mdzo gdong dkar ram thod dkar la ga ba zer/mdzo gwa ma༅ ringag stag garig rgyal po'i khal mdzo zhig gi ming /ru ring ni rwa ring zer ba'i don/mdzo mo ru rdzong / hor shan pa'i mkhar rdzong la zer///// //lnga/ //dro/ /re/ //bye/ 1jo //re/ma da dar yug ga ga kha btags da bubs ga ga ra ba —don/ mdzod dar yug dgu/ dar dkar bubs dgu 'then zer ba'i don/ 227

ḍadzāni—༄'dzam gling sbyi bsang / spyir lung ba shog kha 'tshogs nas bsang —chen btang ba la spyi bsang zer/'dzing ya/ 'thab ya'am 'khon ya zer ba'i do na/'dzing re/ 'thab pa'am rdeg pa'i don la zer/'dzin grogs glag mo/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i dgra bla zhig la zer/'dzung khug byis pa'i 'jog snod phying ba'i thal khug la zer/'dzum drug can/ gcan gzan stag dang dpa' bo la'ang zer/'dzum drug sder 'dzing / dpa' bos sbar 'dzing byas pa'i don —la'o//'dzom pa gsum/ spre'u dang khyi gu 'khrid ba'i rtsed mo ston mkhan zer/kho rdong༄ja khra yag rdza g.ya' sha can nam rdza rdo mang sa la khra yag rdza zer/dzi gong mo/ rdza mtho sar gnas pa'i bya zhig gi ming la gong mo zer/rdza 'phrang seng /zhung / zhang zhung bon gyi rdza 'phrang 'gag dog sa —zhig gi ming /rdza 'bri rma gsum/ chu gsum la zer/ rdza chu 'bri chu rma chu gsum la'ota228

rdza mo rong / gling gi sa btsan sa'i 'a gag mdo zhig gi ming / rdza mo'i 'brong / rdza kha'i 'brong g.yag la rdza 'brong mo zer/ ri'i phyed 'gyel/ rdza ri cherna gyi phyid ka thang la bsnyi la b.ridorna/jig gtam/ dregs gtam dang sdigs mo'i gtam la zer/jig rdzig dpa' med dpa' nyams ston pa la rdzig nyams zer/rdzu 'phrul/ mig 'phrul sna tshogs ston ba lo rdzu 'phrul zer/rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung / mig 'phrul sna tshogs su ston pa la zer/rdzu bag can/ dzuno smra mkhan gya 'gyu'i bsam tshul can la zer/rdzogs ldan dus/ bskal pa bzang po'i dus la zer/rdzong bum chung / mkhar rdzong chung ba la 'bum chung ngam bum chung —zer/ jong seng 'brug gling ge sar rgyal po'i bzhugs mkhar la zer/( dzāngar wa skad 'don pa/ wa brgyal ba'i skad la wa skad 'don pa zer/wa gad mig tu tshud pa/ wa mo gad khung du 'dzul ba'i don la zer wa gra kha can/ wa spu mdog mdzes pa la gra kha'am gra mdangs yag gi zer 229

wa mo khung 'dzul/ dpa' med snying chung la wa sdar ma zer ba'i da4la sbyar/wa mo stag rdzu/ dpa' med dpa' mdog bstan pa la zer/wa mo sbyi dpon 'chol rgan/ khro thung gis spyi dpon khra rgan la —gshe gshe btang ba red/wa mo mtshon thogs/ dpa' med wa mo mtshon thogs 'dra zhes dma' 'bebs byas pa'i don/wa dmar gyi sog zhwa/ bu mo bag la bskyal dus gyon pa'i wa zhwa bzang bo zhig la zer/wa ler yod/ sems na gsal bor shar ba'i don la zer/wa shi khyi shi rgyal kha'i 'bras bu ci yang med par shi ba la wa shi khyi shi zer/wa 'ang3nga / ra ma la zer/ wa 'phyang ni ra ma'i man tshar la zer/wer ma/ lha srung spyi'i ming / bod kyis dgra lha dang bon gyis wer ma zer ba don ga cig9— di༄༄zha 'thing 'thing gsum/ gling mi 'thing rta 'thing khyi 'thing gsum zer/zha long lus skur/ zha bo/ long ba/ lus sgur sogs dmag 230

'gror mi 'os/zhwa dgar can/ zhwa dkar ni phying ba'i zhwa la zer/ bod la zhwa dkar can zer/ zhwa ca la can/ zhwa mgor zi skud dmar po bstar yod pa la 'a ca la can zer/ zhwa nag hor kha/ zhwa rtsid dog catsha/ la zhwa nag zer/zhwa lde ring / bla ma ser mos gyon pa'i zhwa sne ring la zer zhwa dam ra ser/ zhwa dmar pa rnying ma pa la zer/ zhwa ser po gsar ma pa la zer/zhwa stag leb/ gling khra rgan rgyal po'i thob zhwa stag rnga can la zer/zhwa ya med dom ra/ dom gyi pags pa'i zhwa la dom ra zer/ ya med ni 'gran med zer/ zhwa hrul/ zhwa hrul ni zhwa chad ngan ngon la zer/zhag spub kyi gtor ma/ sgrub pa pos zhag gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i gtor ma la zhag bsgrubs zer/zhags pa sprul nag 'dom dgu/ seng chen rgyal po'i zhags thag la zer/zhang ne byed chen kham/ gling stag rong gi dmag dpon zhika gi ming /zhang zhung / yul zhig gi ming / yul de la bon lugs dar bas 231

zhang zhung bon zer/zhang bo/ a ma'i rigs kyi nye du'am mna' ma'i a pha a ma la zer/zhang bon rgyal po/ zhang zhung bon gyi rgyal po'i ming la zhang bon rgyal po'ang zer/zhang blon brag rgod/ zhang zhung rgyal po'i lha blon rdzu 'phrul can zhig la zer/zhang zhung wa la ni/ mi stegs pa'i bla ma mthu ngan sngags can zhig —la zer/zhang zhung lhun grub grags pa/ zhang zhung rgyal po'i mtshan la zer/zhan zhan rjes 'gro/ g.yul gyes/ tshe dmag sdar ma nus med rjes —su lus mi chog zer ba'i don/zhabs thang la byon/ rkang thang la phebs pa'i don la zer/zhabs 'dren/ pha bla btsong mkhan/ dgra dga' rang pham dag dze+ezer/zhabs g.yog zhabs phyi pa la zer/ lag g.yog pa la'ang zer /zhal skyems/ ja chang ngam btung ba'i rigs la zhal skyems zer/zhal khebs/ thang kha'i zhal khebs dang mi'i gdo nga dkris kyi ras lazer/zhal gyis 'ches/ zhal gyis 'ches pa ni khas blangs pa'i don/zhal bsgos bzhin/ bka' bsgos bzhin du khas blangs zer ba'i ོ232

don/ ‘zhal mjab/ bla dpon ngo thug pa la zhal mjal kyang zer/zhal ta/ bka' brda'am lde mig 'dzin mkhan gnyer ba la zhal ta pa'ang zer/ la ta ma/ btsun mo'i 'khor g.yog la yang zer zhal gdangs/ kha gdangs pa'i don la zer/ zhal gdangs pa zhe sa'i tshig zhal du bzhes/ zas kha ru zos pa la zer/ yang khas blangs pa la yang zer/zhal du gsol/ zas zhal du bzhes zer ba'i don la'o//zhal na tshems med/ zhal dang tshems ni kha dang so'i ming / kha na so med zer ba'i don/zhal 'phrad thug min/ ngo thug min mi shes zer ba'i som nyi'i tshigazhal sprur nas/ mchu sbyar ba'am 'o byas pa'i don la zer/ zhal mi 'cham pa/ kha mi 'cham pa'am gros mi mthun pa'i don la zer/ zhal 'dzum chil le/ thugs dgyes nas zhal 'dzum dmul le zer ba'i don/thunal ras blo ba khrag gis byugs/ thugs khros nas zhal mdangs glo ba khrag gis byugs 'dra zer ba'i do na/233

zhal ras nya rgya/ nya ni bco lnga la zer/ gdong bco lnga'i zla rgyas bzhin zer ba'i don/zhal lu/ rgya tsha 'al dkar gyi mtshan/ zhal dkar la zhal lu zhes pas gces ming btags/zhal lu'i sku srog hor la shor/ gling rgya tsha zhal dkar hor gyis bkrongs pa la zer/zhal gsum/ lha mo rnam rgyal ma la zer/ zhal gsum ni dbu gsum zer ba'i don /zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya/ rnying ma'i lha tshogs shig gi ming dang grangs la zer/zhig med khro sgrom/ thor zhig med pa'i lcags sgam zer ba dang mtshungs/zhing chen pags pa/ mi'i pags pa la zhing lpags zer/khyi/nga chen g.yang gzhi/ mi'i pags pa la zer/ mgo dang rkang lag bzhi sbyar ba'i pags/ pa la g.yang gzhi zer/zhing du gshegs/ mi tshe las 'das pa'i don/ zhing du gshezo/tso ni zhe sa'i tshigazhing ri chu'i bdag po/ zhing pa'i ming / zhing ri ma dang chu ma'i bdag po yin pas so//zhu ngo mi lcogs/ bka' lan mi ldog pa dang ngo mi lcogs pa zer 234

ba'i don/'u sna byed mi phod/ zhu 'bul byed mi nus zer ba'i don/ zhu'u khyi/ khyi phrug la zha'u khyi yang zer/ zha'u dang zha lu chung ba'i don/zhun ma 'i rdo/ sra zhing 'thas pa'i lcags rdo lta bu zer ba'i don/zhum bu nag po/ byi la nag po la zhum bu'ang zer/ kha ska da la lo'u lu zer/zhe kha chub/ sems gnag pa'i don/ kha 'jam khong rtsub zer ba'i don/zhe khrel/ ngo tsha ba'am ya nga ba'i don la zer/ yid ma rangs pa la yang zer/ zhe khrel rgya e gda'/ ya nga rgyu'am ngo tsha rgyu e yod zer ba'i don/zhe 'gyod drag po/ snying nas 'gyod pa skyes pa la zhe 'gyod drag po zer zhe gtod sa/ sems stod sa zer ba la zhe gtod sa yung zer/zhe bag bcad/ sems thag bcad zer ba'i don/ zhe thag pa nas/ sems bsam pa nas zer ba'i don/zhe gnag kha dkar/ kha yag khog nag zer ba'i do na/zhe gnong ba/ ngo tsha ba'am 'gyod pa skyes pa la zer/ zhe spo gting nas langs/ zhe sdang gting nas langs zer ba dang 235

gcig go/zhe rtsis che ba/ thugs mdang ha cang che ba la zhe rtsis che zer/ zhe zon ma dzod/ dogs zon gyis shig zer ba'i don/zhe yis dam bca'/ thugs kyis dam bca' zer ba'i don/che/ blo bde/ bsam blo bde zhing skyid pa'i don la zhe blo bde zer/zhe sha 'khrug snying nas sdang ba'am zhe 'gras che ba'i don/zhe ga nong ba/ ngo tsha ba'am 'gyod pa skyes pa la zer/zhe sha gcod/ tshig ngan bzod mi nus par smra ba la zer/zheng ne klu gzugs/ mnga' bdag gdam/ khri rgyal po'i blon chen zhig gi ming /zhed rgyu med/ skrag rgyu 'jib/sa rgyu med zer ba'i don/zhen chang/sa che ba/ snying sdug gi bu bu mo dang 'dra ba'i seng/sa chags pa la zhen chags zer/zhen pa gting log yi ga gting nas log pas skyugs bro ba la zer/zhen pa log zas mid la mi 'gro ba'i yi ga log pa la zer/zho chags kyi ru ma/ zho chags pa'i zho rtsi la ru ma'am ru rtsi yang zer/zho rul/ zho ma chags pa'i 'o rul la zho rul kyang zer/zhogs ga ning snga mo'i nyi ma ma shar dus la zhogs ku'am zhogs pa zer/236

khodono༄ gzha' tshon/ 'ja' tshon gyi ming / gzha' cho na yang zer gzhi dkyil/ kun gyis bskor ba'i klong ngam dkyil la zer/gzhi chung / khyim gzhi chung ngu la gzhis chung ngam gzhi chung yang zer — gzhi baglib/ g.yo 'gul med par brtan cing brjid pha'i don la zer/gzhis sdod skyel ma/ yul mi'i skyel ma'am yul nas 'dug pa'i skyel ma zer/gzhis pa byes ba/ gzhis pa ni yulaba'i mi lazer/ byes nganiphyi na yod pa'i mi la zer/gzhis byes kyi gsung gleng ri pha yul ba zhala'adzoms nas kha brda byas pa'i don/gzhis byesarga ru/ ri yul ngo thug pa'i smon 'dun zer ba'i don/gzhis bzhugasarnams/ yul 'dug rnams zer ba la gzhis ོbzhugs rnamasazer/ga'ug gu/ mjug ma'i ming / mtshang ra la gzhug gi yang zer /gzhu mar mchog gzhu smad la gzhu mar mchog zer/gzhu mar mchog gzhu stod la gzhu yar mchog zer/ 237 3

gzhong nga/nga 'khrag khom/ gzhong gang blangs na 'khyag khoca5 med zer bas dpe la bkod/gzhob dri thul/ lug bal ra rtsid sogs me la bsregs pa'i dri la gzhob dri zer/ ḍadzāno༄bzhes phor/ gling seng chen gyi bzhes dkar la bzhes phor zer/bzhes gro/ bza' ba'i zas la bzhes spro'am bzhes gro yang zer/ḍa r+sha —— ཿ za grogs spyang thang sngon mo/ gling ge sar rgyal po'i sku srung dgra lha zhig gi mtshan/za che na sbrang dkar/ sbrang dkar ni sbrang rtsi dkar po la zer rtsam pa la'ang sbrang dkar rtsam pa zhes ming btags/za gtam zur gtam/ brnyas gtam dang zur za'i gtam la zer/za thang 'phel/ bsod nams dang kha rje dbang thang sogs gong du 'phel ba la za thang 'phel zer/za ma tog snod ku'am sgam kha sbyar dang ga'u kha sbyar lta bu la zer/za ma mo/ bud med kyi ming la za ma mo yang zer/za zi/ mi gsal ba'i don/ na bun dang smig rgyu lta bu la zer/238

bhaskor rgyal po/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po zhig gi mtshan la zer/ zag bcas mngon shes/ rmi lam dang mo rtsis brtag pa 'dra ba'i —shes pa la zag bcas mngon shes zer/ zag phung / sgyu ma'i nyer len gyi phung bo la zag phung zer/zag med/ dri ma med pa'am dug lnga'i sgrib pa med pa lozag med zer/zangs sgron/ zangs sgam chung ngu la zer/ zangs kyi ga'u la'ang zangs sgrom zer/ zangs dung / rgyu zangs dmar gyi bzos pa'i dmag dung ring bo slob ze'adi/zangs mdog dpal ri/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi ri dmar po zhig —la zer/ o rgyun pad+ma'i gnas yin zer/zangs rag zangs dmar dang rag ser gnyis la zangs rag zer/zad mi shes ba/ rdzogs rgyu dang 'dzad rgyu med pa la zad mi shes —zer/zas bda' ba/ zas mchog dri zhim po'amaro mngar ba la zas bda' ba zer/ sa gtsang sras/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i mtshan/ zas gtsang gi bu zer ba'i dom239

zas gatsha la tshigs/ bzhes pa bzhes skabs dang za ma za skabs la gsol tshigs zer/zi ra/ me'i gong bu'am me stag lta bu la zer/zi ra yar yar/ me stag chad chad dam glog 'od 'khyug 'khyug zer ba'i don/zing long nge ba/ dmag mang zang zing long long zer ba'i brel tshubs langs pa la zer/zil gyis mnan/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis rgyu skar zil gyis mnan pa lta bu'i don/zil ba chags/ rtswa mgor chu'i zil ba chags zer ba'i chu thigs phra mo la zer/zur 'dug lus 'gyings stabs su bsdad pa la zer/zur phud lnga pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtshan/ dbu skra bcingayotshul la zur yod pas zur phud lnga pa zer/zur la 'bud shoms gyis/ logs su 'bud grabs byos zer ba'i rngo/zug/zur sa snol sa med/ bskor sa gzur sa med pa'i don la zer/tho dor/ lha srung spyi'i ming la zer/ zo dor ni 'jig rten pa'i lha la zer bar snyam/thog po smra/ mi bden par smra ba'am rdzun tshig smra mkhan la zer/240

rngog gor/ rgyu nor dgra lag tu shor ba la zog shor zer/thor gugs spro'i bajas/ zor bas breg pa la zor gugs kyis brngas zer 'aca dab / zas za drags na khog nas zhu dka' ba la ོzer/ dzāng༄mkhabaspubs kyistanator ma/ zla ba gcig tu bsgrubs pa'i gtor ma lazla bsgrubs zer/zla gargyag ma 'gyangs/ zla ba gcig ma 'gor zer ba la ma 'gyangs zer/ grogs/ mdza' grogs sam mdza' gcugs la zla grogs zer/zla ba dgu las mi thogs/ zla ba dgu las mi 'gor zer ba la mi thogs zer/masab nyayanang / tshes bco lnga'i zla ba cha yongs sagang ba la nya gang zer/za ba bar ngo / rtog gcig nas bco lnga'i bar la bla ba yar ngo zer/ dorno༄gzab bar bya/ bag yod dang dogs zon bya dgos zer ba'i don/241

gzan rul/ gzan hrul ni chad le chod le rgyan rgas ngan pa la zer/gza' skar rgyu lam/ sa'i go la'am nam mkha' la zer /gza' skar dang phywa la yag rgyu med/ dmag 'gro'i gza' skar ོdang mo rtsis sosas mi bzangazer ba'i don/gza' skar sbyor legs/ gza' dang skar ma dar ba sbyor ba sogayolegs pa la zer/gza' skar mi legs/ nyi ma dang skar ma mi legs pa la gza' ོskar mi legs zer/gza' mchog rā hu la/ ga za' brgyad kyi ya gyal zhig gi mtshan/gza' gdong dmar/ gza'i rigs shig gi ming la zer/gza' tshes gnyis bzang / gza' dang tshes skar bzang po la —gza' ches gnyis bzang zer/gzi mchong / rin thang bral ba'i rin po che rdo 'dra ba zhig la zer/gzi yi ske bag rin chen gzi yi ske rgyan zer ba la ske thag zer/gzi yi cha ru/ smug gu rgyal po'i rin po che zhig gi ming / cha ru nimago sbrel ba'i yo byad cig la zer/gzi yi 'o yo khra che/ rin po che gzi mchong zhig gi ming la zer/gzig sgar/ gzig lpags kyi gur phib pa'i skor la gzig sgar —zer/242

gzig thul/ gzig lpags kyis bzos pa'i gyon gos la gzig thul ze ra/ga2slob thabs/ gzig lpags kyis btums pa'i gzhu shubs la zer/gzig a long can/ gzig thig le can ther ba la gzig a long can zer /gzings g.yor shing / gru gzings dang gru dar gru khyim sogs la zer/gzim me da mar me/ hor gur dkar la gzim med mar me zhig yod pa de la zer/gzim la nye ba/ gnyid la yur ba zer ba dang mtshungs/gzim shag khang ba'i ming / gzim khang zer ba'i don/gzim shag rā ga —gzim khang dmar po zer/ 4 rā ga ni dmar po'i don/—gzu ba/ gzu ba ni drang bo'i don/ phyogs lhung med par drang bor gnas pa la gzu ba zer/gzugs can gyi nga/gra/ mngon du mthong rgyu yod pa'i dgra jag sogs la zer/gzugs med gyi bzhegs/ mngon du mthong rgyu med pa'i lha 'dre ོgdon bgegs —sogs la zer/4243

( 8rdo༄bzang drug span/ dza ti/ cu gang / gur kum/ li shi sug smel/ma/ te/ kusdo skrasags cas//bza' kha gtor bshigs/ bza' ba'i bar la phra ma byas nas kha gtor ba la zer/bza' btung zin/ za 'thung tshar ba nas zer ba'i don/bza' tshang bar na kha pho che/ khyim chung ma'i sngon nas dpa' ོgtam byas zer ba'i don/bzi 'thom 'thom/ chang gis bzi ba ltar dran pa mi gsal zhing mgo 'thom pa la zer/ bzi 'thom bog brgyal/ glo bur du mgo yu 'khor nas 'gyel ba —la zer/bzod bsran ye nas med/ bzod bsran gtan nas med zer —ba'i don/9dzāng༄'u thug ci bya gtol med du gyur te gu thug pa la 'u thug kyang zer/'u lu/ 'thag shing stag ma'i ming / mtshon nus med bu mo'i 'u lu 'dra zer/ la las 'u lu ni phang shing yin zer srol yod/244

'u lag sog skad yinazerag shakhal༄'am mi mdzobatsan gyis 'gro 'duko byed du bcugal 4la thor shug chung / srin bya 'ug pa chung ngu la 'ug chung yang zer/'uge ser/ 'dob tshags zu rga pa'i mdog dang mig ser bo yin —pas 'ug ser zer/'ur khra thung / jo ru'i 'ur cha khra thung zer ba'i jo ru'i lag cha zhig la zer/'ur cha skor skor/ 'ur rdo mgo la bskor nas 'phangs pa ltar zer/'ur chil le/ dmag mang lhan tu brgyugs te sgra 'ur chil zer ba'i — don/ 'ur rdo/ rdzi bo'i lag tu thogs pa'i thag khra'i 'ur rdo la zer/'o dod chen po/ sdug thug tshe ming nas bzung ste 'bod pa la 'o dod zer/'o dod du bos/ 'jigs te ci bya gtol med kyi ngang nas lha srung bos pa la zer/'o ma brgyal ba/ sku tshags ma blangs pa zhes snyun 'dri ba la zer/'o yug bhe mtsho/ sbu ba'i tshwa mtsho dkar mo la zer bar snyam/'og drel/ 'og gi zhon rta'i dril la 'og drel zer/'og ma dros klu'i gter lung / mtsho ma dros pa ni rin chen nor gyi 245

gter mdzod ces che brjorwalags/'od stong can/ nyi ma'i ming / 'od stong can dang tsha ra can yisazer/'od 'phro ba'i gseb nas/ 'od minang nas sam 'od 'phro ba'i nang nas zer ba'i don/'od gsal de yi/ 'od gsal rmi lam zer/ rmi lam de yi zer ba'i don/'od gsal drod kyi dwangs ma/ drod kyi dwangs ma nyi ma'i ming/drod kyi yang snying yang zer/'obs ring / sa shur gting zab mo brkos pa la 'ob4zer/'ol mo lung ring / stag gzig gi gzhi sa'am pha sa tsam la zer/'ol li/ bya 'ol ba la zer bar snyam/ nges can du cha ma 'tshal/98nga༄ ma stod/ tshe sngon namatshe stod zer ba'i dogal tha/ ya gi zer ba'i don/ ma tha ni ma gi zer ba'i don/ya bdag kha ya ngo ya byed mkhan la ya bdag kyang zer/ya bo bzung / ngo ya'am 'thab ya bzung ba la zer/ya bo la/ gdong len dang 'gran ya byed pa'i mi la zer/ma bu la/ dpa' rogs dpung grogs byas pa'i don la zer/246

sa bo tsang tsam/ ngo rgol cung tsam byas pa la yen tsam byas zer/ma med seng stag gling seng chen rgyal po'i gung blon 'gran med sengastag a dom la zer ma ma 'dang ba/ 'gran ya ma 'ong ba'am ma nus pa'i don la zer/ma mi nga / ngo mi gnongs sam 'jigs mi skrag zer ba'i don/ ma5bya bla ma'i lung rtagos/ hor ya mu bla ma'i mo rtags zer/ lub rtags ni mo rtags zer ba'i don/la mya'i gu ru/ hor gur dkar gyi bla mchod zhig gi ming /la med jig ba ra rgod/ gru gu thog rgod rgyal po'i dpa' rgod zhig gi ming /la med dar seng dkar lu/ sprug gu rgyal po'i blon chen zhig gi —ming la zer la med ban rgan thu lu/ 'jang sa tham rgyal po'i blon po che drag ོzhig la zer/ ma 'azog mtsho/ dbus gtsang bar gyi yar 'brog g.yu mtsho la zer la ma zung / dmag chos lam zung nimada' mdung go khrab cha ma —mtshungs ba la zer/ya rtse rgyal po/ gur dkar rgyal po la ya rtse rgyal po yang zer/la zi mkhar dmar/ hor gur dkar rgyal po'i mkhar rdzong la zer/la 'u pher ba/ kha ya'am ngo ya nus pa la zem ya bu yang zer/247

ya yo snyoms/ drang 'khyog dang kyag kyog snyoms dgos zer ba'i don/layo med/ drang 'khyog med pa'am gya 'gyur med pa la zer/ya 'a da 'phangs/ mtshon khar drangs te bsad pa'i don la zer bar snyam/yang tig snying bo'i nang nas yang snying zer ba la yang tig zer/yang le shod/ brag phug zhig la zer/ slob dpon pad 'byung gi sgrub gnas yin zer/yang re skyid/ a re dga'/ yang re skyid ni dga' ba las kyang dga' ba/ skyid pa las kyang skyid pa zer ba'i don/yam shud dmar po/ btsan rigs shig la zer/ yam shud srog bdag dmar po'ang zer/yar khams byang ma'i ri rgyud/ bdud klu btsan gyi yul la zer/yar ngo gsum/ tshes gcig nas bcu dang bco lnga'i bar la'o//yar lha ga nyan po/ gtsang gi yar lha sham po la zer bar snyam/yi re myag sems sdug pa dang zhe rmongs pa la yi re mug zer/yid skyo ba/ sun snang skyes nas sems sdug pa la yid skyo ba zer/yid skyo mo/ sems/ sdug mo zer ba'i don la'o//yid gdung ba/ mya ngan gyis gdung ba la zer/ sdug bsngal ba'i don/yid phreng ba/ sems la bzung ba'am zhe chags pa'i don/248

mid re 'phya/ yid pham kho chad pa'i don la yid re 'phya zer/yid la skyo ba skyes/ sems la sdug bsngal drag po skyes pa'i don/mid la bcags/ sems la dam du bzung ba yid la bcags nga zer yin grang na/ yin grang na ni yin zer na zer ba'i don/yin ngo red/ yin ngo ma red/ yin nges can red zer bar snyam/ yin mdog kha bo/ mi shes shes mdog min na yin mdog zer ba'i don/ yin na ya nu de 'bra/ a nu bu chung la zer/ yin ni bu chung de 'dra zer ba'i don/ min lugs 'azaskab/ yin lugs 'di 'dra red zer ba'i don/ sku5sbya 'a nga / yu ba'i bzung ngam/ ral gri'i yu ba nas bzung —zer ba'i don / lu med byas/ rtsa ba nas med —par byas pa la yu med byas zer/lug gcig gos bubs gcig la gos yug gcig kyang zer/lugs mo/ khyo ga shi ba'i yugs sa ma la yugs mo zer lung mar ja/ ja mdog ser po la yung mar ja zer — lum rgya 'gog gnyibaska ma rgya bza' dang 'gog bza' gnyis la rgya 'gog gnyis zer/lum chen/ rgyalaba'i yum chen mo sher phyin la zer/ 249

mur chu/ yur chu ni rka chu zer ba'i don/ bsad pa'i mi khrag yur chur drangs zer/lul kong yul/ kong po'i yul zer bar snyam/cal bdag bre le sog dkar/ stag gzig rgyal po'i nor bdagasnyezhig la zer/cal gzhib / khyim gzhis samakhang khyim sogs la gzhis ka zer/zugam chod/ gtan nas ma chod zer ba la ye nas ma chod zer/me dag ye nas dag pa'am ka nas dag pa zer ba'i don/me'/ phe tse snam bu'i snyes kyi ming / rgyag med lto che snyes 'jazer/me mi gda'/ gtan nas med pa red zer ba'i don/me shes lnga/ me long ye shes/ mnyam nyid ye shes/ sor rtogayo〉shes/ bya grub ye shes/ chos dbyings ye shes rnams sotame shes mtsho rgyal/ slob dpon pad+ma'i lcam mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal la zer/mer gyis bud/ lhangs se bud dam mngon du bud zer bar 'amayo lang / par 'gro tshur 'gro brel brel 'tshub 'tshub la zer/yog gesayibajungs/ yog ge ni dbyug pa'i ming / dbyug pababardungs zer ba'i don/mob bag rta sga'i yob chen gyi long thag la yob thag zer/250

yom yom 'khyom 'khrom/ sa 'gul ba lta bu'i 'dar 'dar yom yom la'o// yol gor/ gzhong ba'i ming / gser zangs kyi snod spyad gzhong rgalta bu la zer/ḍanorno༄gnag gu/ g.yag chung ngu la g.yag gu zer/gamag ja gzengs/ g.yag gis rnga ma gyen du gzengs pal zer/gakhag rgod rwa 'bab/ g.yag chen gyis thug brgyab pa la g.yag —rgod rwa 'thab zer/gsag da/ stongan 'gro med 'dug med g.yag chad ltartsal zer/ lag zhol bo/ galag rgod rtsid zhol canal g.yag zhol bo zer galag la'i gong / stag gling gnyisakyi sa mtshams kyi ri zhig gi ming sha rnarakar/ lug gi ming / lug spyong dkar zer/ gsangadapor bdag bo/ 'brog mi la g.yang dkarabadag po ོzer/ོ gsang dkar zas bkram/ lug tswa thog tu bapogapa la zas la —— bkram zer/dmang gi ra baspo bzhi/ 'bri//ma mo/ rgod ma/ ra mabazhi 251

zer/g.yang byas/ khro thung la phe tse nu dgu zer ba'i g.yang sgyes shig yod pa de la zer/ g.yang dkar ma bu bsres/ ma mo dang lu gu bsres na 'ba' sgra che ba'i don/g.yang gzhi/ zog lug gi pags pa bshu tshe ma go dang sug ba'i ma bcad pa'i pags pa la g.yang zhi zer/g.yang la lhung / brag gzar ngos lhung ba la g.yang la lhung zer/g.yab rta/ zhon rta la g.yab rta zer sa yang yod/g.yab dus/ rta la zhon dus zer ba la sayab dus zer/g.yab mo/ rlung g.yab dang rnga yab lta bu la g.yab mo zer/g.ya' ma nyil le/ rta mang brgyugs nas rdo chag nyil du btang ba lazer/g.ya' ma ja ri/ rdza g.ya' shad can la g.ya' ma rdza ri zer/g.ya' gshong / rdo g.ya' ma can gyi gshong khug la g.ya' gshong zer/g.yas ru/ dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i nang gi gtsang g.yas ru la zer/g.yas kyi sag bag g.yas kyi mda' shubs 'dogs thag la sag thag zer/g.yas bzel g.yon bsgrel/ kha skad la dmag mang g.yas rdzog 252

g.yon rdzog zer ba'i don/ nga g.yas stag dong / stag lpags kyis btums pa'i mda' shubs — la zer/galas ram g.yon 'degs/ g.yas skyor g.yon skyor gyis ram 'degs byas pa la zer galu dkar nor bu/ ge sar rgyal pos bal bo'i lug rdzong phab skabs bal bor 'phangs pa'i phyag mda' zhig gi ming /galu mkhar nor bu gter rdzong / 'di yang seng chen gyisakhar rdzong gi ming /galu chung bya ma bye'u mgo ma 'brug mo'i skra gnon pa'i mgo rgyan la zer/g.yu stag me tog khra rgan rgyal po'isras snang ngu g.yu stag la'o// —galu drug dkar/ g.yu rdo'i nang gi rin bo che rin bang bral ba ske zhig la zer/ galung drung lha rgod/ zhang zhung rgyal po'i gung blon zhig gi ming la zer/g.yu 'phru can/ rnga 'phru'i mdog ljang khu can la— g.yu 'phru zer/galu 'brug kha sprod/ gos 'brug ris can la zer/g.yu sba mthing shog gling seng chen rgyal po'i gzim sbra'i ming la zer/253

g.yu zom/ rin chen g.yu yi zo ba la g.yu zos zer/g.yu yi sgrol ma/ rgyu g.yu las bzos pa'i sgrol ma'i sku 'dra la zer/g.yu yi gze ma/ g.yu yi mgo rgyan can zer ba'i don/g.yu yi drel gdang sngon po/ smug gu rgyal po'i drel 'dogs sbyad g.yu phur rin po che zhig la zer/g.yu ral 'od kyi bu chung / mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i mtshan gyi —grangs shig la zer/g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing / rje btsun sgrol ma'i bzhugs gnas la skezer/g.yu lha zhi bas kha bslus/ 'jang g.yu lha zhi ba'i thabs kyis bslu brid byed dgos zer/g.yer kha/ dril bu'i ming / dril chung g.yer kha si li li zer/g.yer grags can/ snyan grags can nam rgyang grags can zer ba'i don/g.yer chen bla ma/ grags snyan can gyi bla ma zer ba'i don/g.yer bo che/ grags snyan gyis sa steng khyab pa lta bu la g.yer chen zer/g.yer g.yu 'byag 'dra/ grags snyan g.yu 'brug 'dra ba zer ba'i don/g.yo zhig skor/ mgo skor zhig gtong dgos zer ba'i don/254

g.yog ko mnyed/ g.yog po ko pags mnyed mkhan zer ba'i don/g.yon gzig shubs/ gzig lpags kyis btums pa'i sazhu shubasang la zer/97/༄ ra khu/ chang gi ming / sa cha la ༵zlo ra khri'am ma rag lang zer nga gan/ zangs ser gyi ming la ra gan zer/ rag ser yang zarje/ra rgan/ ra pho rgas po la ra rgan zer/ ra rgan rgya po yog tshom/ khro thung la sma martsodang kha spu mang bas ra nga rgan rgya bo zer/ ra rgod nam55ba 'i 'aspug sgra/ gling seng chen rgyal po'i gzhu mo ra rgod 'khyil ba la zer/ra thong / ra pho so gnyis so bzhi la ra thong zer/ ra thong ni chung ba 'i don/ ra thong bsha' bde/ ra thong bshas na stabs bde zer ba'i don/ra mda'/ jag pas rta zogaded pa'i rjes su rgyug pa'i mi la ra ོmda' zer/ra tshil zhun ma/ ra tshil bzhus ma'i khu ba la zhun ma zer/ ra rog khuyabacig ra nag khyu gcig zer ba'i don/ ra lug zhe zel/ ra lug mang po thag pas ske sprel ba la ra lug ske 255

sbrel zer/ra slog ra ma'i pags pas bzos pa'i slog pa la ra slog zer/ra gsur/ ra tshil me la bsregs pa'i gsu ra ma cho da la ra gsur zer/ra ag tshom can/ ra ma man tshar can la ag tshom can yang zer/rwa rgyas sha ba rgya lding / gling ge sar rgyal po'i nor lha zhig gi ming la zer/rwa sbubs/ rwa khog la rwa sbubs kyang zer/ra tse/ du ba rngub spyad kyi yo byad la ra tse zer/ra rtse zugs/ rwa'i rtse mo brag la brdar nas rwa sna log pa'o//rag dung / zangs ser gyis bzos pa'i dmag dung la zer/rag sder/ zangs ser gyi sder ma'am yol go la zer/rag bza' sger tsho/ dpa' rgya tsha zhal dkar gyi btsun mo'i ming /rang 'khrungs gshog pa/ mi min shang shang rigs la 'dab chags lta bu'i gshog pa yo da pas rang 'khrungs gshog pa zer/rang gis nyar ba/ bdag dom dang nyar tshags byas pa'i don/rang mgor chu 'dren/ dgra dga' lanyen sdug gras la zer/rang 'phyen thul/ rtug dre thul ba la 'phyen dri thul zer/rang byus rang gis 'tsho shes/ rang dbang rang gis 'dzin shes 256

dgos zer ba'i don/rang mal gru bzhi/ rang gi mal sa gru bzhi ni nyal sa gru bzhi zer/ra nga mal bzung rang khyim rang gis bzung zer ba'i don/ rang mtshang / rang byas ngan pa la /rang mtshang zer — 4byurang thos phub dul/ phub ruli ni/sa nas gyitsā rul ba la phub rul zer/ rang lus 'dom gang / rang gi lus tshad rang gi 'dom gang yin pas rang lus 'dom gang zer/ rang grog ha la 'apen/ radza srog 'ben la— 'jog pa'am rdul du— brlag na zer pa'i don/ rang spog hagaci 'phachubs/ rang srog dgra khar bskyal bos bsad nga pa'i don/ rab rtags rdo/ chu la brgal ba'i rab khar rtags bzhag pa'i rdo la rab rtags rdo zer/rab so/ chu chen gyi brgal lam la rab kha'am rab so zer/rabs chad/ bu dang rigs rgyud med pa la rabs chad zer/ram chang / ldum rigs ram bu las bzos pa'i chang la ram chang 5 zer ngaram btegs/ gcig gis gcig la rogs byas pas glu gzhas —— ṭ+wā btang ba la ram btegs zer/257

ram 'degs/ las rogs 'gro rogs byas pa la ram 'degs — —zer/ram nag sdubarigs shig gi 'bras bu la ragabu'am ram nag zer /ralagab 'gran ba/ gri kha 'gran pa laranya kha 'gran zer/ral kha ja lun nga/ ja 'thung yun tsam zhig la gri kha 'gran zer ba'i don/ral gu/ ber chen la ral gu zer/ gos lwa ring bo ral gu yangazer/ral gri stong sde sha zan/ hor rgyal chen gsum gyi bla gri zhes ralas gri 'gengs chen zhig la zer/ral khar khrag zhag mi rta bsad drags pas ral gri'i kha la khrag blo zhag chags pa'i don/ral chen sras po/ hor shan pa'i ming laral chen sras po'ang zeraras g.yab ya tsam/ ras kha gang tsam la ras g.yab ya tsam ———zer/rat+na ne/ legs sbyar skad/ rin po che yi ming la rarna zer/4 rat+na'i 'byung khungs/ rin po che yi 'byung khungs zer ba'i don/rak+ka gdong bzhi/ raka legs sbyar skad/ srin po'i ming srin pogadong bzhi zer/ri rgya klung rgya/ sdig las bcad pa dang ma mtha' bya dang ri dwags 258

bsad mi chog pa'i khrims bzhag ba la zer/ri mchog rma rgyal sbom ra/ rma chen gangs ri pozer/ bod kyi rus lha yin zer srol yod/ze'iltas su phebs/ ri mgor blta gzigs su phebs pa la ri ltas zer/༅spomatho gsum gyi gser zhwa gyon/ ri mthon po'i mgor nyi zer — phog pa la zer/ri 'thor spung 'thor/ lathor lung thor phyogs bzhi mtshams ———brgyad la thor ba'i don/ ri dwags gagor ba/ rngon pa ri dwags gsod du song ba la ri dwags gshor ba zer/ri nya'akhobyas/ mi ngan rang yul la mi 'ongs par sa stong ri stong ོོnas nyal ba ri nyal byas zer/ri ba'i dbal lag 'bum lu/ hor bā thul phyogs kyi dpal ོ brtul zhig la zer/ri po ta la/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs gyi gzhugs gnas lag——zer/ri po pang bskor/ hor bā thul phyogs kyi gyad mi shed chen ri bo —pang bskor la zer/ri bo bagling kyang / brling ni bton pa'i don/ ri bo brtan kyang 259

mgo mjug bsgyur/ri 'bum bstod/ bsang mchod byed pa'am la btsas bstod pa — rlung rta bskyod pa sogs la zer/ri gzigs/ rgyal blon ri mgor phebs nas blta gzigs byas pa la ri gzigs zer/ri gzar zab rdo/ ri gzar ngos su bab rdo bsgril ba ltar zhes rta'i bang rtsal mgyogs myur la zer/ri la jo dar/ ri sang mtho la dar lcog btsugs pa la jo dar zer/ri sul zhig tu gab/ ri khug zhig tu sbas skung bya ba la gab pa zer/ri hi ma la/ hi ma la legs sbyar skad/ bsgyur na gangs ri zer/ri'i thom/ ri'i khrod dam ri'i gseb zer ba'i don/rig pa sor chud pa/ sngar rig pa nyams pa'ang phyir je gsal du 'ong ba la rig pa sor chud zer/rigs lnga'i pog zhu/ prog zhu zhwa'i ming / rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan nam dbu zhwa zer/rigs ldan lcags 'khor can/ shasta la'i rigs ldan drag po'i 'khor lo can la zer bar snyam/rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ rin chen mkha' 'gro/pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro rnams la zer/260

rigs gargutsha mgon po/ 'jam dibyangs/ spyan6ras gzigagaphyag na rdo rje'o// rin chen dang po/ gser la rin chen dang po zer/ gser gyi — ming ngo //rin chen gnyis ba/ dngul la rin chen gnyis pa zer/ dngul gyi ming ngo rin chen sde bdun/ gser/ dngul/ baiḍūr+ya/ spug rdo'i snying bo/ shel/ mu tig dmer po'o/rin chen dang po srang bdun/ gser srang bdun phul ba la rin cen dang po srang bdun zer/ rin chen snya nu ko byu ru'i sdong bo lta bu'i brag las byung rin po che zhig la zer/ ru bkod/ dmag ru bkod sgrig rgyas pa la ru bkod zer/ ru ting gru gu/ dmag mjug gru gu ldog ldog zer ba'i6don/ru dpon/ dmag ru gcig gi dpon po la tsa dpon zer/ru tra nag po/ bdud po ma rungs pa'i ming la ru tra zer/ ru ṭa drag po'i skad dod/ ru sgrigs/ dmag ru sta gon nam gra sgrig byed pa la ru sgrig zer/ru dar/ dmag bskyod skabs bzung ba'i dar la ru dar dang dmako dar zer/261

ru 'dren/ dmag 'dren pa'i dmag dpon la ru 'dren zer/ ru 'dren pā thur/ dmag 'dren dpa' bo zer ba'i don/ru dpon/ dmag bdag gam dmag dpon zer ba'i don/ru shog dpon po/ dmag ru'i shog kha'i dpon po la ru shog dponapo zer/ru shog so so/ dmag khag so so zer ba'i don/rū 'dzing brgyab/ rwa thug brgyab pa la ru 'dzing brgyab zer/rus chen rkang / mi'i brla rkang la rus chen rkang zer/rus chen spug po/ bod kyi rus rgyud la rus chen smug po zer/rus pa'i bse mkhar/ mi'i phung bo yongs la zer/ rus pa'i bse mkhar ma thor na zer ba'i don/rus rgyan/ rus pa las bzos pa'i rgyan cha la rus rgyan zer/rus yab/ sha rus gcig pa'i ya myes la rus yab zer/re gur nag po/ g.yag rtsid las bzos pa'i sbra gur la re gur zer/re ba'i lwa thul/ re lde nag po gyon pa la re ba'i lwa thul zer/ro chag nyil nyil/ mi rta bsad pa'i ro sdong dum ltar chag nyil du btang zer ba'i don/ro bem po/ mi shi ba'i ro la bem po zer/ spyir srog med dngos po la bem po zer/262

jo smyog 'dam/ sha rus khrag gsum phyogs gcig tu bsres pa la ro myog zer/ lho jo zhababa'ilazlogabam̐/4 lkog tu yib pa' me+o so 'og tu sbas pa'i don / ro shun ri ltar/ dmag mang bsad pa'i gyon pa la ro shun zer/ jo sa 'bur zhabs/ ro sa 'thur 'og tu mnan zer ba'i don/ jog mdog ngom/ ngo mdangs nag po ston pa la rog mdog ngom zer — rog po'i dgra/ nag po'i dgra ya la rog po'i dgra yang zer/ rong spug seng phran/ rong phrug seng tshung zer ba yin la/ ge sar la zer/rong 'bum sde khra mo/ stag rong shog chen bco brgyad la zer/4 jong tsho dung gi bla ba/ gling bu rong tsha dmar leb/ gi sar gyi nu bo la zer/ rong bza' khrim shog gling khra rgan dang seng blon gnyis kyi ma yum — sloba'o( rong ston a gyes/ byang gru gu'i yul gyi gzhi bdag mthu chen zhig gi ming la zer/ rol du khrid/ shale du khrid dam rjes su khrid pa'i don/4 — 263

ḍa ṭ+wāṃng༄chung gi rkyal ba 'khun 'debs/ 'dre rje thel mo rkang gcig gi zhon pa la zer/blung rta/ rlung rta'i cho ga'ang yod/ shog ngos su rta'i gzugs dpar te nam mkhar bskyod pa de la rlung (klung) rta zer/glung sbud/ mgar ba'i khol mo la rlung spud zer/ sbud pa yang zer/rlung rdzi phog rlung dang lhan tu mi'i dri bro ba tshor ba la rlung rdzi zer/rlung zer ma yin kyang 'ur ba med/ rlung bser bu yin rung g.yug sa med zer ba'i don/ bagling ba/ g.yo 'gul med par brtan cing brjid pa la brtan brling zer/ḍa r+shang4 ༄la rked/ ri rked la la rked zer ba lags/la /bar/ ri mthon po'i mgo'am rtse la la mgo'am la kha zer/la kha dang lam so/ ri mgo'am lam kha'i so ba dang sa srung la zer/la kha'i dar lcog ri mgor btsugs pa'i dar la la kha'i dar lcog zer/264

thob kha'i sdopar/ la mgo'i sob la la kha'i gya ra zer/ sgo gsa'i lug / la mgo ri mgo'i bug rdzi la zer/ la kha'i sha po / stod ri mgo'i sha pho zer ba'i don/ la rgyab/ ri'i ltag rgyab la la rgyab kyang zer/ la brgal lung brgal/— la 'gro lung 'gro zer ba'i don dang mthun/ la gcamasab/ la mgo lamakha'i so ba dang sa srung lazer/ la nye bzang / las don grub pa'am rten 'brel 'grigs zer ba'i don/ — la thod dkar dmar/ rgyal blon dag gi mgo dkris kyi ras dkar dmar la lathod dkar dmar zer/ la rting / ri rtsa'am ri zhol la zer/ la mgo'i so ba la rting gi myul mazer/ la bang med/ ri thang med pa'i don la zer/ yang bya ba yid ches med pa la yang go thang med dag dag med zer/la dwags/ stod mnga' ris byang phyogs su gtogs pa'i yul zhig gi ming / la mo/ la mo' ma la gor ni myu ra mo'i don la zer/ lo5 rtse je la so ba zhogs/ ri mgo re la so ba zhogs/ lung mdo re la myul ma zhogs zer ba'i don/265
