mkhabatsas/ (lab rtse〉 ri mgo'am khos rkar brtsigs pa'i la btsa4la zer/ sa rtags chu rtags 'byed byed kyi rtags kyi ming yin zer srol yod/la tshu'akha ba/ lamakha'i sgo khral sdud pa po la la tshugs pa zer/la so chu so/ sasrung lam srung / chu kha rab kha srung ba po la la sochu so zer/la gsum bya ra/ ri mgo'i so ba zer ba la la gsum bya ra zer/lag mgobarjes/ lag pa'i phu dung yar badzes pa'i don/lag ngar/ lag pa'i rus pa'i lcags ngar la zer/lag do/ tshong pa'i lag g.yog pa la lag do zer/lag do go bgos/ tshong pas lag g.yog pa phyogs phyogs su go skogyibagos pa'i don la zer/lag na rdo rje/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la zer/lag pas dom ra/ lag sor mig steng du bkab nas bltas pa la zer/lag pas ma theg lag pas yar ma 'khyogs zer ba'i don/lag dmar/ mi bsad ba'i dme bo'am shan pa la lag dmar zer /lag sor bcu/ lag pa'i sor mo bcu la lag sor bcu zer/langs mal gsos/ langs pa sar ma bsdad pa'i ngal gso byasab lalangs mal gsos zer/266

laska bu ri/ srin po rgyal po laṅka mgrin bcu'i pho brang la zer/man tshar/ lam tshar ni kha tshar la zer/ dar dkar kha tshar can zer ba'i don/ —lan rtsa/ las lan gyi rtsa ba'am gyod rtsa zer ba'i don/la ba rtse blogs/ lab tse'am la btsas slogs ni kha skad la rdzog zer/lam skya mo sdog lam skya mo gcod pa'i 'do drug rta zer/ ldog ni gcod pa'i don/lam bde gzar/ bde lam dang gzar lam gnyis la bde gzar lam zer/lam mgron/ lam du 'gro ba'i 'grul ba la lam mgron zer/lam 'gol ba/ dben lam dang gsang lam lta bu 'gol lam zer/lar nas/ gtan nas zer ba'i don yin par sems/ lar nas byed rgya med/ gtan nas byed rgyu med zer ba'i don/las mkhan gdong bzhi/ 'phrin las sgrub mkhan gyi lha zhig la zer/gdong bzhi ni mgobazhi zer ba'i don/las gur dkar mo/ gzhung las sgrub sa'i gur la las gur zer/las rta thang dkar/ rta'i mgyogs 'gros rgod thang dkar la dpe sbyar nas bshad pa'o/ /zubs rnam bzhi/ zhi ba'i las/ rgyas pa'i las/ dbang gi las/267

drag po'i las rnams so/ /las dbang rdzogs/ sku gshegs pa'am las kyi mtha' rdzogs pa la las mtha' rdzogs zer/las mi g.yel/ bya ba byed tshe g.yel ba mi byed par hur brtson rang bzhin 'don pa'i don/las smon ngan grub/ las dang smon lam bzang po ma grub pa la las smon ngan grub zer/'a sa dmag hrag 'thus/ dmapa / mang nang nas mi rta bzar po bdams pa la hrag 'thus zer/li khri/ mdog dmar ser can la li khri'e mdog can zer/li sgam/ rgyu li las bzos pa'i sgam la li sgam zer/li rmog gling brgyad/ rgyu li las bzos pa'i rmog zhwa zur brgyad la zer/li ma'i sku/ rgyu zangs gser las bzos pa'i sku 'dra la li ma zer/li li'u rtug pa/ 'jab bu mkhan byi la'i rtug pa zer/li shi dri bzang ldan pa'i sman gyi rigs shig la zer/ling tog gis sgrib/ mig 'bras steng sprin ltar chags nas sgrib pa la ling tog gis sgrib zer/lings kyis 'gyel/ mi rta glo bur du mgo lings kyis 'gyel ba la zer/268

lu the rdol/ rmya rme chu'i ming / ༷ chu mgau rdole ba bzhin zer beskyang don/ — 4 nga sherge rkang 'theng / lug rkeng gyol lam kongo chag zer ba'i —done/ ོ lug gi gzhug gu/ lug gi tshang (mtshang) ra la gzhug gu yang zer/43ga 'gel/ lug la khal bkal ba'i tshong pa la lug 'gel tshong pa zer/ the:ga thug khrom lug la lug thug kyang zer/lug thong ba/ pho lug so gnyis sam so bzhi'i dus su thong ba zer/lug don po/ g.yang lug don po ni tshe thar la btang ba'i4lug la zer/ lug gdong5rgyag spad/ khrom lug chen pos gdong thug brgyab paṃ la zer/ lug galang dkar ma bu 'dres ba/ lug mang 'dres na 'ba' dir dang dmag mang 'dres na ki dir che ba la zer/lugabakhiganyis/ chos srid dang chab srid gnyis la lugs gnyis zer/lung rje snod gsum/ 'dul ba/ mdo sde/ mngon pa gsum la zer/lung ba 'be+er der re/ lung ba 'ur dir re btang zer bar snyam/269

byungaphanasgom chu/ lung ba gsupogyi chu phyogs gcig tu blang4ba la——lung gsum chu zer/dzing mda' na nyul ma/ lung gsum gyi mdo na nyul ma zer b.lidon/lum bu/ nyung ma'i3gas shig lazer/ sacha la lasam rdog lum bu zer/lus kyi gsum/ rtsa dbu ma/ ro ma/ brkyang ma gsum la zer/lus skyes g.yo ba/ lus skyes ba spu'i ming / sbag nas ba spu gzengs zer/thab skyob bzang ngan/ dpa' bo'i go khrabanyubazang ngan lalus —skyabs bzang ngan zer/lus lcang lo g.yo g.yo/ lus 'dar ba lcang lo rlung gis bskyod pa —bzhin zer ba'i don/lus lto dkar/ nya'i rigs la lus lto dkar zesalus 'phyor po/ mi shom can rgyan gos mdzes pa cadalasaphyor ོro'ang zer/lus pongs che ba/ lus stobs che la sbom zhing sku gzigs ha cang —che ba'i don/lus bem gogami shi bo lus phung la bem gog zer/lus ma zhigatshe 'di nas lus ma brjes pa la lus ma zhig kyang zer/270

zasabardzus sa/ me tog gi spubs las 'khrubs ba la brdzusaskyes zer/lus a bang chad/ lus ngab zhing dub pa la a thang chad kyadza zer/ me bda'/ rang zhe ma tshim pas gzhan la las ded pas 'gyod tshig bshad pa la zer/ mes bda'am les 'ded/ bya ba yolegs pas 'gyod gtam dnganang las ded pa la zer/bags nyes labatang / 'chi mi dgos sa nas shi ba la legs nyes la btang zer/ leb na/ leb chen ni ral gri'i ming / mtshonaleb chen dgra bo'i gogazan zer/ meb zheng / thad zheng gi tshechung la ba zhengang zer/lo na ltar/ ༅re re bzhin dngalo ltar zer ngal lo rgyun kho zer/mobargya / ma sru bu mo rnams la lo brgya 'tsho r+sā don du kha g.yang brjodathun/'ongastogasabaja mi/ lo tog 'breg mi zer ba la lo tog brnga mi yang —zer/molhag ba tshob / dgra miyo tog 'breg 'breg zer ba'i don/mosnyi ba shes/ gnam logyi ba'i lo la zer ba yin/ 271

lo yar ra nga sa e zin/ lo shas sam lo 'ga' re zer ba la lo yar zer/longs spyod 'khor lo/ mgrin pa la zer/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo zer/lwa 'dabs yar brjes/ gyon gos kyi 'dabs ka yar la brdzes zer ba'i don/ḍa rnyi sha ko'i gru gcig ma nyams/ sha ko cha tshang ba zhig la sha ko'i gru ma nyams pa zer/sha khu grang long med/ sha btsos na sha khu 'khyags khom med zer ba'i don/sha kham khrag thigs/ sha kham re dang khrag thigs re zer ba la sha kham khrag thigs zer/sha khog gcig sha gzug gcig gam sha bubs gcig la sha khog gcig zer/sha khrag bubs su ma 'khrungs/ ma'i mngal nas ma btsas zer ba'i don/sha khyi/ sha bo gshor ba'i khyi la sha khyi zer/sha rgo rkyang gsum/ byang stong ri dwags sha ba rgo ba rkyang gsum gyi pha 2 72

sa zer ba'i don/ she rgo gnyis/ ri dwags sha ba'am rgo ba gnyis la sha rgo gnyi sa zer/sha rgod 'dar/ thugs khros nas gdong sha 'dar ba la sha rgod 'dar zer/ sha sgro spug po/ khro thung la sha snod kyi sgro ba ya mtshan can zhig yod pa de la zer/ sha dga' ma/ nyag phran gyi mda' la zer/ yang srin po dang spyang ki la'ang zer/sha mgo dgos/ dgun gsum sha khral dgos zer/ sha mgo ni sha khral zer ba'i don/sha thag bcad/ sha thag ni rta sga'i steje dngos po sdom spyad kyi rgyun thag la zer/ sha thang chad/ 'thab drags nas mi rta thang chad pa la sha thang tshad zer/sho dzibu/ pha sha rtsod pa'i dpa' rgod po zer ba'i don/sha pha bu ni skabs 'gar sdig rgan 'phung rgan gte bo sogs la 'jug par snyam/— she pho chen dung ra / — sha rwa dkar po dung gi gzugs su bkod pas sha pho chin dung rwa zer shang ba'i bu mo mdo sgron/ mi min shang shang yul gyi sman gyi bdag 273

mo zhig gi ming /sha ba'i mal༅nga / mal khung ni nyal sa zer ba'i don/ stod richen sha pho'i mal khung zer ba'i don/sha mo sul mang / sha mo ste/ sul mang ni khong na rtsib rus ltar ri mo mang ba zer/sha rtsa sngo ba/ zhal mdangs sngo la smug rtsi chags pa la sha rtsa sngo ba ོzer/ sha yis mi ::ma/ sha khrag la longs ci 'dra spyad kyang yid mi tshim —zer ba'i don/sha rwa bcu/ sha pho rwa bcu lag can la garwa bcu zer/sha len/ pha bsad bu yis dgra sha len pa la sha len zer/sha lo dkar ba/ sha mdangs dkar ba la sha lo dkar ba'ang zer/sha zhor sha len/ rang mi dgras bsad pa la sha shor zer/ dengadagra sha len pa la sha len zer/shar dmag ha la 'phen/ shar smug gu'i dmag dpung tshar bcad pa'i don/shar rdo rje sems dpa'/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhigala'o//shan pa rgya dmang/ shan pa ag tshom yod pas ra ma lta bu'i man tshar can yin pas rgya dmar zer/shan pa sdig zhad/ shan pa sdig rgan zer ba dang mtshungs/274

shan ba bye'u snyingag na ba sdar mgyemu snyinga'adra ba red ces dma' 'bebs byas pa red/ shan pa'i a nu yin/ shan pa'i bu chung yin zer ba'i don/shan 'dan/ hor shan pa dang gling tsha zhang 'dan ma gnyis la shan 'dan zer/ rgam rul/ smad gos hrul po'am chad po zer ba la sham rul zer/shar me shel dbangapha/ nyi ma'i ming la me shel da bang bo'ang zer/ shar lung ri drug gling tsha zhang 'dan ma'i mkhar rdzong la zer/shi khung phug nas/ dur khung phug nas blta zer ba'i don/shi lcebakhag kha mchongag kha skad la shi thub ning thub byos zer bar shāstica//shi༄chang ro 'chang / shi 'dzin ro 'dzin zer ba'i don/gi 'thob ro 'bab/ rang srog la ma bltas pa'i 'thab 'khrugs ——byas pa lazer shi bo53nga gangag mi shi ba'i ming ladzibo zer/ shi bo'i ro lung ngagang zer/ shi ma gapon/ phar ma shi tshur gagason ba la shi ma gson zer/gi sa 'tshol/ dur sa sbas sa 'tshol zer ba'i don/4'kho gi grog tshang / shig sro mamang ba'i grog ma'i tshang 'dra zer — don/ 273

shing skya ring lcags kyi kha spu can/ mdung gi ming la zer/shing gi sna gcu/ mdzo g.yag gi sna bug brgyus pa'i shing kor de la ོsna gcu zer/shing thog gi zhal skyems/ mngar chang sil tog gi khu ba la zer/shing thog drul/ shing thog sa la lhung ba la sa la brul yang zer/shing 'thu sgar/ bud shing 'thu ba'i dmag sgar la shing 'thu sgar zer/shing bal tsher mgo shing bal ni kha skad la ma mog zer/ dper na ma mog tsher mgor g.yeng 'dra zer/shing a ṭa/ pa ṭa/ nags rdzab rdzob tsher phung lta bu la zer/shug lo sngon po/ shug sdong gi lo ma la shug lo sngon po zer/shed chen gyi ya po/ shed chen gyi 'gran ya zer ba'i don/shel dkar bgrang phreng / shel dkar gyi phreng ba la bgrang phreng zar/she'u/ sha ba'i phru gu la she'u phrug zer/she'u chung khra po/ sha ba'i phrug gu la she'u chung khra bo'ang zer/sheja/ go rig blo rig pa la shes go rig kyang zer/sho mang blon pa/ rtswa ldum zhig gi ming la sho mang zer/tho gam pa/ sho rtse mkhan la tho gam pa yang zer/tho sngags brgyab/ khro thung gis sho mo bsgrubs te mo rtsis byas pa la zer/276

tho de'u/ tho rtse spyad kyi rde'u gru bzhi re'u mig can la sho rde'u zer/9dorgo༄ gshin rje byed/ lha gshin rje gshed dmar la zer/gzhin po/ mi shi bo'i ming la zer gshen rabs/ bon po'i ston pa gshen rabs la zer/ r+shargo༄bshad shā de rang yin/ bshad pa de kho na'am sha stag zer ba'i don/ bshan thang / shan pas zog lug bsha' ra la bshan thang zer/bsha' ba bdun cu/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i shan pa bdun cu la zeza(/bshas ra/ skam lug bsha' sa'i ra ba la bshas ra zer/bshud pa btab/ dbugs kyis shug skad btab pa la zer/9 1r+sha4—༄sa kha'i rtsi thog dmag grangs mang ba sa steng gi rtsi thog 'dra zer ba'i don/277

sa ga zla ba/ lugs rnying hor zla bzhi ba la sa ga zla ba zer/sa mda' / sa 'og tu mi mngon pa'i byi long gsod pa'i mda' zhig bzhag pa la sa mda' zer/sa mda' ma bskor/ sa cha la lung ma song zer ba'i don/sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ sa 'gul rigs mi gcig pa rnam pa —drug tu 'gul zer/sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ sa gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi gzugs su bkod/sa mod gling / gling dkar yul la sa mod gling zhes zer sa'ang yod/sa rdzab/ sa ngan nam sa rdzab rdzob mi gtsang ba'i don la sa rdzab zer/sa zang gad pa skya ring / gling rgya tsha zhal dkar gyis sku srog phul sa'i sa ming la'o//sa 'og byi long / bra tsug las cung che ba'i sa rlogs pa'i srog —chags shig gi ming /sa bayo sa na/ sa shig shig yom yom du 'gul na zer ba'i don/sa ra ca ba/ rkya gar gyi grub chen zhig gi ming la zer/sa la byi rgya/ byi ba dang byi long la rgya dang rnyi bzhag pa la byi rgya zer/sa la 'dzul dgu/ byi ba byi long 'phyi ba sogs khung du 'dzul ba'i 278

srog chags dgu la zer/sa grin nag po/ lag pas reg mi nyan pa'i rma nad zhig la zer/sa spod pa dang mnyam du/ sa rug (rub) pa dang mnyam du zer —ba'i don/sa gsum/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla gsum la zer/sa'i drod khung / sa dro sa la sa'i drod khung yang zer ro//sag thag mda' shubs 'dogs spyad kyi rgyun thag la zer/sang gi nyi ma/ nangs ku'i nyi ma la sang gi nyi ma yang zer/sang gi lha nyin dkar po/ nangs ku'i lha nyin dkar po zer ba'i —don/sang zhogs ba/ nangs ka snga mo zer ba'i don la sang zhogs kyang zer/sang sang gu re/ sang sang bla ma zer/ hor gyi bla ma zhig gi ming /sang sang thogs med gu ru/ hor shan pa'i bla mchod bla ma rdzu 'phrul can zhig gi mtshan la zer/sangs rgyas stong gi dbu lo/ sangs rgyas stong gi dbu skra 'a dbu lo zer/sangs rgyas spyan ma/ lha mo zhig gi mtshan la zer/sī ta/ rgya gar gyi chu chen 'ig gi ming / chu bo sī ta zer/sin+tu'i mtsho/ o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas 'khrungs gnas kyi ma tsho la 279

zer/dzi/la le 'khrug ge ldem/ sil sil ldem ldem ngang ba'i 'gros ltar 'gro/ ba la zer/ sug cab chag sug rkang chas/ zer ba'i don yin par sems/sum cu rtsa gsum/ lha'i gnas te/ nor lha brgyad drag po bcu gcig nyi ma bcu gnyis dang tha skar gyi bu gnyis te nye dbang so gnyis dang brgya byin bcas so gsum la zer/sum nga ra 'bri mo/ lo gsum la 'o ma ma skam pa'i 'bri mo la sum yar 'bri mo zer/se kha nag bya go bo rus gzan la se kha nag kyang zer/se ler thung / seng chen rgya0pre pos bdud yul du 'phangs pa'i phyag mda' zhig gi ming /seng ge 'gying rdzong / shar smug gu rgyal po'i mkhar rdzong gi ming /seng se jams pa/ seng ge'i 'jigs pa zer ba dang mtshungs/seng ge gnam rdzong / gling mi chen rgyal ba lhun grub kyi rdzong la'o//seng ge rdzong dang stag mo rjong / seng ge rdzong stab mo rjong khra yag rdzong dom bu'i rdzong 'di bzhi la smug gu'i rdzong bzhi zer/seng lcam/ gling seng chen gyi btsun mo 'brug mo la zer/ seng ci ma me tog 'di yang 'brug cho/'i mi nga grangs shigaseng chu/ zhang zhung gi chu bo chen po 'i/ga gi ming la seng chu zer/280

seng stag a dom/ gling dpa' thul sum cu'i yang snying a dom seng stag la'o//seng thang na ba khra leb/ smug gling gnyis kyi sa mtshams kyi thang — chen zhig la zer/seng spyang phrug ge sar la sang spyang phrug ces pha rol pas ngan smras byas so//seng phrug thod pa'i sku mkhar/ seng chen rgyal po'i gzim shag la zer/seng blon ri skyes/ seng chen rgyal po'i yab kyi mtshan la zer/seng blon rong tsha gnyis/ pha yab seng blon dang a myes rong tsha khra rgan gnyis la zer/seng zhu gsol/ seng zhwa gyon pa la seng zhu gsol zer/sems skyid khong la mi shong / sems skyid po khong la mi chud zer ba'i don/sems 'khu khrigs/ sems mi bde zhing dogs pa skyes pa'i don la zer/sems can don dgongs/ 'gro ba sems can gyi don thugs la bzung ba'i don/sems nad tsher mi byed/ snying nad ches cher mi byed zer ba'i don/281

sems bem po/ lus dang sems gnyis so sor kha bral ba la lus —bem po kha bral zer/sems tshig mi dgos/ sems tshegs sems khrel byed mi dgos zer ba'i don/sems la wa le/ sems na gsal lam/ me zer ba' don/ser chung wa/ mi skrag shor dang sdar ma snying chung la zer/ser chung kher 'gro/ wa cho/ kher 'gro zhes mi nus med la zer/ser ba thog 'gyur/ nyo ra pu ra nag phyogs kyi dmag dpon zhi ga gi ming /ser lpags kyi thul ba/ wa lpags kyi gyon gos thul ba la zer/so sgra dkrigs pa/ zhe sdang langs nas so sgra tsig tsig byed pa la ོzer/so sgra gro yos brngo bajo/ so 'chas pa'i sgra tsag tsag gro yos brngos 'dra red zer ba'i don/so brgya gcig mthun/ kha brgya ga cig mthun zer ba la so brgya gcig mthun zer/so kha/ ral gri'i dbal kha'am so kha la so lam yang zer/so nyul/ (myul/ so ba dang nyul ma gnyi4 / kyi ming bsdus te so nyul zer/so mtshams/ sa mtshams la so mtshams kyang zer/282

so 'dzin/ rwa tse mgo'i du ba jub spyad kyi spugs gu la so 'dzin ོzer/so la sdod/ dgra la blta ba'i so ba la sdod zer ba'i don/sog ske ras can/ sog dmag ras kyi ske dkris can la sog ske ras can zer/ sog ca la can/ sog po'i zhwa mgor zi skud dmar po bstar yod pas sog ca la can zer/sog bza' li khri/ stag gzig rgyal po'i btsun mo la zer/sog ser po/ sog rigs spyi la sog ser po zer srol yod/sor de'u 'phangs/ mdzub mo'i rtse nas de'u chung 'phangs pa la ོ sor rde'u zer/sor gdub/ na chung bu mo'i mdzub dkris la sor gdub zer/sol ba/ shing bsregs pa'i mgal ba la sol ba zer/sos ga dpyid ka zer ba'i don/ sos ku'am so ku'ang zer/sos dal nyin/ sos dal dus dang sos dal ba'i nyi ma zer ba'i —don/7 ṭ+wāṃ༄༄sram bul/ sram gyi mtha' sham can gyi gyon pa la sram thul can ོzer 283

sram thul dkar khra/ sram lpags kyis bzos/ pa'i lwa ba'am thul ba la zer/sras mo 'dzam gling mdzes sgron/ mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i sra sa mo la zer/sring lcam thal le 'od 'phro/ ge sar rgyal po'i lha'i sring mo lazer/srid pa tho yi ya bdag 'jig rten sho yi bdag po zer ba'i don/srid pa phyu yi bskos thang / 'jig rten las kye bskos thar/ zer ba'i don/srid pa'i skyid sdug 'jig rten skyid sdug zer ba dang gcig go/srid pa'i zo dor/ srid pa'i lha srung zer ba la srid pa'i zo dor zer/srid gsum/ steng lha'i srid pa/ bar mi'i srid pa/ 'og klu'i srid pa'o//srin khe tshe ra/ mi rigs shig gi ming / deng sar hor sog he he gang du gtogs pa mi shes/srin po/ sha khrag za ba la ha cang rngam che ba'i mi rigs shig ‘pa zer/srin po'i rlung gi ra ba/ srin po'i ngan sngags shig gi ming la zer/srin po'i tshogs ra/ srin po'i 'du ra zer ba'i don la'o//bran bya/ 'ug pa che chung la srin bya zer/284

srin lag mthe'u chung gong gi mdzub mo la srin /dzub zer/sras mo he grab/ bdud kyi bang mdzod srung ba'i nor lha zhig gi ming la zer/sru kha rag bza'/ khro thung gi chung ma'i ming la zer/srung 'khor/ nad rims gdon bgegs srung ba'i 'khor lo la srung 'khor zer/srung mdud/ bla mas dar gos sogs kyi mdud pa gnang ba la srung mdud zer/srung dmag rgyal po'i sku srung dmag la srung dmag zer/srid thab/ brgya byin gyi bu la zer/ dmug thabs srid sgrub dang mtshungs/srid pa khog mo rog rdzong / stag rong khro thung gi mkhar rdzong la zer/sreg khang / gdung bzhu ba'i thab ka la sreg khang zer/sreg phrug bya sreg pa'i phrug gu la sreg phrug zer/sro ma badz+ra/ gling gi blon chung kha bde sro ma rdo rje la zer/spog mgo bton pa/ srog skyabs nus pa la srog mgo bton pa'am thon pa zer/grog bdag rgyal po/ zhang zhung bon gyi chos skyong zhig gi ming /spog bdag tshangs pa/ rgyal po dung thod can la srog bdag tshangs 285

pa'ang zer/srol/ phar bsngos/ rang srog la ma bltas par dgra lag gi shi ba la zer/spog dmar ha la 'phen/ lus srog gtong ba la srog da mar ha la 'phen zer/srog la mi blta ba/ gces pa'i srog la mi blta bar gzhung don du shi ba la zer/srog shor/ dmag mang bsad pa la srog shor mang po zer/ḍa rgo4— ༄slog hrul/ slog pa kha skad la stsog pa zer/ stsag chad zer ba dang 'dra/blong mo/ sprang bo lto slong ba po la slong mo zer/bslab gsum/ tshul khrims kyi bslab pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bslab pa/ shes rab kyi bslab pa'o//ḍa |rge ༄gsang gtam/ bka' rgya ma gzhan la bshad mi rung ba'i gtam logasang gtam zer/gsang gnas/ pho'i mtshan ma la gsang gnas kyang zer/gsang ba'i 'khor lo/ bud med kyi mtshan ma la gsang ba'i 'khor 286

lo zer/gsan phyogs med/ nyan 'dod med pa'am nyan sems med zer ba'i don/gsan pa'i mi tshad/ nyan pa'i mi tshad bsams dgos zer ba'i don/gsa' ri mo can/ gzig 'dra ba'i ri dwags mdog skya bo thig le — can zhig la zer/gsal 'tsher gnyis/ nyi zla gnyis la gsal 'tsher gnyis zer/gsal shing rtser skyon/ mi nag can bkyigs nas dar shing gi rtse la btags pa la zer/gsung ma ṇi yig drug ma ṇi yi ge drug la gsung ma ṇi yig drug zer gsung ye mi 'byon/ skad cha gtan nas mi bshad zer ba la gsung ye nas mi 'byon zer/gsung gleng / bka' 'gros dang kha ta mang po byas pa la bgro gleng zer/gser rkyan/ ja dem gyi ming / zangs ser las bzos pa la zangs rkyan zer/gser sku/ rgyu gser las bzos pa'i sku 'dra la gser sku zer/gser gling / rgya gar shar phyogs za hor yul la gser gling zer 287

yin min cha ma 'tshal/gser gling ka na dha ri/ byang shang shang rol ba sde bdun chags gnas la zer/ gser gling seng grags/ byang gru gu rgyal po'i blon chen zhig gi ming la zer/gser sga nyi ma rang shar/ seng chen rgyal po'i chibs sga 'a zer/gser gyi mgur mo/ gser gyi dong tshe'am gser rdog po zhig pa zer bar snyam/gser gyi gan dzir ra/ gser tog dang pa tra lta bu la zer bar rtagazuṭa/gser gyi ṭam ga gser gyi dong tse dang skar ma lta bu la ṭam ga zer/gser gyi khem bu cha gcig gser gyi thur ma cha gcig zer ba'i don/gser gyi phrog zhu/ gser zhwa 'dra ba'i ban zhwa ser po zhis/ la prog zhu zer/gser gyi sprin pa ris/ gos chen gser gyi sprin ris can la zer/gser gyi sor gdub/ gser gyi mdzub dkris la sor gdub kyang zer/gser gyi gsol phor/ gser gyi dkar yol la gsol phor yang 288

zer/gser mgul mo/ gser srang dang zho la mgul mo zer bar snyam/gser 'gu/ gser gyi mgul rgyan ga'u la zer/gser dacal rgya 'gyog gser dngul rgya ma tshad pa la rgya 'gyogs zer/gser ṭam/ gser gyi dong tse la gser gyi ṭam ka zer/gser thog phab/ hor gur dkar rgyal po'i las gur steng gi gser thog phab pa la zer/gser dem/ gser gyi pa tra can gyi ja dem la gser dem zer/gser gdugs khri mkhar/ 'di yang gling seng chen gyi mkhar rdzong la zer/gser mdong mgul dkris can/ gser gyi mdong mo dngul gyi pa tra can la zer/gser 'bri rgod ldem/ rmog 'phru ser po'i steng du rgod sgro btsugs pa la zer/gser 'phru can/ rmog 'phru'i mdog ser po can la gser 'phru can zer/gser ba'i nyi 'bum/ seng chen rgyal po'i blon chen gser ba'i nyi 'bum dar lu la zer/gser zhu/ gser zhwa zer ba'i don/ bla ma'i dbu zhwa gser rtsi can 289

la zer/gser zhu tho lo lo/ gser zhwa ser lam lam zer ba'i don/gser zhun/ gser bzhus pa'i khu ba la gser zhun zer/gser yol/ gser gzhong la gser gyi yol go zer/gso chas/ rta zog gso ba'i gzan chas la gso chas zer/gson rting 'khor nges/ tshe mjug rdzogs nges zer ba'i don/gson dang 'dra ma/ nyon dang zhu rgyu 'di 'dra zer ba la 'dra ma 'di 'dra zer/gson lpags bshu/ mi gson po'i pags pa bshus zer ba'i don/gson lpags thang bting / mi gson po'i pags pa bshus pas sa la bting zer/gson bral/ mi ma shi gson po kha bral ba la gson bral zer/gsob chos/ chos rnam dag ma yin pa'i rdzun chos la gsob chos zer/gsol chu/ bzhes chu'am 'thung chu la gsol chu zer/gsol 'dren/ bla dpon la za ma 'dren pa la gso' 'dren zer/gsol dpon/ ja ma chen po'i ming / gsol dpon chen mo'ang zer/gsol phog zas za ma'i rigs phul ba la gsol phog brgyab zer/gsol phor/ 'thung dkar la bzhes phor dang gsol phor yang ོ290

zer/gsol tshigs bzhes/ spyir btang du za ma zos zer ba la gsol tshigs bzhes zer/gsol bzhes drangs/ bla dpon la za ma drengs pa la gsol bzhes drangs zer/7nga9zhas༄bsang sa/ bsang gtong skabs dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs la bsang rdzas zer/ bsam mno btang / bsam blo btang dang bsam mol btang ba'i don la zer/ 4bsam pa sog le kha gnyis/ ngo gnyis ma dang mgo bde bo la zer/bsam blo skor/ dgra dang rang phyogs gang la bsam blo gtong ba'i don la zer/ bsil zer can/ zla ba bsil ba'i rang bzhin can yin pas bsil zer can zer/bse dri/ dri ngan la bse dri zer/ ra dug la bse dri bro/ mi la bse dri bro ba zer/bse yi la lud/ khrab rmog 'khor gsum la ya lud btsan po'ang 2rdo1

zer/bse rag a bra/ srog chags pra tsug la bse rag a pra zer/bses ma/bar/ mgon khang dang la btsas sogs la bses mkhar zer/bses ma/bar gru bzhi/ lha mkhar gru bzhi mda' mdung gis brgyan zer/bsod zad/ bsod nams zad pa'i mi la bsod zad zer/ tsho rte ༄—— ha phas bdag po 'dris pa/ ha pha ni khyi chung la kha skardo ltar ha pha zer bar snyam/ha yang / smug gu'i dpa' bo'am dpal brtul can la ha yang zer/ha yang brgyad cu/ dpa' rgod brgyad cu zer ba dang don gcigaha yang brgyad cu'i dwangs rtse/ dpa' rgod brgyad cu'i gtso bo'am yang snying zer ba'i don/ha la 'phangs/ dmag mang gi mgo ske shor nas bsad drags pa zer/ha la 'phen pa'i dus/ lus srog gtong ba'i dus la babs zer ba'i don/ha la'i dug ha la nag po'i don/ dug nag po zer ba'i don/292

ha yo dkar po/ me tog tsam pa ka dkar po la ha lo dkar po zer/ha lo'i me tog me tog tsam pa ka la ha lo'i me tog zer/ha ha nye nye/ g.yul gyes pa'i skabs dpa' bos ha ha he he zhes gad rgyangs sgrog pa la zer/hi mā la/ legs sbyar skad/ gangs ri la hi ma la zer/hab cha dir ri/ mi mang bzhad gad dir re la hab cha dir re yang zer hab thob/ gzhan rgyu la brnabs sems sgos hab rngam byed pa la zer/hab hab kyi ngang / zas la rngam rngam zer ba la hab hab zer/ham pa can/ 'dod zhen che ba'am ham 'dod can la zer/ham pa ri las che/ 'dod rngam ri rab las che zer ba'i don/ham lab/ ham pa che ba'i gtam la ham gtam dang ham lab zer/ham shed je che/ 'dod rngam je che zer ba'i don/har langs/ glo bur du yar langs pa la har langs zer/har shar khrel dgod/ gad rgyangs chen po'am bzhad sgra chen po byed pa la'o//hu shu 'don pa/ sems la skyo ba skyes nas shugs ring 'don pa la'o//hu bed rwa gcod/ hor gur ser gyi ral gri la zer/293

hu tshos sngon po'i sked 'ching / ling sngon po'i ska rags la hu tshos sngon po zer/hu shu g.yag rgod ngar ngar/ dpa' bo'i ngar sgra g.yag rgod ngar ngar zer/hur re lus/ skrag ste ha las nas bsdad pa la hur re lus zer/ho ma ya/ srog rtsa chod dang rdul du brlags zer ba'i don / hor thog rgyal/ hor gyi rgyal po snga rabs la thog thog ral chen rgyal po zer/hob 'drogs/ drel rta glo bur du 'drogs pa la hob 'drogs zer/hor rtswa ra pad+ma stong ldan/ hor rgyal chen gsum gyi rtswa bkag dang spro sangs byed sa la zer/hor gyi phung rgan/ hor gur dkar glang gnya' tshil rkyal la zer/hor gling 'khrugs nyin/ hor gling 'khrugs pa'i nyi ma nas bzung zer ba'i don/hor rgyal po khyi kha ra mchu/ hor stag zhu gur dkar rgyal po la ོzer/hor rgyal po mched gsum/ hor gur dkar/ gur ser/ gusanag gsum la'o//hor rje'i lag na/ las ci byed hor rje'i lag na yod zer ba'i ོdon/294

hor stod ma smad la byer/ hor stod ma smad la bros zer ba'i don/hor thog thog ral chen/ hor gyi rgyal po thog ma'i ming jo rus 'ur rdos bkrongs pa yin/hor jig pa ra tsa/ hor sdig can shan pa'i pha yi ming la zer/ hor 'dug byas/ 'gying stabs su bzhugs pa la hor 'dug zer/hor 'dra/ mi sdig can gtum spyod can la hor 'dra zer/hor ba/ bya bye'u gsod pa'i skya khra hor ba la zer/hor mo gos hrul gyon pa/ hor gyi sa srung mi min 'dre srin zhig la zer/hor zhwa dmar po ru lib/ hor sdig can shan pa'i zhwa la zer/hor zam ring mo/ hor chu kham pa'i zam ring la hor zam ring mo zer/hor la bya ma btang na/ hor la gsang brda ma btang na zer ba'i don/hor lam kha'i dgra gsum/ snyob pa lag ring / mthong ba mig rnon/ dpung ba shed chen gsum la zer/hor sar ye med/ hor ser po gtan med dang rtsa brlags zer ba'i don/snye ha ra sog ga sog po'i rigs las chad pa'i mi rigs shig gi 295

ming 7 7tram̐ ༄hrag thus/ mi rgod rta rgod gang bzang la hrag thus zer/hrag bsdus/ mi rta gang bzang bsdus pa la hrag bsdus zer/hril gyis/ phyogs gcig lhan cig mnyam gcig tu zer ba'i don/hril gyis log yongs rdzogs su phyir log zer ba'i don/ rnyi 4—༄ lha khri nyi ma kun gsal/ sog khu ye rgyal po'i blon chen zhig gi ming /lha gur/ bla dpon bzhugs gur la lha gur zer/lha gur mthong ba kun smon/ gling seng chen gyi bzhugs gur la zer/lha lcam/ rgyapa po'i btsun mo la lha lca/ma yang zer/lha chab gyi bsil rgyun/ chu gtsang gi thigs rgyun bran pa la bsel rgyun zer/lha chen tshangs pa/ gling seng chen gyi lha'i yul gyi yab pa zer/lha rje/ lha rje ni sman pa'i ming / 'tsho byed mkhan yang zer/296

lha 'jig rten mgon po/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan/ lha tho/ lha srung gnas pa'i la btsas lta bu la lha tho zer/lha de'u/ ri chung la ri de'u dang lha de'u yang zer/lha bdud gdong thug lha dang bdud gnyis gdong thug nas 'thab pa la zer/lha 'dre 'ching ba'i zhags pa/ lha 'dre sdom nus pa'i thag pa la lha 'dre 'ching zhags zer/lha po ti'i mgul phreng / mgrin rgyan lta bu'i phreng ba rin po che zhig la zer/lha phrug thos dga'/ ge sar lha yul na yod skabs kyi ming la zer/lha bran/ mnga' bdag gam rgyal po'i 'bangs la lha bran zer/lha tshangs dbang / lha'i gtso bo tshangs pa dang brgya byin gnyis la tshangs dbang zer/lha rdzas/ kha btags dang gos btags sogayol lha rdzas zer/lha zhags 'od ldan/ gling rgya tsha/ri 'phrul zhags dkar po 'od 'phro la zer/lha ri khung rtse/ gling lha bsang gtong sa'i ri la zer/lha la gtang rag gtang rag ni dga' ston gyi don/ mi la dga' ston dang lha la gtang rag zer/297

lha la zhal zas phul/ lha la mchod gtor phul ba la zhal zas phul zer/lha lung yar rdzogs/ rgyal po'i bka' la lha lung zer/ bka' gyen ldog la yar rdzogs zer/lha gsol ba/ lha mchod pa la lha gsol ba'ang zer/lha'i bla ma/ gza' phur bu'i ming la lha'i bla ma zer/lha'u mi chung bsam 'grub/ chos blon mas/ra gyi nga/dung rgyud bu chung lha'u bsam 'a grub la zer/lha'u sum cu/ gling dpa' brtul sum cu la lha'u sum cu zer/lhags pa/ bser bu'i ming la zer/ gang du thon zer ba la gang du lhags kyang zer/lhags ngar/ grang rlung bser bu la lhags ngar zer/lhan chung kha gang / lhan pa chung chung kha gang gru bzhi ba la zer/lham rul/ rul ni ngan pa'i don/ lham chad zer ba'i don/lham 'ja' ris can/ sog lham 'ja' ris can la zer/lhas byin/ bdud dga' rab dbang phyug la lhas byin zer/lhums su zhugs/ mi'i khog tu bu zhugs pa la lhums su zhugs —zer/sto mon pa'i las bdud/ lho mon pa'i ltag bdu da dang gnya' — gnon zer ba'i don/298

sgo rin chen 'byung ldan/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ya gyal zhig go /snyarma pa la/ chos skyong pa zer ba yin la/lhardzu/ mi'i thod rus la zer/ ka bā la yang zer/spyo chen 'bum ral/ gling seng chen gyi srung ba sgrub pa'i sngags pa nus mthu can zhig la zer/ḍadzāng༄ya ka ru/ dri bsung can gyi sman gyi ljon shing zhig la zer/ a kyang / de yin kyang de yin na yang zer ba'i don/a dkar rgya lam/ hor yul gyi sa cha zhig gi ming la zer/sa khu gan ne gom pa/ gling khra rgan gyi mtshan la ga ne gom pa'ang zer/a khu stag gdong rgyal po/ stag rong khro thung la stag gdong rgyal po'ang zer/a khung ke ru/ bdud kyi blon chen zhig gi ming la zer/a khung ru tra/ bdud kyi lam srung zhig gi ming la zer/a khra brgyad cu/ a khra dpa' bo'i ming / mthing g.yu ral rgyal po'i dpa' rgod brgyad cu la zer/sa grags/ mnga' ris byang stod kyi yul zhig gi ming la zer/ya grags nyi ma grags pa/ a grags rgyal po'i mtshan la zer/ 299 ༄

a rgas gsum/ spre'u khrid pa'i rtse mo ston mkhan gsum la a rgas gsum zer/a rgod the sa sna nag sta/sa/ gzig gi dpa' rgod 'gran med zhig gi ming /a rgod srin po mi gzan/ mthing sa/yu ral rgyal po'i dpa' rgod zhig gi ming /a dgos chung / dgos gal dang mkho gal chung zer ba'i don/a 'ga' leb chen/ gling seng chen gyis hor la 'phangs pa'i phyag mda' zhig gi ming la zer/a glang / gshin rje'i las mkhan a ba glang mgo la a glang zer/a sngo na/ gnam gyi ming / dgung a sngon mthon po9 nga zer /a cang / a la zer ba'i don/ a la la a/ cang rtse myo//tshar ku re yin/a chen/ hor gyi rus/ ming la zer/ yirga chen hor dang se chen hor zer/a mchod/ rgyal po'i gzhi srung sgrub pa po la a myo/chod zer/a 'jog la gri phyis/ mi rta bsad drags pas gri khar khrag zhag chags pa sga'i a 'jog la phyis zer/a nyog byis pa chung ngu la brda rnying du a nyog dang nya nyog kyang zer/a stag klu mo/ bdud kyi dpa' mo a stag lha mo la zer/300

ya brtan dug gi me tog stag rong khro thung gi sras nya tsha a brtan la zer/a thig bon gyi mo ma'am phywa mkhan mngon shes can zhig la'o//a 'thas/ rgyu nor la chags zhen ha cang che ba'i bsam pa la a 'thas zer/a nu gnyis/ brda rnying la bu chung la a nu zer/ bu chung gnyis zer ba'i don/a nu dpal seng / a nu bu chung gi ming / sras chung dpal seng zer ba'i don/a ne gnam sman/ a ne gung sman rgyal mo la gnam sman dkar mo'ang zer/a de'i seng chung nor bu/ gling rje mi yi nyi ma ge sar rgyal po la zer a gnam khrid dga'/ hor stag zhu gur dkar rgyal po la zer/ a gnam gzim chung / hor gur dkar rgyal po'i gzim gur chung ngu la zer/a phyi sman rgyal/ gling gi ma sru che khag la zer/ma pho'i ral kha 'tshos/ nga yi mtshon kha'am gri kha srungs zer ba'i don/a phyi/ ma sru che ba'i ming la a phyi sman mo'ang zer/301

a phrug byis pa chung ngu la a phrug gam mi phrug kyang zer/a bon stag gi bla ma/ nub stag gzig rgyal po'i bla mchod cig —la'o//ya bon ra bon/ stag gzig gi bon po'i bla ma gnyis gyi ming la zer/a bra skad ngan/ bra tsug gis skad 'don pa la zer/a bra kha nag tsig gu 'dra ba'i srog chags chung ngu zhig la zer/a dbon/ stag rong gdong btsan a dbon la zer/a 'bras/ mig gi 'bras bu la a 'bras kyang zer/a 'be 'ja' lam/ mkha' lam dang 'ja' lam zer ba'i don/a 'brug seng lcam 'brug mo la a 'brug kyang zer/a myes sgo ma pa ra dza/ bon po mthu ngan sngags can zhig la zer/a tsa ma/ ya re mtshar zer ba'i don/ dmar yag stag gi kha sgo la/wa mos 'dur rgyug a tsa ma/a 'dzom/ sprel dang khyi 'khrid pa'i rtsed mo ston mkhan la a 'dzom zer/a bza'i gces phrug ha la 'phangs/ hor gur dkar gyi sras zla ba 'phru dkar gling gis bkrongs ba la zer/a ya/ ngo ya'am 'gran ya zer ba la a ya'ang zer/a ya med/ 'gran zla med zer ba la a ya med zer/302

ma yag shākya rgyal mtshan/ gling stag rong phyogs kyi dpa' bo g.yer chen zhig la'o//ma yan jag ba skya bdun/ hor gyi ri so pa jag pa skya mi bdun la zer/ ma lung ngo nag stag gzig gi gyad mi stobs can zhig la zer/a g.yog thang rnyed/ ge sar la mgar g.yog thang rnyed zer/a ra/ sma ra dang kha spu la a ra yang zer/a ra lag pas byug kha spu g.yas byug g.yon byug zer ba'i don/ya rag chang la zer/ yang a rag dang ra khu zer sa'ang yod/a re dga'/ dga' spro skyes pa la a re dga' zhing yang re skyid — zer/ ma re bro/ dgod re bro zer ba bzhad gad kyi ming la zer/ma lan mi ster/ tshig lan dang gtam lan mi ster zer ba'i don/ya long mtheb drug mdzub mo drug yod bas mtheb drug zer/ hor gyi dpa' bo zhig gi ming /ya shu re/ 'gyod gdung gi tshig a shu re ltos dang gling gi sde zer ba'i don/ su ra/ chang gi ming yin la/ yang lha ma yin 'du sa'i brag phug la'ang zer ma ser mo/ seng lcam 'brug mo la a ser mo'ang zer/303

a bse khe tshe nga ni/ mnga' ris byang stod kyi mi rigs shig la zer/a gsar che 'phrad ma thag tu bzang dgu brjod zhag gcig 'gor na mtshang dgu bton pa la a gsar zer/ag tshom byil byil/ sma ra lag pas byabs pa la byil byil zer/ag tshom gyis brang stod khebs/ sma ras brang stod khebs pa zer ba'i don/ab dong / a bras brkos pa'i khong bu la 6sab dong zer/ab sha mna' zan/ ab sha ni khrel med kyi don/ ge sar la khril med mna' zan zer/am gartsigs sdam/ ma khar so btabs pa la a gtsigs sdam zer/ar jag jag pa rkun ma'i ming / brda rnying la ar jag zer/ar la gtad/ lha 'dre dam la btags pa la 6gar la gtad zer/yi hu hu/ rta'i 'tsher skad la i hu hu zer bas brda bstan/in+d+ra ni la/ rin chen sngon po zer ba'i don/i dhi bolha/ rgya gar nub phyogs kyi rgya la po zhig la zer/u dum wa ra/ srid 'dir ha cang dkon pa'i me tog zhig gi ming / u dum shing / u dumyo/ wa ra'i me tog 'dra ba'i shing zhig la zer/u tshug // blun po spyi brtol che ba la u tshug can zer/304

yug chos me tog dpyid mgo tshes dus kha gad snga ba'i me tog zhig la zer/ye 'dra yod/ 'di ltar dang 'di 'dra yod zer ba'i don/ye ma dga'/ yid cung ma rangs pa'i don la zer/ye ma ho/ ngo mtshar ba'am rmad du byung ba'i don/ye zer ltos/ e bden e bshad ltos zer ba'i don/en tsam/ cung zad tsam dang cung tsam zer ba'i don/yo rgyan mgon po/ slob dpon pad 'byung la mo rgyan mgon po'ang zer/mo rgyan pad+ma'i pan zhwa/ o rgyan pad+ma'i dbu zhwa pad+ma kha 'bus la zer/tho ro khog nyob/ rgas po khog rul lam rgad po khog 'khyug zer ba dang 'dra/yo shu dang i shu/ sems skyo shas skyes dus sngam pa 'then pa la zer/yog ma/ mid thag gi o mdud la og ma yang zer/yog zhol/ sma ra dang kha spu'i ming la og zhol yang zer/yong log brgyab/ 'phongs bskor ba'am ltag rgyab sprad pa'i don/yol sgrom/ khol sgam lta bu'i snod spyad zhig la zer/a'u tsi/ bzang bo'i don/ a mdo'i sa cha la las bu bzang bo la bu a tsa bo zer ba don gcig snyam mo/ /305

spung rong gis mdun shog gi ri mo bris/'brug pas dpe sgrig gi 'gan khur/zhe sar sgrung gi tshig 'grel gsal sgron/snangadakon mchog tshe brtan gyis bsgrigs/kun su'u mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun/nan su'u zhing chen zhin hwa dpe khang gis bkrams/mtsho sngon mi rigs par khang gis dpar/1986 'o'i 10par dpar gzhi dang tho bsgrig /1988yo'i bla12par par thengs gnyis par tab/dpar grangs/ 1’001/de4 200152sa 7—5421—0025—47༅ 6(zang)deb rer sgor/ 3 10

sgru/yo1s+dza//ཿ yam̐.oṃzo zo/r+ṣamir+sāḥ lo ñtsa—stsar+ṣalochazlom khu༅/ ( ma4)ṣ+ṭhashā shā+o༅ mogazolo ṭharta3 yo/gre1stuyo〉(༷༵snyuhūm̐X/skre/ /hoṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃt+t+waṃ/bhestsitī//༵// ṭ+wāṃ ༵blo1153kho 7—5421—0025—47ma6khrithengayi/ཿ 3 10za
